# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| htl:help | Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.Callmvn htl:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| htl:validate | This goal validates Sightly scripts syntax. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 2.0 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>
  ...
  <build>
    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->
    <pluginManagement>
      <plugins>
        <plugin>
          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
          <version>1.0.6</version>
        </plugin>
        ...
      </plugins>
    </pluginManagement>
    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>1.0.6</version>
      </plugin>
      ...
    </plugins>
  </build>
  ...
</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-source-repository--Web_Browser_Access"></a>Web Browser Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-source-repository--Web_Browser_Access"></a>

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-source-repository--Anonymous_Access"></a>Anonymous Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-source-repository--Anonymous_Access"></a>

The source can be checked out anonymously from Subversion with this command:

```bash
$ svn checkout http://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/htl-maven-plugin-1.0.6 htl-maven-plugin
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-source-repository--Developer_Access"></a>Developer Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-source-repository--Developer_Access"></a>

Everyone can access the Subversion repository via HTTP, but committers must checkout the Subversion repository via HTTPS.

```bash
$ svn checkout https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/htl-maven-plugin-1.0.6 htl-maven-plugin
```

To commit changes to the repository, execute the following command to commit your changes (svn will prompt you for your password):

```bash
$ svn commit --username your-username -m "A message"
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-source-repository--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>Access from Behind a Firewall

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-source-repository--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>

For those users who are stuck behind a corporate firewall which is blocking HTTP access to the Subversion repository, you can try to access it via the developer connection:

```bash
$ svn checkout https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/htl-maven-plugin-1.0.6 htl-maven-plugin
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-source-repository--Access_Through_a_Proxy"></a>Access Through a Proxy

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-source-repository--Access_Through_a_Proxy"></a>

The Subversion client can go through a proxy, if you configure it to do so. First, edit your "servers" configuration file to indicate which proxy to use. The file's location depends on your operating system. On Linux or Unix it is located in the directory "~/.subversion". On Windows it is in "%APPDATA%\Subversion". (Try "echo %APPDATA%", note this is a hidden directory.)

There are comments in the file explaining what to do. If you don't have that file, get the latest Subversion client and run any command; this will cause the configuration directory and template files to be created.

Example: Edit the 'servers' file and add something like:

```text
[global]
http-proxy-host = your.proxy.name
http-proxy-port = 3128
```

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.0.8</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.0.8</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Source Code Management

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Overview"></a>Overview

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Overview"></a>

This project uses [Subversion](http://subversion.apache.org/) to manage its source code. Instructions on Subversion use can be found at [http://svnbook.red-bean.com/](http://svnbook.red-bean.com/).

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Web_Browser_Access"></a>Web Browser Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Web_Browser_Access"></a>

The following is a link to a browsable version of the source repository:

```text
http://svn.apache.org/viewvc/sling/tags/htl-maven-plugin-1.0.8
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Anonymous_Access"></a>Anonymous Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Anonymous_Access"></a>

The source can be checked out anonymously from Subversion with this command:

```bash
$ svn checkout http://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/htl-maven-plugin-1.0.8 htl-maven-plugin
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Developer_Access"></a>Developer Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Developer_Access"></a>

Everyone can access the Subversion repository via HTTP, but committers must checkout the Subversion repository via HTTPS.

```bash
$ svn checkout https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/htl-maven-plugin-1.0.8 htl-maven-plugin
```

To commit changes to the repository, execute the following command to commit your changes (svn will prompt you for your password):

```bash
$ svn commit --username your-username -m "A message"
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>Access from Behind a Firewall

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>

For those users who are stuck behind a corporate firewall which is blocking HTTP access to the Subversion repository, you can try to access it via the developer connection:

```bash
$ svn checkout https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/htl-maven-plugin-1.0.8 htl-maven-plugin
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Access_Through_a_Proxy"></a>Access Through a Proxy

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-source-repository--Access_Through_a_Proxy"></a>

The Subversion client can go through a proxy, if you configure it to do so. First, edit your "servers" configuration file to indicate which proxy to use. The file's location depends on your operating system. On Linux or Unix it is located in the directory "~/.subversion". On Windows it is in "%APPDATA%\Subversion". (Try "echo %APPDATA%", note this is a hidden directory.)

There are comments in the file explaining what to do. If you don't have that file, get the latest Subversion client and run any command; this will cause the configuration directory and template files to be created.

Example: Edit the 'servers' file and add something like:

```text
[global]http-proxy-host = your.proxy.namehttp-proxy-port = 3128
```

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup></pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-usage--Configuring_Your_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring Your HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.0.8/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.0.8:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| excludes | String[] | - | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| failOnWarnings | boolean | - | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| includes | String[] | - | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| skip | boolean | - | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| sourceDirectory | File | - | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-validate-mojo--excludes"></a>excludes:**

List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-validate-mojo--failOnWarnings"></a>failOnWarnings:**

If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.failOnWarnings
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-validate-mojo--includes"></a>includes:**

List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: \*\*/\*.html

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-validate-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-validate-mojo--sourceDirectory"></a>sourceDirectory:**

Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly
scripts to validate.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.sourceDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.sourceDirectory}

---

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| htl:help | Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.Callmvn htl:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| htl:validate | Validates HTL scripts. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.1.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.1.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup></pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.1.0/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.1.0/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                    <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>                    <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <id>validate-scripts</id>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.1.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| excludes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| failOnWarnings | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| generateJavaClasses | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| generatedJavaClassesDirectory | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| ignoreImports | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| includes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| skip | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| sourceDirectory | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo--excludes"></a>excludes:**

List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo--failOnWarnings"></a>failOnWarnings:**

If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.failOnWarnings
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo--generateJavaClasses"></a>generateJavaClasses:**

If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be
stored in the folder identified by the
generatedJavaClassesDirectory parameter.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generateJavaClasses
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo--generatedJavaClassesDirectory"></a>generatedJavaClassesDirectory:**

Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder
will be added to the list of source folders for this project.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo--ignoreImports"></a>ignoreImports:**

Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when
generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these
packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.

- **Type**: java.util.Set
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.ignoreImports

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo--includes"></a>includes:**

List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: \*\*/\*.html

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.1.2</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.1.2</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup></pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.1.2/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.1.2/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                    <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>                    <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <id>validate-scripts</id>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.1.2:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| excludes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| failOnWarnings | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| generateJavaClasses | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| generatedJavaClassesDirectory | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| ignoreImports | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| includes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| skip | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| sourceDirectory | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| htl:help | Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.Callmvn htl:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| htl:validate | Validates HTL scripts. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.1.4-1.3.1</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.1.4-1.3.1</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup></pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.1.4-1.3.1/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.1.4-1.3.1/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                    <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>                    <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <id>validate-scripts</id>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.1.4-1.3.1:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| excludes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| failOnWarnings | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| generateJavaClasses | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| generatedJavaClassesDirectory | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| ignoreImports | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| includes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| skip | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| sourceDirectory | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--excludes"></a>excludes:**

List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--failOnWarnings"></a>failOnWarnings:**

If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.failOnWarnings
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--generateJavaClasses"></a>generateJavaClasses:**

If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be
stored in the folder identified by the
generatedJavaClassesDirectory parameter.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generateJavaClasses
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--generatedJavaClassesDirectory"></a>generatedJavaClassesDirectory:**

Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder
will be added to the list of source folders for this project.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--ignoreImports"></a>ignoreImports:**

Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when
generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these
packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.

- **Type**: java.util.Set
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.ignoreImports

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--includes"></a>includes:**

List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: \*\*/\*.html

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.2
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo--sourceDirectory"></a>sourceDirectory:**

Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly
scripts to validate.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.sourceDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.sourceDirectory}

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.1.6-1.4.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.1.6-1.4.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup></pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.1.6-1.4.0/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.1.6-1.4.0/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                    <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>                    <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <id>validate-scripts</id>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.1.6-1.4.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| excludes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| failOnWarnings | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| generateJavaClasses | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| generatedJavaClassesDirectory | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| ignoreImports | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| includes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| skip | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| sourceDirectory | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--excludes"></a>excludes:**

List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--failOnWarnings"></a>failOnWarnings:**

If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.failOnWarnings
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generateJavaClasses"></a>generateJavaClasses:**

If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be
stored in the folder identified by the
generatedJavaClassesDirectory parameter.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generateJavaClasses
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generatedJavaClassesDirectory"></a>generatedJavaClassesDirectory:**

Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder
will be added to the list of source folders for this project.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--ignoreImports"></a>ignoreImports:**

Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when
generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these
packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.

- **Type**: java.util.Set
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.ignoreImports

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--includes"></a>includes:**

List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: \*\*/\*.html

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.2
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo--sourceDirectory"></a>sourceDirectory:**

Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly
scripts to validate.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.sourceDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.sourceDirectory}

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Issue Management

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-issue-tracking--Overview"></a>Overview

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.1.8-1.4.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.1.8-1.4.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup></pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.1.8-1.4.0/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.1.8-1.4.0/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                    <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>                    <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <id>validate-scripts</id>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.1.8-1.4.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| excludes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| failOnWarnings | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| generateJavaClasses | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| generatedJavaClassesDirectory | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| ignoreImports | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| includes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| skip | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| sourceDirectory | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--excludes"></a>excludes:**

List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--failOnWarnings"></a>failOnWarnings:**

If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.failOnWarnings
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generateJavaClasses"></a>generateJavaClasses:**

If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be
stored in the folder identified by the
generatedJavaClassesDirectory parameter.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generateJavaClasses
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generatedJavaClassesDirectory"></a>generatedJavaClassesDirectory:**

Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder
will be added to the list of source folders for this project.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--ignoreImports"></a>ignoreImports:**

Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when
generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these
packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.

- **Type**: java.util.Set
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.ignoreImports

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--includes"></a>includes:**

List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: \*\*/\*.html

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.2
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo--sourceDirectory"></a>sourceDirectory:**

Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly
scripts to validate.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.sourceDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.sourceDirectory}

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.2.0-1.4.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.2.0-1.4.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup></pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.2.0-1.4.0/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.2.0-1.4.0/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                    <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>                    <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <id>validate-scripts</id>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.2.0-1.4.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| excludes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| failOnWarnings | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| generateJavaClasses | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| generatedJavaClassesDirectory | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| generatedJavaClassesPrefix | String | 1.2.0-1.4.0 | Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide any prefix.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesPrefix. |
| ignoreImports | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| includes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| skip | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| sourceDirectory | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--excludes"></a>excludes:**

List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--failOnWarnings"></a>failOnWarnings:**

If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.failOnWarnings
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generateJavaClasses"></a>generateJavaClasses:**

If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be
stored in the folder identified by the
generatedJavaClassesDirectory parameter.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generateJavaClasses
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generatedJavaClassesDirectory"></a>generatedJavaClassesDirectory:**

Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder
will be added to the list of source folders for this project.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generatedJavaClassesPrefix"></a>generatedJavaClassesPrefix:**

Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will
generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide
any prefix.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 1.2.0-1.4.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generatedJavaClassesPrefix

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--ignoreImports"></a>ignoreImports:**

Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when
generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these
packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.

- **Type**: java.util.Set
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.ignoreImports

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--includes"></a>includes:**

List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: \*\*/\*.html

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.2
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--sourceDirectory"></a>sourceDirectory:**

Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly
scripts to validate.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.sourceDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.sourceDirectory}

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| htl:help | Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.Callmvn htl:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| htl:validate | Validates HTL scripts. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.2.2-1.4.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.2.2-1.4.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)
