<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup></pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.2.2-1.4.0/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugin>                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                <version>1.2.2-1.4.0/version>                <configuration>                    <!-- put your configurations here -->                    <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>                    <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>                </configuration>                <executions>                    <execution>                        <id>validate-scripts</id>                        <goals>                            <goal>validate</goal>                        </goals>                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>                    </execution>                </executions>            </plugin>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

Additionally, the following dependencies are required as part of your project’s dependencies list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation --><dependency>    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler</artifactId>    <!-- version 1.0.14 or higher -->    <version>1.0.14</version>    <scope>provided</scope></dependency><dependency>    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler.java</artifactId>    <!-- version 1.0.16 or higher -->    <version>1.0.16</version>    <scope>provided</scope></dependency>
```

Starting with version 1.2.2 of the htl-maven-plugin, only the following dependency is needed as part of your project’s dependency list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation --><dependency>    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.runtime</artifactId>    <version>1.0.0-1.4.0</version>    <scope>provided</scope></dependency>
```

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.2.2-1.4.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| excludes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| failOnWarnings | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| generateJavaClasses | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| generatedJavaClassesDirectory | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| generatedJavaClassesPrefix | String | 1.2.0-1.4.0 | Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide any prefix.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesPrefix. |
| ignoreImports | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| includes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| skip | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| sourceDirectory | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--excludes"></a>excludes:**

List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--failOnWarnings"></a>failOnWarnings:**

If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.failOnWarnings
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generateJavaClasses"></a>generateJavaClasses:**

If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be
stored in the folder identified by the
generatedJavaClassesDirectory parameter.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generateJavaClasses
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generatedJavaClassesDirectory"></a>generatedJavaClassesDirectory:**

Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder
will be added to the list of source folders for this project.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generatedJavaClassesPrefix"></a>generatedJavaClassesPrefix:**

Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will
generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide
any prefix.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 1.2.0-1.4.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generatedJavaClassesPrefix

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--ignoreImports"></a>ignoreImports:**

Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when
generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these
packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.

- **Type**: java.util.Set
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.ignoreImports

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--includes"></a>includes:**

List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: \*\*/\*.html

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.2
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--sourceDirectory"></a>sourceDirectory:**

Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly
scripts to validate.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.sourceDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.sourceDirectory}

---

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| htl:help | Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.Callmvn htl:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| htl:validate | Validates HTL scripts. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.3.0-1.4.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.3.0-1.4.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>
    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup>
</pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>
    ...
    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.3.0-1.4.0/version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- put your configurations here -->
                </configuration>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>validate</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    ...
</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>
    ...
    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.3.0-1.4.0/version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- put your configurations here -->
                    <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>
                    <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>
                </configuration>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>validate-scripts</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>validate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    ...
</project>
```

Additionally, the following dependencies are required as part of your project’s dependencies list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler</artifactId>
    <!-- version 1.0.14 or higher -->
    <version>1.0.14</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler.java</artifactId>
    <!-- version 1.0.16 or higher -->
    <version>1.0.16</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
```

Starting with version 1.2.2 of the htl-maven-plugin, only the following dependency is needed as part of your project’s dependency list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.runtime</artifactId>
    <version>1.1.1-1.4.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
```

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.3.0-1.4.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| allowedExpressionOptions | Set | 1.3.0 | Adds the provided options to the list of known expression options, so that the compiler doesn't log any warnings about them.User property is:htl.allowedExpressionOptions. |
| excludes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| failOnWarnings | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| generateJavaClasses | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| generatedJavaClassesDirectory | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| generatedJavaClassesPrefix | String | 1.2.0-1.4.0 | Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide any prefix.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesPrefix. |
| ignoreImports | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| includes | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| skip | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| sourceDirectory | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--allowedExpressionOptions"></a>allowedExpressionOptions:**

Adds the provided options to the list of known expression options,
so that the compiler doesn't log any warnings about them.

- **Type**: java.util.Set
- **Since**: 1.3.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.allowedExpressionOptions

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--excludes"></a>excludes:**

List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--failOnWarnings"></a>failOnWarnings:**

If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.failOnWarnings
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generateJavaClasses"></a>generateJavaClasses:**

If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be
stored in the folder identified by the
generatedJavaClassesDirectory parameter.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generateJavaClasses
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generatedJavaClassesDirectory"></a>generatedJavaClassesDirectory:**

Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder
will be added to the list of source folders for this project.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl

Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will
generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide
any prefix.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 1.2.0-1.4.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.generatedJavaClassesPrefix

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--ignoreImports"></a>ignoreImports:**

Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when
generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these
packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.

- **Type**: java.util.Set
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.ignoreImports

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--includes"></a>includes:**

List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: \*\*/\*.html

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.2
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--sourceDirectory"></a>sourceDirectory:**

Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly
scripts to validate.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.sourceDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.sourceDirectory}

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| htl:help | Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.Callmvn htl:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| htl:validate | Validates HTL scripts. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.8 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.3.2-1.4.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.3.2-1.4.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>
    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup>
</pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>
    ...
    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.3.2-1.4.0/version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- put your configurations here -->
                </configuration>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>validate</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    ...
</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>
    ...
    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.3.2-1.4.0/version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- put your configurations here -->
                    <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>
                    <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>
                </configuration>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>validate-scripts</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>validate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    ...
</project>
```

Additionally, the following dependencies are required as part of your project’s dependencies list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler</artifactId>
    <!-- version 1.0.14 or higher -->
    <version>1.0.14</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler.java</artifactId>
    <!-- version 1.0.16 or higher -->
    <version>1.0.16</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
```

Starting with version 1.2.2 of the htl-maven-plugin, only the following dependency is needed as part of your project’s dependency list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.runtime</artifactId>
    <version>$context.get("sightly.runtime.version")</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
```

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.3.2-1.4.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <allowedExpressionOptions> | Set | 1.3.0 | Adds the provided options to the list of known expression options, so that the compiler doesn't log any warnings about them.User property is:htl.allowedExpressionOptions. |
| <excludes> | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| <failOnWarnings> | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| <generateJavaClasses> | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| <generatedJavaClassesDirectory> | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| <generatedJavaClassesPrefix> | String | 1.2.0-1.4.0 | Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide any prefix.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesPrefix. |
| <ignoreImports> | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| <includes> | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| <skip> | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| <sourceDirectory> | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

Adds the provided options to the list of known expression options,
so that the compiler doesn't log any warnings about them.

- **Since**: 1.3.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.allowedExpressionOptions

transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder

- **Type**: java.io.File

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--a.3CgeneratedJavaClassesPrefix.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--generatedJavaClassesPrefix"></a><generatedJavaClassesPrefix>**

Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will
generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 1.2.0-1.4.0
- **Required**: No

Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when
generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from
transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these
packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.

- **Type**: java.util.Set
- **Since**: 1.1.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.ignoreImports

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--a.3Cincludes.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--includes"></a><includes>**

List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are
relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see
the sourceDirectory configuration option).

- **Type**: java.lang.String[]
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: \*\*/\*.html

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--a.3Cskip.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--skip"></a><skip>**

If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 1.0.2
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.skip
- **Default**: false

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--a.3CsourceDirectory.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-2-1-4-0-validate-mojo--sourceDirectory"></a><sourceDirectory>**

Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly
scripts to validate.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 1.0.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: htl.sourceDirectory
- **Default**: ${project.build.sourceDirectory}

---

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| htl:help | Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.Callmvn htl:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| htl:validate | Validates HTL scripts. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.3.4-1.4.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.3.4-1.4.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes you’ve configured the ${project.build.sourceDirectory} setting.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>
    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup>
</pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>
    ...
    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.3.4-1.4.0/version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- put your configurations here -->
                </configuration>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>validate</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    ...
</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>
    ...
    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
                <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.3.4-1.4.0/version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- put your configurations here -->
                    <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>
                    <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>
                </configuration>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>validate-scripts</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>validate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    ...
</project>
```

Additionally, the following dependencies are required as part of your project’s dependencies list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler</artifactId>
    <!-- version 1.0.14 or higher -->
    <version>1.0.14</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler.java</artifactId>
    <!-- version 1.0.16 or higher -->
    <version>1.0.16</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
```

Starting with version 1.2.2 of the htl-maven-plugin, only the following dependency is needed as part of your project’s dependency list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.runtime</artifactId>
    <version>$context.get("sightly.runtime.version")</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
```

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.3.4-1.4.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <allowedExpressionOptions> | Set | 1.3.0 | Adds the provided options to the list of known expression options, so that the compiler doesn't log any warnings about them.User property is:htl.allowedExpressionOptions. |
| <excludes> | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| <failOnWarnings> | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| <generateJavaClasses> | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| <generatedJavaClassesDirectory> | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| <generatedJavaClassesPrefix> | String | 1.2.0-1.4.0 | Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide any prefix.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesPrefix. |
| <ignoreImports> | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| <includes> | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| <skip> | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| <sourceDirectory> | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-3-4-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Project Distribution Management

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-distribution-management--Overview"></a>Overview

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-distribution-management--Overview"></a>

The following is the distribution management information used by this project.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-plugin-info"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| htl:help | Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.Callmvn htl:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| htl:validate | Validates HTL scripts. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.8 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>2.0.0-1.4.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>2.0.0-1.4.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes the scripts are found in the ${project.build.scriptSourceDirectory} directory. Alternatively, you can configure the folder using the sourceDirectory configuration parameter.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>
    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup>
</pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>
    ...
    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugins>
                <plugin>
                    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
                    <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                    <version>2.0.0-1.4.0</version>
                    <configuration>
                        <!-- put your configurations here -->
                    </configuration>
                    <executions>
                        <execution>
                            <goals>
                                <goal>validate</goal>
                            </goals>
                        </execution>
                    </executions>
                </plugin>
            </plugins>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    ...
</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>
    ...
    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugins>
                <plugin>
                    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
                    <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                    <version>2.0.0-1.4.0</version>
                    <configuration>
                        <!-- put your configurations here -->
                        <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>
                        <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>
                    </configuration>
                    <executions>
                        <execution>
                            <id>validate-scripts</id>
                            <goals>
                                <goal>validate</goal>
                            </goals>
                            <phase>generate-sources</phase>
                        </execution>
                    </executions>
                </plugin>
            </plugins>    
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    ...
</project>
```

Additionally, the following dependencies are required as part of your project’s dependencies list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler</artifactId>
    <!-- version 1.0.14 or higher -->
    <version>1.0.14</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler.java</artifactId>
    <!-- version 1.0.16 or higher -->
    <version>1.0.16</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
```

Starting with version 1.2.2 of the htl-maven-plugin, only the following dependency is needed as part of your project’s dependency list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.runtime</artifactId>
    <version>1.2.0-1.4.0</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
```

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:2.0.0-1.4.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <allowedExpressionOptions> | Set | 1.3.0 | Adds the provided options to the list of known expression options, so that the compiler doesn't log any warnings about them.User property is:htl.allowedExpressionOptions. |
| <excludes> | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| <failOnErrors> | boolean | 2.0.0 | If set to "false" it will not fail the build on compiler errors, however the errors will still be logged.Default value is:true.User property is:htl.failOnErrors. |
| <failOnWarnings> | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| <generateJavaClasses> | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| <generatedJavaClassesDirectory> | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| <generatedJavaClassesPrefix> | String | 1.2.0-1.4.0 | Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide any prefix.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesPrefix. |
| <ignoreImports> | Set | 1.1.0 | Defines a list of Java packages that should be ignored when generating the import statements for the Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts. Subpackages of these packages will also be part automatically of the ignore list.User property is:htl.ignoreImports. |
| <includes> | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option).Default value is:**/*.html. |
| <skip> | boolean | 1.0.2 | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| <sourceDirectory> | File | 1.0.0 | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find HTL scripts to validate. The default value has been changed from${project.build.sourceDirectory} to${project.build.scriptSourceDirectory} in version 2.0.0.Default value is:${project.build.scriptSourceDirectory}.User property is:htl.sourceDirectory. |

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| htl:help | Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.Callmvn htl:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| htl:validate | Validates HTL scripts. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>2.0.2-1.4.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>2.0.2-1.4.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-usage"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes the scripts are found in the ${project.build.scriptSourceDirectory} directory. Alternatively, you can configure the folder using the sourceDirectory configuration parameter.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>
    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup>
</pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>
    ...
    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugins>
                <plugin>
                    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
                    <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                    <version>2.0.2-1.4.0</version>
                    <configuration>
                        <!-- put your configurations here -->
                    </configuration>
                    <executions>
                        <execution>
                            <goals>
                                <goal>validate</goal>
                            </goals>
                        </execution>
                    </executions>
                </plugin>
            </plugins>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    ...
</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-2-1-4-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>
    ...
    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugins>
                <plugin>
                    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
                    <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                    <version>2.0.2-1.4.0</version>
                    <configuration>
                        <!-- put your configurations here -->
                        <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>
                        <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>
                    </configuration>
                    <executions>
                        <execution>
                            <id>validate-scripts</id>
                            <goals>
                                <goal>validate</goal>
                            </goals>
                            <phase>generate-sources</phase>
                        </execution>
                    </executions>
                </plugin>
            </plugins>    
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    ...
</project>
```

Additionally, the following dependencies are required as part of your project’s dependencies list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler</artifactId>
    <!-- version 1.0.14 or higher -->
    <version>1.0.14</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.compiler.java</artifactId>
    <!-- version 1.0.16 or higher -->
    <version>1.0.16</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
```

Starting with version 1.2.2 of the htl-maven-plugin, only the following dependency is needed as part of your project’s dependency list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.runtime</artifactId>
    <version>1.2.0-1.4.0</version>
    <scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
```

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:2.0.2-1.4.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-index"></a>

# HTL Maven Plugin – Overview

# Overview

The Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin provides support for validating HTML Template Language scripts from projects during build time, reporting issues like:

- syntax errors;
- expression warnings (e.g. missing required display contexts, sensible attributes with dynamic values, etc.);
- incorrect usage of block elements.

It is compatible with [m2eclipse](https://www.eclipse.org/m2e/documentation/m2e-making-maven-plugins-compat.html) and supports executing its goals during Eclipse incremental builds.

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-index--Goals"></a>Goals

The HTL Maven Plugin has only one goal:

- [htl:validate](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-validate-mojo) is bound to the generate-sources phase and is used to validate/transpile HTL scripts.

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-index--Usage"></a>Usage

General instructions on how to use the HTL Maven Plugin can be found on the [usage](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-usage) page.

In case you still have questions regarding the plugin’s usage feel free to contact the Apache Sling Development List. The posts to the mailing list are archived and could already contain the answer to your question as part of an older thread. Hence, it is also worth browsing/searching the mail archive.

If you feel like the plugin is missing a feature or has a defect, you can fill a feature request or bug report in our issue tracker. When creating a new issue, please provide a comprehensive description of your concern. Especially for fixing bugs it is crucial that the developers can reproduce your problem. For this reason, entire debug logs, POMs or most preferably little demo projects attached to the issue are very much appreciated. Of course, patches are welcome, too. Contributors can check out the project from our source repository and will find supplementary information in the guide to helping with Maven.

---

# HTL Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| htl:help | Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.Callmvn htl:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| htl:validate | Validates HTL scripts and optionally transpiles them to Java classes. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 3.3.9 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>2.0.4-1.4.0</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>2.0.4-1.4.0</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-usage"></a>

# HTL Maven Plugin – Usage

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-usage--Usage"></a>Usage

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-usage--Validating_your_HTL_Scripts"></a>Validating your HTL Scripts

To validate your HTL Scripts you can run the following command:

```bash
mvn org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:validate
```

This assumes the scripts are found in the `${project.build.scriptSourceDirectory}` directory. Alternatively, you can configure the folder using the `sourceDirectory` configuration parameter.

The command can be simplified to

```bash
mvn htl:validate
```

if your Maven user settings file provides the following configuration

```xml
<pluginGroups>    <pluginGroup>org.apache.sling</pluginGroup></pluginGroups>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-usage--Configuring_the_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Configuring the HTL Maven Plugin

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugins>                <plugin>                    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                    <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                    <version>2.0.4-1.4.0</version>                    <configuration>                        <!-- put your configurations here -->                    </configuration>                    <executions>                        <execution>                            <goals>                                <goal>validate</goal>                            </goals>                        </execution>                    </executions>                </plugin>            </plugins>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-usage--Generating_Java_classes_from_your_HTL_scripts"></a>Generating Java classes from your HTL scripts

Since version 1.1.0 it’s possible to generate Java classes from the project’s HTL scripts. This is useful when you want to identify your script’s Java dependencies or precompile scripts. To do this the following configuration should be applied:

```xml
<project>    ...    <build>        <pluginManagement>            <plugins>                <plugin>                    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>                    <artifactId>htl-maven-plugin</artifactId>                    <version>2.0.4-1.4.0</version>                    <configuration>                        <!-- put your configurations here -->                        <failOnWarnings>true</failOnWarnings>                        <generateJavaClasses>true</generateJavaClasses>                    </configuration>                    <executions>                        <execution>                            <id>transpile-scripts</id>                            <goals>                                <goal>validate</goal>                            </goals>                            <phase>generate-sources</phase>                        </execution>                    </executions>                </plugin>            </plugins>        </pluginManagement>    </build>    ...</project>
```

Additionally, the following dependency is needed as part of your project’s dependency list:

```text
<!-- HTL dependencies needed for the HTL Maven Plugin source code generation --><dependency>    <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>    <artifactId>org.apache.sling.scripting.sightly.runtime</artifactId>    <version>1.2.6-1.4.0</version>    <scope>provided</scope></dependency>
```

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:2.0.4-1.4.0:validate

**Description**:

Validates HTL scripts and optionally transpiles them to Java
classes.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `generate-sources`.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-2-0-4-1-4-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <allowedExpressionOptions> | Set | 1.3.0 | Adds the provided options to the list of known expression options, so that the compiler doesn't log any warnings about them.User property is:htl.allowedExpressionOptions. |
| <excludes> | String[] | 1.0.0 | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| <failOnErrors> | boolean | 2.0.0 | If set to "false" it will not fail the build on compiler errors, however the errors will still be logged.Default value is:true.User property is:htl.failOnErrors. |
| <failOnWarnings> | boolean | 1.0.0 | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.failOnWarnings. |
| <generateJavaClasses> | boolean | 1.1.0 | If set to "true" it will generate the Java classes resulted from transpiling the HTL scripts to Java. The generated classes will be stored in the folder identified by thegeneratedJavaClassesDirectoryparameter.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.generateJavaClasses. |
| <generatedJavaClassesDirectory> | File | 1.1.0 | Defines the folder where the generated Java classes resulted from transpiling the project's HTL scripts will be stored. This folder will be added to the list of source folders for this project.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/htl.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesDirectory. |
| <generatedJavaClassesPrefix> | String | 1.2.0-1.4.0 | Defines the package prefix under which the HTL compilers will generate the Java classes. By default the plugin doesn't provide any prefix.User property is:htl.generatedJavaClassesPrefix. |

# HTL Maven Plugin – htl:help

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-help-mojo--htl:help"></a>htl:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:2.0.4-1.4.0:help

**Description**:

Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.  
Call `mvn htl:help -Ddetail=true
-Dgoal=<goal-name>` to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <detail> | boolean | - | Iftrue, display all settable properties for each goal.Default value is:false.User property is:detail. |
| <goal> | String | - | The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.User property is:goal. |
| <indentSize> | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default value is:2.User property is:indentSize. |
| <lineLength> | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin for Compiling JSP Sources into Bundles – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-jspc-maven-plugin-archives-jspc-maven-plugin-2-1-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-jspc-maven-plugin-archives-jspc-maven-plugin-2-1-0-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| jspc:help | Display help information on jspc-maven-plugin.Callmvn jspc:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| jspc:jspc | TheJspcMojois implements the Sling Maven JspC goaljspccompiling JSP into the target and creating a component descriptor for Declarative Services to use the JSP with the help of the appropriate adapter as component. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-jspc-maven-plugin-archives-jspc-maven-plugin-2-1-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-jspc-maven-plugin-archives-jspc-maven-plugin-2-1-0-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 2.0 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-jspc-maven-plugin-archives-jspc-maven-plugin-2-1-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-jspc-maven-plugin-archives-jspc-maven-plugin-2-1-0-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>
  ...
  <build>
    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->
    <pluginManagement>
      <plugins>
        <plugin>
          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
          <artifactId>jspc-maven-plugin</artifactId>
          <version>2.1.0</version>
        </plugin>
        ...
      </plugins>
    </pluginManagement>
    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>jspc-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>2.1.0</version>
      </plugin>
      ...
    </plugins>
  </build>
  ...
</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)
