<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info"></a>

# Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| slingfeature:aggregate-features | Aggregate multiple features into a single one. |
| slingfeature:analyse-features | Analyse the feature. |
| slingfeature:apis-jar | Generates the APIs JARs for the selected feature files. |
| slingfeature:apply-default-config | This mojo applies default configurations to selected features. |
| slingfeature:attach-featurearchives | Create a feature model archive and attach it. An archive is created for each feature of this project |
| slingfeature:attach-features | Attach the feature as a project artifact. |
| slingfeature:collect-artifacts | No description. |
| slingfeature:embed-features | Embed the features in the resources |
| slingfeature:extract-extension | No description. |
| slingfeature:features-diff | Compares different versions of the same Feature Model. |
| slingfeature:help | Display help information on slingfeature-maven-plugin.Callmvn slingfeature:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| slingfeature:include-artifact | This goal creates a Feature Model file that includes the Module Artifact as bundle (or extension) so that the Artifact can be added through a FM into a FM project. The FM file can be found in the 'build directory'/slingfeature-tmp folder. After a FM file is created successfully this file will be installed in the local Maven Repository as 'slingosgifeature' file under the Module's Maven Id location (group, artifact, version). This file can then later be used inside the 'aggregate-features' goal with:<includeArtifact> <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId> <artifactId>org.apache.sling.test.feature</artifactId> <version>1.0.0</version> <classifier>my-test-classifier</classifier> <type>slingosgifeature</type> </includeArtifact>It also can add dependencies to the FM file if its scope is provided (normally that would be 'compile'). In addition a bundle start order can be set for these included dependency bundles. Finally any FM files inside the Source FM folder are embedded into the FM file. This allows to add extension files like 'repoinit' etc to be added to provide them with the module. |
| slingfeature:info | Extract information from a feature This mojo does not require a project, it can be run by just pointing it at a feature file. When run from within a project, the normal feature selection mechanism can be used. This mojo supportsExtracting the exported packages per feature and writing them to a fileDetecting duplicates across features and writing a report |
| slingfeature:launch-features | Launches the given Feature File |
| slingfeature:repository | Create a Maven repository structure from the referenced artifacts in the features. |
| slingfeature:update-feature-versions | Update the bundles/artifact versions |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 2.0 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>  ...  <build>    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->    <pluginManagement>      <plugins>        <plugin>          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>          <artifactId>slingfeature-maven-plugin</artifactId>          <version>1.7.2</version>        </plugin>        ...      </plugins>    </pluginManagement>    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->    <plugins>      <plugin>        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>        <artifactId>slingfeature-maven-plugin</artifactId>        <version>1.7.2</version>      </plugin>      ...    </plugins>  </build>  ...</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-9-2-index"></a>

# Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin – Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-9-2-index--Apache_Sling_OSGi_Feature_Maven_Plugin"></a>

# Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin

Maven Plugin for building OSGi features and applications.

See [Goals](#sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-9-2-plugin-info) for a list of supported goals.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-9-2-index--Usage"></a>

## Usage

As this Maven plugin comes with [Maven extensions](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-using-extensions.html) (for defining custom bindings for `default` lifecycle and a custom artifact handler for type/packaging `slingosgifeature` as well as a `AbstractMavenLifecycleParticipant`) it needs to be loaded accordingly

```xml
<plugin>
  <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
  <artifactId>slingfeature-maven-plugin</artifactId>
  <version>1.9.2</version>
  <extensions>true</extensions>
</plugin>
```

Additional Documentation can be found in the [README](https://github.com/apache/sling-slingfeature-maven-plugin/blob/master/README.md) page.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-9-2-index--Plugin_bindings_for_slingosgifeature_packaging"></a>

## Plugin bindings for `slingosgifeature` packaging

```xml
<phases>
  <install>org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:attach-features,
           org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-install-plugin:install</install>
  <deploy>org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-deploy-plugin:deploy</deploy>
</phases>
```

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-9-2-plugin-info"></a>

# Plugin Documentation – Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-9-2-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

# Plugin Documentation

This report describes goals, parameters details, requirements and sample usage of this plugin.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-9-2-plugin-info--Goals"></a>

## Goals

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| slingfeature:aggregate-features | Aggregate multiple features into a single one. |
| slingfeature:analyse-features | Analyse the feature. |
| slingfeature:apis-jar | Generates the APIs JARs for the selected feature files. |
| slingfeature:apply-default-config | This mojo applies default configurations to selected features. |
| slingfeature:attach-featurearchives | Create a feature model archive and attach it. An archive is created for each feature of this project |
| slingfeature:attach-features | Attach the feature as a project artifact. |
| slingfeature:collect-artifacts | No description. |
| slingfeature:embed-features | Embed the features in the resources |
| slingfeature:extract-extension | No description. |
| slingfeature:features-diff | Compares different versions of the same Feature Model. |
| slingfeature:help | Display help information on slingfeature-maven-plugin.Callmvn slingfeature:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| slingfeature:include-artifact | This goal creates a Feature Model file that includes the Module Artifact as bundle (or extension) so that the Artifact can be added through a FM into a FM project. The FM file can be found in the 'build directory'/slingfeature-tmp folder. After a FM file is created successfully this file will be installed in the local Maven Repository as 'slingosgifeature' file under the Module's Maven Id location (group, artifact, version). This file can then later be used inside the 'aggregate-features' goal with:<includeArtifact> <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId> <artifactId>org.apache.sling.test.feature</artifactId> <version>1.0.0</version> <classifier>my-test-classifier</classifier> <type>slingosgifeature</type> </includeArtifact>It also can add dependencies to the FM file if its scope is provided (normally that would be 'compile'). In addition a bundle start order can be set for these included dependency bundles. Finally any FM files inside the Source FM folder are embedded into the FM file. This allows to add extension files like 'repoinit' etc to be added to provide them with the module. |
| slingfeature:info | Extract information from a feature This mojo does not require a project, it can be run by just pointing it at a feature file. When run from within a project, the normal feature selection mechanism can be used. This mojo supportsExtracting the exported packages per feature and writing them to a fileDetecting duplicates across features and writing a report |
| slingfeature:launch-features | Launches the given Feature File |
| slingfeature:repository | Create a Maven repository structure from the referenced artifacts in the features. |
| slingfeature:update-feature-versions | Update the bundles/artifact versions |

| slingfeature:include-artifact | This goal creates a Feature Model file that includes the Module Artifact as bundle (or extension) so that the Artifact can be added through a FM into a FM project. The FM file can be found in the 'build directory'/slingfeature-tmp folder. After a FM file is created successfully this file will be installed in the local Maven Repository as 'slingosgifeature' file under the Module's Maven Id location (group, artifact, version). This file can then later be used inside the 'aggregate-features' goal with:<includeArtifact> <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId> <artifactId>org.apache.sling.test.feature</artifactId> <version>1.0.0</version> <classifier>my-test-classifier</classifier> <type>slingosgifeature</type> </includeArtifact>It also can add dependencies to the FM file if its scope is provided (normally that would be 'compile'). In addition a bundle start order can be set for these included dependency bundles. Finally any FM files inside the Source FM folder are embedded into the FM file. This allows to add extension files like 'repoinit' etc to be added to provide them with the module. |
| slingfeature:info | Extract information from a feature This mojo does not require a project, it can be run by just pointing it at a feature file. When run from within a project, the normal feature selection mechanism can be used. This mojo supportsExtracting the exported packages per feature and writing them to a fileDetecting duplicates across features and writing a report |
| slingfeature:launch-features | Launches the given Feature File |
| slingfeature:repository | Create a Maven repository structure from the referenced artifacts in the features. |
| slingfeature:update-feature-versions | Update the bundles/artifact versions |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-plugin-info"></a>

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| slingstart:attach-modelarchive | Attach the model archive as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:attach-slingfeature | Attach the model as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:help | Display help information on slingstart-maven-plugin.Callmvn slingstart:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| slingstart:package | Create a Sling quickstart package (either JAR or WAR) based on the referenced model. |
| slingstart:prepare-package | Prepare the packaging of the Sling quickstart artifact (either JAR or WAR). |
| slingstart:repository | Create a Maven repository structure from the referenced artifacts in the model. |
| slingstart:start | Start one or multiple launchpad instance(s). |
| slingstart:stop | Stop one or multiple running launchpad instance(s). |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 2.0 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.8 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>
  ...
  <build>
    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->
    <pluginManagement>
      <plugins>
        <plugin>
          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
          <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
          <version>1.7.14</version>
        </plugin>
        ...
      </plugins>
    </pluginManagement>
    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>1.7.14</version>
      </plugin>
      ...
    </plugins>
  </build>
  ...
</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| slingstart:attach-modelarchive | Attach the model archive as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:attach-slingfeature | Attach the model as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:help | Display help information on slingstart-maven-plugin.Callmvn slingstart:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| slingstart:package | Create a Sling quickstart package (either JAR or WAR) based on the referenced model. |
| slingstart:prepare-package | Prepare the packaging of the Sling quickstart artifact (either JAR or WAR). |
| slingstart:repository | Create a Maven repository structure from the referenced artifacts in the model. |
| slingstart:start | Start one or multiple launchpad instance(s). |
| slingstart:stop | Stop one or multiple running launchpad instance(s). |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 2.0 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.8 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>
  ...
  <build>
    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->
    <pluginManagement>
      <plugins>
        <plugin>
          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
          <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
          <version>1.7.16</version>
        </plugin>
        ...
      </plugins>
    </pluginManagement>
    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>1.7.16</version>
      </plugin>
      ...
    </plugins>
  </build>
  ...
</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info"></a>

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| slingstart:attach-modelarchive | Attaches the model archive as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:attach-slingfeature | Attaches the model as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:help | Display help information on slingstart-maven-plugin.Callmvn slingstart:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| slingstart:package | Initialize a Sling application project by extracting bundles into the correct locations. |
| slingstart:prepare-package | Prepare the sling start applications. |
| slingstart:repository | Create a mvn repository structure from the artifacts |
| slingstart:start | Mojo for starting launchpad. |
| slingstart:stop | Stops the running launchpad instances. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 2.0 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>
  ...
  <build>
    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->
    <pluginManagement>
      <plugins>
        <plugin>
          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
          <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
          <version>1.7.2</version>
        </plugin>
        ...
      </plugins>
    </pluginManagement>
    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>1.7.2</version>
      </plugin>
      ...
    </plugins>
  </build>
  ...
</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – Source Code Management

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Overview"></a>Overview

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Overview"></a>

This project uses [Subversion](http://subversion.apache.org/) to manage its source code. Instructions on Subversion use can be found at [http://svnbook.red-bean.com/](http://svnbook.red-bean.com/).

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Web_Browser_Access"></a>Web Browser Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Web_Browser_Access"></a>

The following is a link to a browsable version of the source repository:

```text
http://svn.apache.org/viewvc/sling/tags/slingstart-maven-plugin-1.7.2
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Anonymous_Access"></a>Anonymous Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Anonymous_Access"></a>

The source can be checked out anonymously from Subversion with this command:

```bash
$ svn checkout http://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/slingstart-maven-plugin-1.7.2 slingstart-maven-plugin
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Developer_Access"></a>Developer Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Developer_Access"></a>

Everyone can access the Subversion repository via HTTP, but committers must checkout the Subversion repository via HTTPS.

```bash
$ svn checkout https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/slingstart-maven-plugin-1.7.2 slingstart-maven-plugin
```

To commit changes to the repository, execute the following command to commit your changes (svn will prompt you for your password):

```bash
$ svn commit --username your-username -m "A message"
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>Access from Behind a Firewall

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>

For those users who are stuck behind a corporate firewall which is blocking HTTP access to the Subversion repository, you can try to access it via the developer connection:

```bash
$ svn checkout https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/slingstart-maven-plugin-1.7.2 slingstart-maven-plugin
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Access_Through_a_Proxy"></a>Access Through a Proxy

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-source-repository--Access_Through_a_Proxy"></a>

The Subversion client can go through a proxy, if you configure it to do so. First, edit your "servers" configuration file to indicate which proxy to use. The file's location depends on your operating system. On Linux or Unix it is located in the directory "~/.subversion". On Windows it is in "%APPDATA%\Subversion". (Try "echo %APPDATA%", note this is a hidden directory.)

There are comments in the file explaining what to do. If you don't have that file, get the latest Subversion client and run any command; this will cause the configuration directory and template files to be created.

Example: Edit the 'servers' file and add something like:

```text
[global]
http-proxy-host = your.proxy.name
http-proxy-port = 3128
```

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-plugin-info"></a>

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| slingstart:attach-modelarchive | Attach the model archive as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:attach-slingfeature | Attach the model as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:help | Display help information on slingstart-maven-plugin.Callmvn slingstart:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| slingstart:package | Create a Sling quickstart package (either JAR or WAR) based on the referenced model. |
| slingstart:prepare-package | Prepare the packaging of the Sling quickstart artifact (either JAR or WAR). |
| slingstart:repository | Create a Maven repository structure from the referenced artifacts in the model. |
| slingstart:start | Start one or multiple launchpad instance(s). |
| slingstart:stop | Stop one or multiple running launchpad instance(s). |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 2.0 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>
  ...
  <build>
    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->
    <pluginManagement>
      <plugins>
        <plugin>
          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
          <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
          <version>1.7.6</version>
        </plugin>
        ...
      </plugins>
    </pluginManagement>
    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>1.7.6</version>
      </plugin>
      ...
    </plugins>
  </build>
  ...
</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – Source Code Management

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Overview"></a>Overview

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Overview"></a>

This project uses [Subversion](http://subversion.apache.org/) to manage its source code. Instructions on Subversion use can be found at [http://svnbook.red-bean.com/](http://svnbook.red-bean.com/).

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Web_Browser_Access"></a>Web Browser Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Web_Browser_Access"></a>

The following is a link to a browsable version of the source repository:

```text
http://svn.apache.org/viewvc/sling/tags/slingstart-maven-plugin-1.7.6
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Anonymous_Access"></a>Anonymous Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Anonymous_Access"></a>

The source can be checked out anonymously from Subversion with this command:

```bash
$ svn checkout http://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/slingstart-maven-plugin-1.7.6 slingstart-maven-plugin
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Developer_Access"></a>Developer Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Developer_Access"></a>

Everyone can access the Subversion repository via HTTP, but committers must checkout the Subversion repository via HTTPS.

```bash
$ svn checkout https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/slingstart-maven-plugin-1.7.6 slingstart-maven-plugin
```

To commit changes to the repository, execute the following command to commit your changes (svn will prompt you for your password):

```bash
$ svn commit --username your-username -m "A message"
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>Access from Behind a Firewall

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>

For those users who are stuck behind a corporate firewall which is blocking HTTP access to the Subversion repository, you can try to access it via the developer connection:

```bash
$ svn checkout https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/sling/tags/slingstart-maven-plugin-1.7.6 slingstart-maven-plugin
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Access_Through_a_Proxy"></a>Access Through a Proxy

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-source-repository--Access_Through_a_Proxy"></a>

The Subversion client can go through a proxy, if you configure it to do so. First, edit your "servers" configuration file to indicate which proxy to use. The file's location depends on your operating system. On Linux or Unix it is located in the directory "~/.subversion". On Windows it is in "%APPDATA%\Subversion". (Try "echo %APPDATA%", note this is a hidden directory.)

There are comments in the file explaining what to do. If you don't have that file, get the latest Subversion client and run any command; this will cause the configuration directory and template files to be created.

Example: Edit the 'servers' file and add something like:

```text
[global]
http-proxy-host = your.proxy.name
http-proxy-port = 3128
```

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-plugin-info"></a>

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| slingstart:attach-modelarchive | Attach the model archive as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:attach-slingfeature | Attach the model as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:generate-resources | No description. |
| slingstart:help | Display help information on slingstart-maven-plugin.Callmvn slingstart:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| slingstart:package | Create a Sling quickstart package (either JAR or WAR) based on the referenced model. |
| slingstart:prepare-package | Prepare the packaging of the Sling quickstart artifact (either JAR or WAR). |
| slingstart:repository | Create a Maven repository structure from the referenced artifacts in the model. |
| slingstart:start | Start one or multiple launchpad instance(s). |
| slingstart:stop | Stop one or multiple running launchpad instance(s). |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 2.0 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.8 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>
  ...
  <build>
    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->
    <pluginManagement>
      <plugins>
        <plugin>
          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
          <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
          <version>1.8.2</version>
        </plugin>
        ...
      </plugins>
    </pluginManagement>
    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>1.8.2</version>
      </plugin>
      ...
    </plugins>
  </build>
  ...
</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-plugin-info"></a>

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – Plugin Documentation

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>Plugin Documentation

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-plugin-info--Plugin_Documentation"></a>

Goals available for this plugin:

| Goal | Description |
| --- | --- |
| slingstart:attach-modelarchive | Attach the model archive as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:attach-slingfeature | Attach the model as a project artifact. |
| slingstart:generate-resources | No description. |
| slingstart:help | Display help information on slingstart-maven-plugin.Callmvn slingstart:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>to display parameter details. |
| slingstart:package | Create a Sling quickstart package (either JAR or WAR) based on the referenced model. |
| slingstart:prepare-package | Prepare the packaging of the Sling quickstart artifact (either JAR or WAR). |
| slingstart:repository | Create a Maven repository structure from the referenced artifacts in the model. |
| slingstart:start | Start one or multiple launchpad instance(s). |
| slingstart:stop | Stop one or multiple running launchpad instance(s). |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>System Requirements

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-plugin-info--System_Requirements"></a>

The following specifies the minimum requirements to run this Maven plugin:

| Maven | 2.0 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 1.7 |
| Memory | No minimum requirement. |
| Disk Space | No minimum requirement. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-plugin-info--Usage"></a>Usage

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-plugin-info--Usage"></a>

You should specify the version in your project's plugin configuration:

```xml
<project>
  ...
  <build>
    <!-- To define the plugin version in your parent POM -->
    <pluginManagement>
      <plugins>
        <plugin>
          <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
          <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
          <version>1.9.12</version>
        </plugin>
        ...
      </plugins>
    </pluginManagement>
    <!-- To use the plugin goals in your POM or parent POM -->
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>slingstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>1.9.12</version>
      </plugin>
      ...
    </plugins>
  </build>
  ...
</project>
```

For more information, see ["Guide to Configuring Plug-ins"](http://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html)

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-scm--Overview"></a>

This project uses [Git](https://git-scm.com/) to manage its source code. Instructions on Git use can be found at [https://git-scm.com/documentation](https://git-scm.com/documentation).

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-scm--Anonymous_Access"></a>Anonymous Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-scm--Anonymous_Access"></a>

The source can be checked out anonymously from Git with this command (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)):

```bash
$ git clone --branch slingstart-maven-plugin-1.9.12 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/sling-slingstart-maven-plugin.git
```

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-scm--Developer_Access"></a>Developer Access

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-9-12-scm--Developer_Access"></a>

Only project developers can access the Git tree via this method (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)).

```bash
$ git clone --branch slingstart-maven-plugin-1.9.12 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/sling-slingstart-maven-plugin.git
```

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – slingstart:attach-modelarchive

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--slingstart:attach-modelarchive"></a>slingstart:attach-modelarchive

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.9.12:attach-modelarchive

**Description**:

Attach the model archive as a project artifact.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: test.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): package.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <allowUnresolvedPomDependencies> | boolean | - | If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in the Maven POM.Default value is:false. |
| <disableExtendingMavenClasspath> | boolean | - | If set totruethe Maven classpath (either scope "provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being referenced in the model.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| <model> | String | 1.3 | Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any model found inmodelDirectory.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| <modelArchiveName> | String | - | The filename to be used for the generated model archive file.Default value is:${project.build.finalName}. |
| <modelDirectory> | File | - | The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter is evaluated in theDependencyLifecycleParticipant. As default first${basedir}/src/main/provisioningand then${basedir}/src/test/provisioningis used (in case the former does not exist).This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:${basedir}/src/main/provisioning. |
| <modelPattern> | String | - | The model file name pattern to consider.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:((.*)\.txt\|(.*)\.model). |
| <usePomDependencies> | boolean | - | If set totrue, Artifact dependencies from provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved against the versions given in the Maven POM. The following sections in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:The project's artifact itselfThe project's dependenciesThe project's dependencyManagementDefault value is:false. |
| <usePomVariables> | boolean | - | If set totrue, properties from the Maven POM can be used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using this model do not have to resolve them themselves.Default value is:false. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--a.3CallowUnresolvedPomDependencies.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--allowUnresolvedPomDependencies"></a><allowUnresolvedPomDependencies>**

If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is
set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in
the Maven POM.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--a.3CdisableExtendingMavenClasspath.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--disableExtendingMavenClasspath"></a><disableExtendingMavenClasspath>**

If set to true the Maven classpath (either scope
"provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being
referenced in the model.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--a.3Cmodel.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--model"></a><model>**

Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any
model found in modelDirectory.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 1.3
- **Required**: No

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--a.3CmodelArchiveName.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelArchiveName"></a><modelArchiveName>**

The filename to be used for the generated model archive file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${project.build.finalName}

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--a.3CmodelDirectory.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelDirectory"></a><modelDirectory>**

The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter
is evaluated in the DependencyLifecycleParticipant. As
default first ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning and
then ${basedir}/src/test/provisioning is used (in case
the former does not exist).

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--a.3CmodelPattern.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelPattern"></a><modelPattern>**

The model file name pattern to consider.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ((.\*)\.txt|(.\*)\.model)

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--a.3CusePomDependencies.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--usePomDependencies"></a><usePomDependencies>**

If set to true, Artifact dependencies from
provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved
against the versions given in the Maven POM. The following sections
in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:

1. The project's artifact itself
2. The project's dependencies
3. The project's dependencyManagement

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--a.3CusePomVariables.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-attach-modelarchive-mojo--usePomVariables"></a><usePomVariables>**

If set to true, properties from the Maven POM can be
used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables
are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using
this model do not have to resolve them themselves.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

-Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

| <lineLength> | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – SlingStart Maven Plugin

# SlingStart Maven Plugin

Maven Plugin supporting Sling Launchpad.

See [The Apache Sling Provisioning Model and Apache SlingStart](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-slingstart) for a documentation about the provisioning model and the general SlingStart concepts.

See [Goals](#sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-plugin-info) for a list of supported goals.

provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-start-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – slingstart:start

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-start-mojo--slingstart:start"></a>slingstart:start

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.9.12:start

**Description**:

Start one or multiple launchpad instance(s).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): pre-integration-test.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-start-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <cleanWorkingDirectory> | boolean | - | Clean the working directory before start.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.clean.workdir. |
| <debug> | String | - | Overwrites debug parameter of all server configurations (if set). Attaches a debugger to the forked JVM. If set to"true", the process will allow a debugger to connect on port 8000. If set to some other string, that string will be appended to the server'svmOpts, allowing you to configure arbitrary debugging options.User property is:launchpad.debug. |
| <keepLaunchpadRunning> | boolean | - | Deprecated.UseAbstractStartStopMojo.blockUntilKeyIsPressedinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.keep.running. |
| <launchpadDependency> | Dependency | - | The launchpad jar as a dependency. This is only used if "launchpadJar" is not specified. |
| <launchpadJar> | File | - | The launchpad jar. This option has precedence over "launchpadDependency".User property is:launchpad.jar. |
| <launchpadReadyTimeOutSec> | int | - | Ready timeout in seconds. If the launchpad has not been started in this time, it's assumed that the startup failed.Default value is:600.User property is:launchpad.ready.timeout. |
| <parallelExecution> | boolean | - | Set the execution of launchpad instances to be run in parallel (threads)Default value is:true.User property is:launchpad.parallelExecution. |
| <servers> | List | - | Parameter containing the list of server configurations |
| <shouldBlockUntilKeyIsPressed> | boolean | - | Iftruethis mojo blocks until you press the Enter key. |
| <skipLaunchpad> | boolean | - | Set this to "true" to skip starting the launchpadDefault value is:false.User property is:maven.test.skip. |
| <systemPropertiesFile> | File | - | The system properties file will contain all started instances with their ports etc.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/launchpad-runner.properties. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-start-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-start-mojo--a.3CcleanWorkingDirectory.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-start-mojo--cleanWorkingDirectory"></a><cleanWorkingDirectory>**

- **User Property**: launchpad.debug

---

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-validate-mojo--htl:validate"></a>htl:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.0.6:validate

**Description**:

This goal validates Sightly scripts syntax.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): compile.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| excludes | String[] | - | List of files to exclude. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| failOnWarnings | boolean | - | If set to "true" it will fail the build on compiler warnings.Default value is:false.User property is:failOnWarnings. |
| includes | String[] | - | List of files to include. Specified as fileset patterns which are relative to the input directory whose contents will be scanned (see the sourceDirectory configuration option). |
| skip | boolean | - | If set to "true" the validation will be skipped.Default value is:false.User property is:htl.skip. |
| sourceDirectory | File | - | Defines the root folder where this Mojo expects to find Sightly scripts to validate.Default value is:${project.build.sourceDirectory}.User property is:sourceDirectory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-6-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-index"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-index--Apache_Sling_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

The Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin, M2Eclipse compatible, provides support for validating HTML Template Language scripts from projects during build time, reporting issues like:

- syntax errors;
- expression warnings (e.g. missing required display contexts, sensible attributes with dynamic values, etc.);
- incorrect usage of block elements.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-index--Goals"></a>Goals

The HTL Maven Plugin has only one goal:

- [htl:validate](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-validate-mojo) is bound to the compile phase and is used to validate HTL scripts.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-0-8-index--Usage"></a>Usage

General instructions on how to use the HTL Maven Plugin can be found on the usage page.

In case you still have questions regarding the plugin’s usage feel free to contact the Apache Sling Development List. The posts to the mailing list are archived and could already contain the answer to your question as part of an older thread. Hence, it is also worth browsing/searching the mail archive.

If you feel like the plugin is missing a feature or has a defect, you can fill a feature request or bug report in our issue tracker. When creating a new issue, please provide a comprehensive description of your concern. Especially for fixing bugs it is crucial that the developers can reproduce your problem. For this reason, entire debug logs, POMs or most preferably little demo projects attached to the issue are very much appreciated. Of course, patches are welcome, too. Contributors can check out the project from our source repository and will find supplementary information in the guide to helping with Maven.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-index"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-index--Apache_Sling_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

The Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin, M2Eclipse compatible, provides support for validating HTML Template Language scripts from projects during build time, reporting issues like:

- syntax errors;
- expression warnings (e.g. missing required display contexts, sensible attributes with dynamic values, etc.);
- incorrect usage of block elements.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-index--Goals"></a>Goals

The HTL Maven Plugin has only one goal:

- [htl:validate](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-validate-mojo) is bound to the compile phase and is used to validate HTL scripts.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-index--Usage"></a>Usage

General instructions on how to use the HTL Maven Plugin can be found on the [usage](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-0-usage) page.

In case you still have questions regarding the plugin’s usage feel free to contact the Apache Sling Development List. The posts to the mailing list are archived and could already contain the answer to your question as part of an older thread. Hence, it is also worth browsing/searching the mail archive.

If you feel like the plugin is missing a feature or has a defect, you can fill a feature request or bug report in our issue tracker. When creating a new issue, please provide a comprehensive description of your concern. Especially for fixing bugs it is crucial that the developers can reproduce your problem. For this reason, entire debug logs, POMs or most preferably little demo projects attached to the issue are very much appreciated. Of course, patches are welcome, too. Contributors can check out the project from our source repository and will find supplementary information in the guide to helping with Maven.

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-help-mojo--htl:help"></a>htl:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.1.2:help

**Description**:

Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.  
Call mvn htl:help -Ddetail=true
-Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| indentSize | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default value is:2.User property is:indentSize. |
| lineLength | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-index--Apache_Sling_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

The Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin, M2Eclipse compatible, provides support for validating HTML Template Language scripts from projects during build time, reporting issues like:

- syntax errors;
- expression warnings (e.g. missing required display contexts, sensible attributes with dynamic values, etc.);
- incorrect usage of block elements.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-index--Goals"></a>Goals

The HTL Maven Plugin has only one goal:

- [htl:validate](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-validate-mojo) is bound to the compile phase and is used to validate HTL scripts.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-index--Usage"></a>Usage

General instructions on how to use the HTL Maven Plugin can be found on the [usage](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-2-usage) page.

In case you still have questions regarding the plugin’s usage feel free to contact the Apache Sling Development List. The posts to the mailing list are archived and could already contain the answer to your question as part of an older thread. Hence, it is also worth browsing/searching the mail archive.

If you feel like the plugin is missing a feature or has a defect, you can fill a feature request or bug report in our issue tracker. When creating a new issue, please provide a comprehensive description of your concern. Especially for fixing bugs it is crucial that the developers can reproduce your problem. For this reason, entire debug logs, POMs or most preferably little demo projects attached to the issue are very much appreciated. Of course, patches are welcome, too. Contributors can check out the project from our source repository and will find supplementary information in the guide to helping with Maven.

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:help

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-help-mojo--htl:help"></a>htl:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.1.4-1.3.1:help

**Description**:

Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.  
Call mvn htl:help -Ddetail=true
-Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| detail | boolean | - | Iftrue, display all settable properties for each goal.Default value is:false.User property is:detail. |
| goal | String | - | The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.User property is:goal. |
| indentSize | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default value is:2.User property is:indentSize. |
| lineLength | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-help-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

If true, display all settable properties for each
goal.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: detail
- **Default**: false

The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all
goals will be displayed.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: goal

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-help-mojo--indentSize"></a>indentSize:**

- **Type**: int
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: indentSize
- **Default**: 2

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-help-mojo--lineLength"></a>lineLength:**

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-index"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-index--Apache_Sling_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

The Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin, M2Eclipse compatible, provides support for validating HTML Template Language scripts from projects during build time, reporting issues like:

- syntax errors;
- expression warnings (e.g. missing required display contexts, sensible attributes with dynamic values, etc.);
- incorrect usage of block elements.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-index--Goals"></a>Goals

The HTL Maven Plugin has only one goal:

- [htl:validate](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-validate-mojo) is bound to the compile phase and is used to validate HTL scripts.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-index--Usage"></a>Usage

General instructions on how to use the HTL Maven Plugin can be found on the [usage](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-4-1-3-1-usage) page.

In case you still have questions regarding the plugin’s usage feel free to contact the Apache Sling Development List. The posts to the mailing list are archived and could already contain the answer to your question as part of an older thread. Hence, it is also worth browsing/searching the mail archive.

If you feel like the plugin is missing a feature or has a defect, you can fill a feature request or bug report in our issue tracker. When creating a new issue, please provide a comprehensive description of your concern. Especially for fixing bugs it is crucial that the developers can reproduce your problem. For this reason, entire debug logs, POMs or most preferably little demo projects attached to the issue are very much appreciated. Of course, patches are welcome, too. Contributors can check out the project from our source repository and will find supplementary information in the guide to helping with Maven.

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:help

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-help-mojo--htl:help"></a>htl:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.1.6-1.4.0:help

**Description**:

Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.  
Call mvn htl:help -Ddetail=true
-Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| detail | boolean | - | Iftrue, display all settable properties for each goal.Default value is:false.User property is:detail. |
| goal | String | - | The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.User property is:goal. |
| indentSize | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default value is:2.User property is:indentSize. |
| lineLength | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-help-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

goal.

- **Type**: boolean

- **User Property**: detail

goals will be displayed.

- **Type**: java.lang.String

- **User Property**: goal

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-help-mojo--indentSize"></a>indentSize:**

- **User Property**: indentSize

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-index"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-index--Apache_Sling_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

The Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin, M2Eclipse compatible, provides support for validating HTML Template Language scripts from projects during build time, reporting issues like:

- syntax errors;
- expression warnings (e.g. missing required display contexts, sensible attributes with dynamic values, etc.);
- incorrect usage of block elements.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-index--Goals"></a>Goals

The HTL Maven Plugin has only one goal:

- [htl:validate](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-validate-mojo) is bound to the compile phase and is used to validate HTL scripts.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-index--Usage"></a>Usage

General instructions on how to use the HTL Maven Plugin can be found on the [usage](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-6-1-4-0-usage) page.

In case you still have questions regarding the plugin’s usage feel free to contact the Apache Sling Development List. The posts to the mailing list are archived and could already contain the answer to your question as part of an older thread. Hence, it is also worth browsing/searching the mail archive.

If you feel like the plugin is missing a feature or has a defect, you can fill a feature request or bug report in our issue tracker. When creating a new issue, please provide a comprehensive description of your concern. Especially for fixing bugs it is crucial that the developers can reproduce your problem. For this reason, entire debug logs, POMs or most preferably little demo projects attached to the issue are very much appreciated. Of course, patches are welcome, too. Contributors can check out the project from our source repository and will find supplementary information in the guide to helping with Maven.

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:help

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-help-mojo--htl:help"></a>htl:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.1.8-1.4.0:help

**Description**:

Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.  
Call mvn htl:help -Ddetail=true
-Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| detail | boolean | - | Iftrue, display all settable properties for each goal.Default value is:false.User property is:detail. |
| goal | String | - | The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.User property is:goal. |
| indentSize | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default value is:2.User property is:indentSize. |
| lineLength | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-help-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

If true, display all settable properties for each
goal.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: detail
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-help-mojo--goal"></a>goal:**

The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all
goals will be displayed.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: goal

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-help-mojo--indentSize"></a>indentSize:**

The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.

- **Type**: int
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: indentSize
- **Default**: 2

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-help-mojo--lineLength"></a>lineLength:**

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-index"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-index--Apache_Sling_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

The Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin, M2Eclipse compatible, provides support for validating HTML Template Language scripts from projects during build time, reporting issues like:

- syntax errors;
- expression warnings (e.g. missing required display contexts, sensible attributes with dynamic values, etc.);
- incorrect usage of block elements.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-index--Goals"></a>Goals

The HTL Maven Plugin has only one goal:

- [htl:validate](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-validate-mojo) is bound to the compile phase and is used to validate HTL scripts.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-index--Usage"></a>Usage

General instructions on how to use the HTL Maven Plugin can be found on the [usage](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-1-8-1-4-0-usage) page.

In case you still have questions regarding the plugin’s usage feel free to contact the Apache Sling Development List. The posts to the mailing list are archived and could already contain the answer to your question as part of an older thread. Hence, it is also worth browsing/searching the mail archive.

If you feel like the plugin is missing a feature or has a defect, you can fill a feature request or bug report in our issue tracker. When creating a new issue, please provide a comprehensive description of your concern. Especially for fixing bugs it is crucial that the developers can reproduce your problem. For this reason, entire debug logs, POMs or most preferably little demo projects attached to the issue are very much appreciated. Of course, patches are welcome, too. Contributors can check out the project from our source repository and will find supplementary information in the guide to helping with Maven.

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:help

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-help-mojo--htl:help"></a>htl:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.2.0-1.4.0:help

**Description**:

Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.  
Call mvn htl:help -Ddetail=true
-Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| detail | boolean | - | Iftrue, display all settable properties for each goal.Default value is:false.User property is:detail. |
| goal | String | - | The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.User property is:goal. |
| indentSize | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default value is:2.User property is:indentSize. |
| lineLength | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-help-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-index"></a>

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-index--Apache_Sling_HTL_Maven_Plugin"></a>Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin

The Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin, M2Eclipse compatible, provides support for validating HTML Template Language scripts from projects during build time, reporting issues like:

- syntax errors;
- expression warnings (e.g. missing required display contexts, sensible attributes with dynamic values, etc.);
- incorrect usage of block elements.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-index--Goals"></a>Goals

The HTL Maven Plugin has only one goal:

- [htl:validate](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-validate-mojo) is bound to the compile phase and is used to validate HTL scripts.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-index--Usage"></a>Usage

General instructions on how to use the HTL Maven Plugin can be found on the [usage](#sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-0-1-4-0-usage) page.

In case you still have questions regarding the plugin’s usage feel free to contact the Apache Sling Development List. The posts to the mailing list are archived and could already contain the answer to your question as part of an older thread. Hence, it is also worth browsing/searching the mail archive.

If you feel like the plugin is missing a feature or has a defect, you can fill a feature request or bug report in our issue tracker. When creating a new issue, please provide a comprehensive description of your concern. Especially for fixing bugs it is crucial that the developers can reproduce your problem. For this reason, entire debug logs, POMs or most preferably little demo projects attached to the issue are very much appreciated. Of course, patches are welcome, too. Contributors can check out the project from our source repository and will find supplementary information in the guide to helping with Maven.

# Apache Sling HTL Maven Plugin – htl:help

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-help-mojo--htl:help"></a>htl:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:htl-maven-plugin:1.2.2-1.4.0:help

**Description**:

Display help information on htl-maven-plugin.  
Call mvn htl:help -Ddetail=true
-Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| detail | boolean | - | Iftrue, display all settable properties for each goal.Default value is:false.User property is:detail. |
| goal | String | - | The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.User property is:goal. |
| indentSize | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default value is:2.User property is:indentSize. |
| lineLength | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-help-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-help-mojo--detail"></a>detail:**

If true, display all settable properties for each
goal.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: detail
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-help-mojo--goal"></a>goal:**

The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all
goals will be displayed.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: goal

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-help-mojo--indentSize"></a>indentSize:**

The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.

- **Type**: int
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: indentSize
- **Default**: 2

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-htl-maven-plugin-archives-htl-maven-plugin-1-2-2-1-4-0-help-mojo--lineLength"></a>lineLength:**

The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.

- **Type**: int
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: lineLength
- **Default**: 80
