| skip | boolean | - | Whether to skip the validation.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.skip. |
| skipJson | boolean | - | Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no difference betweenskipandskipJsonbecause only JSON files will be validated by now.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.skipJson. |

Whether to accept quote ticks in JSON files or not.

- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.validation.jsonQuoteTick
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-0-validate-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

Whether to skip the validation.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.validation.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-0-validate-mojo--skipJson"></a>skipJson:**

Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no
difference between skip and skipJson
because only JSON files will be validated by now.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.validation.skipJson
- **Default**: false

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.2:deploy-file

**Description**:

Deploy a JAR representing an OSGi Bundle to a Sling OSGi Bundle
Repository. This method posts the bundle referenced via

obr property.

| slingUrl | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bundleFileName | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:sling.file. |
| slingConsoleUrl | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| slingUrlSuffix | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

With multiple entries in the list different bundles with different preconditions can be defined.Default value is::<deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>   <bundlePrerequisite>     <bundles>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>         <version>2.1.8</version>       </bundle>     </bundles>     <preconditions>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.resourceresolver</artifactId>         <version>1.5.18</version>       </bundle>     </preconditions>   </bundlePrerequisite>   <bundlePrerequisite>     <bundles>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>         <version>1.4.8</version>       </bundle>     </bundles>   </bundlePrerequisite> </deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites> |
| deploymentMethod | BundleDeploymentMethod | 2.3.0 | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut.Default value is:WebConsole.User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| fileVaultFilterXmlFile | File | 2.2.0 | Path to META-INF/vault/filter.xml when using FileVault XML filesystem layout.User property is:sling.filevault.filterxml.file. |
| fileVaultJcrRootFile | File | 2.2.0 | FileVault filesystem layout content root folder.User property is:sling.filevault.jcr_root.file. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-fsmount-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-fsmount-mojo--bundleFileName"></a>bundleFileName:**

The name of the generated JAR file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.file
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-fsmount-mojo--deployFsResourceBundle"></a>deployFsResourceBundle:**

Deploy org.apache.sling.fsresource to Sling instance
bundle when it is not deployed already.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-fsmount-mojo--deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites"></a>deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites:**

Bundles that have to be installed as prerequisites to execute this
goal. With multiple entries in the list different bundles with
different preconditions can be defined.  
**Default value is:**:

```xml
<deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>
  <bundlePrerequisite>
    <bundles>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>
        <version>2.1.8</version>
      </bundle>
    </bundles>
    <preconditions>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.resourceresolver</artifactId>
        <version>1.5.18</version>
      </bundle>
    </preconditions>
  </bundlePrerequisite>
  <bundlePrerequisite>
    <bundles>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>
        <version>1.4.8</version>
      </bundle>
    </bundles>
  </bundlePrerequisite>
</deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>
```

- **Type**: java.util.List
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-fsmount-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a>deploymentMethod:**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below
   regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall
   goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method
- **Default**: WebConsole

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-fsmount-mojo--failOnError"></a>failOnError:**

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.filevault.filterxml.file

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:generate-adapter-metadata

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--sling:generate-adapter-metadata"></a>sling:generate-adapter-metadata

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.2:generate-adapter-metadata

**Description**:

Build [adapter
metadata (JSON)](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/the-sling-engine/adapters.html) for the Web Console Plugin at
/system/console/status-adapters and
/system/console/adapters from classes annotated with
[adapter
annotations](http://svn.apache.org/viewvc/sling/trunk/tooling/maven/adapter-annotations/).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: compile.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): process-classes.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fileName | String | - | Name of the generated descriptor file.Default value is:SLING-INF/adapters.json.User property is:adapter.descriptor.name. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--fileName"></a>fileName:**

Name of the generated descriptor file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: adapter.descriptor.name
- **Default**: SLING-INF/adapters.json

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-help-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:help

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-help-mojo--sling:help"></a>sling:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.2:help

**Description**:

Display help information on maven-sling-plugin.  
Call mvn sling:help -Ddetail=true
-Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| detail | boolean | - | Iftrue, display all settable properties for each goal.Default value is:false.User property is:detail. |
| goal | String | - | The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.User property is:goal. |
| indentSize | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default value is:2.User property is:indentSize. |
| lineLength | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – Maven Sling Plugin

# Maven Sling Plugin

The Maven Sling Plugin provides a number of goals which may be of help while developing bundles for Sling. To run the plugin you need at least Maven 3.x and JDK 1.7 or higher.

See [Goals](#sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-plugin-info) for a list of supported goals.

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-install-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:install

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-install-mojo--sling:install"></a>sling:install

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.2:install

**Description**:

Install an OSGi bundle to a running Sling instance. The plugin
places an HTTP POST request to [Felix
Web Console](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests). It's also possible to HTTP PUT instead of POST
leveraging the [WebDAV
bundle from Sling](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/development/repository-based-development.html). Since version 2.1.8 you can also leverage
the the [Sling
POST servlet](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/bundles/manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post.html) for that The chosen method depends on the
parameter deploymentMethod.   

**Intermediate Node Creation**

For all deploymentMethods except WebDAV the bundle
is not directly deployed within the OSGi container, but rather
being uploaded to the JCR and from there on being picked up by the
[JCR
Installer Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-jcr-installer-provider) asynchronously, which takes care of
deploying it in the OSGi container. For both other deployment
methods, intermediate nodes (i.e. inexisting parent nodes) are
automatically created. The primary type of those intermediate nodes
depend on the deployment method.

- WebDAV, uses the configured collection node type, by default
  sling:Folder (see also [WebDAV
  Configuration](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development))
- SlingPostServlet, uses internally
  ResourceResolverFactory.create(...) without setting
  any jcr:primaryType. Therefore the
  JcrResourceProviderFactory will call
  Node.addNode(String relPath) which determines a
  fitting node type automatically, depending on the parents node type
  definition (see [Javadoc](http://www.day.com/specs/jsr170/javadocs/jcr-2.0/javax/jcr/Node.html#addNode%28java.lang.String%29)).
  So in most of the cases this should be a sling:Folder,
  as this is the first allowed child node definition in
  sling:Folder. This only may differ, if your existing
  parent node is not of type sling:Folder itself.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): install.

Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource).

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.mountByFS
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-install-mojo--password"></a>password:**

The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.password
- **Default**: admin

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-install-mojo--refreshPackages"></a>refreshPackages:**

Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded
bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.refreshPackages
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-install-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

Whether to skip this step even though it has been configured in the
project to be executed. This property may be set by the
sling.install.skip comparable to the
maven.test.skip property to prevent running the unit
tests.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.install.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-install-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a>slingConsoleUrl:**

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required
for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of
slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.console.url

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-install-mojo--slingUrl"></a>slingUrl:**

The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful
for **WebConsole** deployment.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.url
- **Default**: http://localhost:8080/system/console

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-install-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a>slingUrlSuffix:**

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the
sling.url for use as the real target url. This allows
to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the
same common sling.url in a parent POM (eg.
sling.url=http://localhost:8080 and
sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is
typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet
deployment methods.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.urlSuffix

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-install-mojo--usePut"></a>usePut:**

**Deprecated.** Use deploymentMethod instead.

If a PUT via WebDAV should be used instead of the standard POST to
the Felix Web Console. In the uninstall goal, a HTTP
DELETE will be used.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.usePut
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-install-mojo--user"></a>user:**

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.user
- **Default**: admin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:uninstall

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--sling:uninstall"></a>sling:uninstall

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.2:uninstall

**Description**:

Uninstall an OSGi bundle from a running Sling instance. The plugin
places by default an HTTP POST request to [Felix
Web Console](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) to uninstall the bundle. It's also possible to use
HTTP DELETE leveraging the [WebDAV
bundle from Sling](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/development/repository-based-development.html). or the [Sling
POST servlet](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/bundles/manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post.html) to uninstall the bundle. The chosen method depends
on the parameter deploymentMethod.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bundleStart | boolean | - | Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.bundle.start. |
| bundleStartLevel | String | - | The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default value is:20.User property is:sling.bundle.startlevel. |
| failOnError | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| mimeType | String | - | The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.Default value is:application/java-archive.User property is:sling.mimeType. |
| mountByFS | boolean | - | Whether to add the mapping for theApache Sling File System Resource Provider.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.mountByFS. |
| password | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| refreshPackages | boolean | - | Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.refreshPackages. |
| slingUrl | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| user | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bundleFileName | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar.User property is:sling.file. |
| deploymentMethod | BundleDeploymentMethod | - | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut.User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| slingConsoleUrl | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| slingUrlSuffix | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |
| usePut | boolean | - | Deprecated.UsedeploymentMethodinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.usePut. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--bundleFileName"></a>bundleFileName:**

The name of the generated JAR file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.file
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--bundleStart"></a>bundleStart:**

Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when
POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.start
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a>bundleStartLevel:**

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is
already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is
ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling
instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually).
Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.startlevel
- **Default**: 20

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a>deploymentMethod:**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below
   regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall
   goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--failOnError"></a>failOnError:**

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--mimeType"></a>mimeType:**

The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST
deployment.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.mimeType
- **Default**: application/java-archive

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--mountByFS"></a>mountByFS:**

Whether to add the mapping for the [Apache
Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource).

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.mountByFS
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--password"></a>password:**

The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.password
- **Default**: admin

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--refreshPackages"></a>refreshPackages:**

Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded
bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean

- **User Property**: sling.refreshPackages
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a>slingConsoleUrl:**

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required

- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.console.url

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--slingUrl"></a>slingUrl:**

The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful
for **WebConsole** deployment.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.url
- **Default**: http://localhost:8080/system/console

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a>slingUrlSuffix:**

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-uninstall-mojo--user"></a>user:**

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-validate-mojo--sling:validate"></a>sling:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.2:validate

**Description**:

The validate goal checks the JSON code of a bundle.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): process-resources.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-validate-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| skip | boolean | - | Whether to skip the validation.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.skip. |
| skipJson | boolean | - | Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no difference betweenskipandskipJsonbecause only JSON files will be validated by now.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.skipJson. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| jsonQuoteTick | boolean | - | Whether to accept quote ticks in JSON files or not.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.jsonQuoteTick. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-validate-mojo--jsonQuoteTick"></a>jsonQuoteTick:**

Whether to accept quote ticks in JSON files or not.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.validation.jsonQuoteTick
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-validate-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

Whether to skip the validation.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.validation.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-2-validate-mojo--skipJson"></a>skipJson:**

Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no
difference between skip and skipJson
because only JSON files will be validated by now.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.validation.skipJson
- **Default**: false

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.4:deploy-file

**Description**:

Deploy a JAR representing an OSGi Bundle to a Sling OSGi Bundle
Repository. This method posts the bundle referenced via
sling.file to an OSGi Bundle Repository accepting the
bundle. The plugin uses a *multipart/format-data* POST
request to just post the file to the URL configured in the
obr property.

**Attributes**:

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-deploy-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| failOnError | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| obr | String | - | The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is posted, e.g.http://obr.sample.comUser property is:obr. |
| password | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| slingUrl | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| user | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-deploy-file-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bundleFileName | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:sling.file. |
| slingConsoleUrl | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| slingUrlSuffix | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:deploy

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-deploy-mojo--sling:deploy"></a>sling:deploy

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.4:deploy

**Description**:

Deploy a JAR representing an OSGi Bundle to a Sling OSGi Bundle
Repository. This method posts the bundle built by maven to the OSGi
Bundle Repository. The plugin uses a *multipart/format-data*
POST request to just post the file to the URL configured in the
obr property.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): deploy.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-deploy-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| jarName | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:project.build.finalName. |
| obr | String | - | The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is posted, e.g.http://obr.sample.comUser property is:obr. |
| password | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| skip | boolean | - | Whether to skip this step even though it has been configured in the project to be executed. This property may be set by thesling.deploy.skipcomparable to themaven.test.skipproperty to prevent running the unit tests.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.deploy.skip. |
| slingUrl | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| user | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-deploy-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| slingUrlSuffix | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:fsmount

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--sling:fsmount"></a>sling:fsmount

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.4:fsmount

**Description**:

Creates OSGi configurations for the [Apache
Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Since version: 2.2.0.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bundleFileName | String | 2.2.0 | The name of the generated JAR file.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar.User property is:sling.file. |
| failOnError | boolean | 2.2.0 | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| password | String | 2.2.0 | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| slingUrl | String | 2.2.0 | The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| user | String | 2.2.0 | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| deployFsResourceBundle | boolean | 2.3.0 | Deployorg.apache.sling.fsresourceto Sling instance bundle when it is not deployed already.Default value is:true. |
| deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites | List | 2.3.0 | Bundles that have to be installed as prerequisites to execute this goal. With multiple entries in the list different bundles with different preconditions can be defined.Default value is::<deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>   <bundlePrerequisite>     <bundles>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>         <version>2.1.8</version>       </bundle>     </bundles>     <preconditions>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.resourceresolver</artifactId>         <version>1.5.18</version>       </bundle>     </preconditions>   </bundlePrerequisite>   <bundlePrerequisite>     <bundles>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>         <version>1.4.8</version>       </bundle>     </bundles>   </bundlePrerequisite> </deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites> |
| deploymentMethod | BundleDeploymentMethod | 2.3.0 | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut.Default value is:WebConsole.User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| fileVaultFilterXmlFile | File | 2.2.0 | Path to META-INF/vault/filter.xml when using FileVault XML filesystem layout.User property is:sling.filevault.filterxml.file. |
| fileVaultJcrRootFile | File | 2.2.0 | FileVault filesystem layout content root folder.User property is:sling.filevault.jcr_root.file. |
| slingConsoleUrl | String | 2.2.0 | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| slingUrlSuffix | String | 2.2.0 | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--bundleFileName"></a>bundleFileName:**

The name of the generated JAR file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.file
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--deployFsResourceBundle"></a>deployFsResourceBundle:**

Deploy org.apache.sling.fsresource to Sling instance
bundle when it is not deployed already.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites"></a>deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites:**

Bundles that have to be installed as prerequisites to execute this
goal. With multiple entries in the list different bundles with
different preconditions can be defined.  
**Default value is:**:

```xml
<deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>
  <bundlePrerequisite>
    <bundles>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>
        <version>2.1.8</version>
      </bundle>
    </bundles>
    <preconditions>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.resourceresolver</artifactId>
        <version>1.5.18</version>
      </bundle>
    </preconditions>
  </bundlePrerequisite>
  <bundlePrerequisite>
    <bundles>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>
        <version>1.4.8</version>
      </bundle>
    </bundles>
  </bundlePrerequisite>
</deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>
```

- **Type**: java.util.List
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a>deploymentMethod:**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below
   regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall
   goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method
- **Default**: WebConsole

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--failOnError"></a>failOnError:**

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--fileVaultFilterXmlFile"></a>fileVaultFilterXmlFile:**

Path to META-INF/vault/filter.xml when using FileVault XML
filesystem layout.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.filevault.filterxml.file

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--fileVaultJcrRootFile"></a>fileVaultJcrRootFile:**

FileVault filesystem layout content root folder.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.filevault.jcr\_root.file

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-fsmount-mojo--password"></a>password:**

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:generate-adapter-metadata

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--sling:generate-adapter-metadata"></a>sling:generate-adapter-metadata

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.4:generate-adapter-metadata

**Description**:

Build [adapter
metadata (JSON)](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/the-sling-engine/adapters.html) for the Web Console Plugin at
/system/console/status-adapters and
/system/console/adapters from classes annotated with
[adapter
annotations](http://svn.apache.org/viewvc/sling/trunk/tooling/maven/adapter-annotations/).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: compile.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): process-classes.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fileName | String | - | Name of the generated descriptor file.Default value is:SLING-INF/adapters.json.User property is:adapter.descriptor.name. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

Name of the generated descriptor file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: adapter.descriptor.name
- **Default**: SLING-INF/adapters.json

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – Maven Sling Plugin

# Maven Sling Plugin

The Maven Sling Plugin provides a number of goals which may be of help while developing bundles for Sling. To run the plugin you need at least Maven 3.x and JDK 1.7 or higher.

See [Goals](#sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-plugin-info) for a list of supported goals.

---

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:install-file

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--sling:install-file"></a>sling:install-file

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.4:install-file

**Description**:

Install an OSGi bundle to a running Sling instance.

**Attributes**:

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bundleStart | boolean | - | Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.bundle.start. |
| bundleStartLevel | String | - | The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default value is:20.User property is:sling.bundle.startlevel. |
| failOnError | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| mimeType | String | - | The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.Default value is:application/java-archive.User property is:sling.mimeType. |
| mountByFS | boolean | - | Whether to add the mapping for theApache Sling File System Resource Provider.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.mountByFS. |
| password | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| refreshPackages | boolean | - | Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.refreshPackages. |
| slingUrl | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| user | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| artifact | String | - | A string of the form groupId:artifactId:version[:packaging[:classifier]].User property is:sling.artifact. |
| artifactId | String | - | The artifactId of the artifact to installUser property is:sling.artifactId. |
| bundleFileName | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:sling.file. |
| classifier | String | - | The classifier of the artifact to installUser property is:sling.classifier. |
| deploymentMethod | BundleDeploymentMethod | - | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut.User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| groupId | String | - | The groupId of the artifact to installUser property is:sling.groupId. |
| packaging | String | - | The packaging of the artifact to installDefault value is:jar.User property is:sling.packaging. |
| repositoryId | String | - | The id of the repository from which we'll download the artifactDefault value is:temp.User property is:sling.repoId. |
| repositoryUrl | String | - | The url of the repository from which we'll download the artifactUser property is:sling.repoUrl. |
| slingConsoleUrl | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| slingUrlSuffix | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |
| usePut | boolean | - | Deprecated.UsedeploymentMethodinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.usePut. |
| version | String | - | The version of the artifact to installUser property is:sling.version. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

A string of the form
groupId:artifactId:version[:packaging[:classifier]].

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.artifact

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--artifactId"></a>artifactId:**

The artifactId of the artifact to install

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.artifactId

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--bundleFileName"></a>bundleFileName:**

The name of the generated JAR file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.file

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--bundleStart"></a>bundleStart:**

Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when
POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.start
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a>bundleStartLevel:**

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is
already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is
ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling
instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually).
Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.startlevel
- **Default**: 20

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--classifier"></a>classifier:**

The classifier of the artifact to install

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.classifier

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a>deploymentMethod:**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below
   regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall
   goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-file-mojo--failOnError"></a>failOnError:**

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:install

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--sling:install"></a>sling:install

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.4:install

**Description**:

Install an OSGi bundle to a running Sling instance. The plugin
places an HTTP POST request to [Felix
Web Console](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests). It's also possible to HTTP PUT instead of POST
leveraging the [WebDAV
bundle from Sling](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/development/repository-based-development.html). Since version 2.1.8 you can also leverage
the the [Sling
POST servlet](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/bundles/manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post.html) for that The chosen method depends on the
parameter deploymentMethod.   

**Intermediate Node Creation**

For all deploymentMethods except WebDAV the bundle
is not directly deployed within the OSGi container, but rather
being uploaded to the JCR and from there on being picked up by the
[JCR
Installer Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-jcr-installer-provider) asynchronously, which takes care of
deploying it in the OSGi container. For both other deployment
methods, intermediate nodes (i.e. inexisting parent nodes) are
automatically created. The primary type of those intermediate nodes
depend on the deployment method.

- WebDAV, uses the configured collection node type, by default
  sling:Folder (see also [WebDAV
  Configuration](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development))
- SlingPostServlet, uses internally
  ResourceResolverFactory.create(...) without setting
  any jcr:primaryType. Therefore the
  JcrResourceProviderFactory will call
  Node.addNode(String relPath) which determines a
  fitting node type automatically, depending on the parents node type
  definition (see [Javadoc](http://www.day.com/specs/jsr170/javadocs/jcr-2.0/javax/jcr/Node.html#addNode%28java.lang.String%29)).
  So in most of the cases this should be a sling:Folder,
  as this is the first allowed child node definition in
  sling:Folder. This only may differ, if your existing
  parent node is not of type sling:Folder itself.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): install.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--bundleFileName"></a>bundleFileName:**

The name of the generated JAR file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.file
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--bundleStart"></a>bundleStart:**

Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when
POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.start
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a>bundleStartLevel:**

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is
already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is
ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling
instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually).
Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.startlevel
- **Default**: 20

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a>deploymentMethod:**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below
   regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall
   goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--failOnError"></a>failOnError:**

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--mimeType"></a>mimeType:**

The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST
deployment.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.mimeType
- **Default**: application/java-archive

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--mountByFS"></a>mountByFS:**

Whether to add the mapping for the [Apache
Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource).

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.mountByFS
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--password"></a>password:**

The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.password
- **Default**: admin

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--refreshPackages"></a>refreshPackages:**

Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded
bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.refreshPackages
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

Whether to skip this step even though it has been configured in the
project to be executed. This property may be set by the
sling.install.skip comparable to the
maven.test.skip property to prevent running the unit
tests.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.install.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a>slingConsoleUrl:**

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required
for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of
slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.console.url

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--slingUrl"></a>slingUrl:**

The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful
for **WebConsole** deployment.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.url
- **Default**: http://localhost:8080/system/console

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a>slingUrlSuffix:**

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the
sling.url for use as the real target url. This allows
to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the
same common sling.url in a parent POM (eg.
sling.url=http://localhost:8080 and
sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is
typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet
deployment methods.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.urlSuffix

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--usePut"></a>usePut:**

**Deprecated.** Use deploymentMethod instead.

If a PUT via WebDAV should be used instead of the standard POST to
the Felix Web Console. In the uninstall goal, a HTTP
DELETE will be used.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.usePut
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-install-mojo--user"></a>user:**

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.user
- **Default**: admin

# Apache Sling Maven Sling Plugin – sling:uninstall

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--sling:uninstall"></a>sling:uninstall

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.4:uninstall

**Description**:

Uninstall an OSGi bundle from a running Sling instance. The plugin
places by default an HTTP POST request to [Felix
Web Console](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) to uninstall the bundle. It's also possible to use
HTTP DELETE leveraging the [WebDAV
bundle from Sling](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/development/repository-based-development.html). or the [Sling
POST servlet](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/bundles/manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post.html) to uninstall the bundle. The chosen method depends
on the parameter deploymentMethod.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.

The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default value is:20.User property is:sling.bundle.startlevel. |

- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.file
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--bundleStart"></a>bundleStart:**

Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when
POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.start
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a>bundleStartLevel:**

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is
already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is
ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling
instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually).
Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.startlevel
- **Default**: 20

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a>deploymentMethod:**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below
   regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall
   goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--failOnError"></a>failOnError:**

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--mimeType"></a>mimeType:**

The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST
deployment.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.mimeType
- **Default**: application/java-archive

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--mountByFS"></a>mountByFS:**

Whether to add the mapping for the [Apache
Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource).

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.mountByFS
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--password"></a>password:**

The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.password
- **Default**: admin

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--refreshPackages"></a>refreshPackages:**

Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded
bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.refreshPackages
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a>slingConsoleUrl:**

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required
for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of
slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.console.url

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--slingUrl"></a>slingUrl:**

The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful
for **WebConsole** deployment.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.url
- **Default**: http://localhost:8080/system/console

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a>slingUrlSuffix:**

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the
sling.url for use as the real target url. This allows
to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the
same common sling.url in a parent POM (eg.
sling.url=http://localhost:8080 and
sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is
typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet
deployment methods.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.urlSuffix

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--usePut"></a>usePut:**

**Deprecated.** Use deploymentMethod instead.

If a PUT via WebDAV should be used instead of the standard POST to
the Felix Web Console. In the uninstall goal, a HTTP
DELETE will be used.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.usePut
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-uninstall-mojo--user"></a>user:**

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.user
- **Default**: admin

---

- **Required**: No

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-validate-mojo--skip"></a>skip:**

Whether to skip the validation.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.validation.skip
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-4-validate-mojo--skipJson"></a>skipJson:**

Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:maven-sling-plugin:2.3.8:deploy-file

**Description**:

Deploy a JAR representing an OSGi Bundle to a Sling OSGi Bundle
Repository. This method posts the bundle referenced via
sling.file to an OSGi Bundle Repository accepting the
bundle. The plugin uses a *multipart/format-data* POST
request to just post the file to the URL configured in the
obr property.

**Attributes**:

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-8-deploy-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| failOnError | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| obr | String | - | The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is posted, e.g.http://obr.sample.comUser property is:obr. |
| password | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| slingUrl | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance. The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| user | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-maven-sling-plugin-archives-maven-sling-plugin-2-3-8-deploy-file-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bundleFileName | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:sling.file. |
| slingConsoleUrl | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| slingUrlSuffix | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |
