| <outputDirectory> | File | - | The directory in which the features are launched (below its child directorylaunchers/<launch-id>).Default value is:${project.build.directory}.User property is:outputDir. |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-help-mojo--feature-launcher.3Ahelp"></a>

# feature-launcher:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:feature-launcher-maven-plugin:1.0.2:help

**Description**:

Display help information on feature-launcher-maven-plugin.
  
Call `mvn feature-launcher:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>` to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

## Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <detail> | boolean | - | Iftrue, display all settable properties for each goal.Default:falseUser Property:detail |
| <goal> | String | - | The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.User Property:goal |
| <indentSize> | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default:2User Property:indentSize |
| <lineLength> | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default:80User Property:lineLength |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo"></a>

# feature-launcher:start – Apache Sling Feature Launcher Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--feature-launcher.3Astart"></a>

# feature-launcher:start

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:feature-launcher-maven-plugin:1.0.2:start

**Description**:

Start one or multiple [Sling Feature(s)](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-feature-model).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](https://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `pre-integration-test`.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>

## Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <featureLauncherVersion> | String | - | The version of theSling Feature Launcherto use.Default:1.3.4 |
| <launches> | List<Launch> | - | List ofLaunchobjects to start. Each is having the following format:<id>...</id><!-- the id of the launch, must be unique within the list, is mandatory--><feature>...</feature><!-- the Maven coordinates of the feature model, mandatory unless featureFile is used  --><featureFile>...</featureFile><!-- the path to the feature model, mandatory unless feature is used --><launcherArguments><!-- additional arguments to pass to the launcher --><frameworkProperties><org.osgi.service.http.port>8090</org.osgi.service.http.port></framweworkProperties>..</launcherArguments><repositoryUrls><repositoryUrl>file://.../artifacts</repositoryUrl><repositoryUrl>https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/</repositoryUrl></repositoryUrls><environmentVariables><!--additional environment variables to pass to the launcher --><JAVA_HOME>...</JAVA_HOME></environmentVariables>If no repository URLs are configured the following defaults are used, in order:The local Maven repositoryThe Maven Central repositoryThe Apache Snapshots repository |
| <outputDirectory> | File | - | The directory in which the features are launched (below its child directorylaunchers/<launch-id>).Default:${project.build.directory}User Property:outputDir |
| <trackProcess> | boolean | - | Whether to track the Sling instance process and forcibly stop it when the build ends, when it was not stopped properly.Default:true |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>

## Parameter Details

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--featureLauncherVersion"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--a.3CfeatureLauncherVersion.3E"></a>

### <featureLauncherVersion>

The version of the [Sling Feature Launcher](https://github.com/apache/sling-org-apache-sling-feature-launcher) to use.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **Default**: `1.3.4`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--launches"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--a.3Claunches.3E"></a>

### <launches>

List of [`Launch`](apidocs/org/apache/sling/maven/feature/launcher/Launch.html) objects to start. Each is having the following format:

```text

```

If no repository URLs are configured the following defaults are used, in order:

- The local Maven repository
- The Maven Central repository
- The Apache Snapshots repository

- **Type**: [`java.util.List<org.apache.sling.maven.feature.launcher.Launch>`](apidocs/org/apache/sling/maven/feature/launcher/Launch.html)
- **Required**: `Yes`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--outputDirectory"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--a.3CoutputDirectory.3E"></a>

### <outputDirectory>

The directory in which the features are launched (below its child directory `launchers/<launch-id>`).

- **Type**: `java.io.File`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **User Property**: `outputDir`
- **Default**: `${project.build.directory}`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--trackProcess"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-2-start-mojo--a.3CtrackProcess.3E"></a>

### <trackProcess>

Whether to track the Sling instance process and forcibly stop it when the build ends, when it was not stopped properly.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **Default**: `true`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-4-help-mojo--feature-launcher.3Ahelp"></a>

# feature-launcher:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:feature-launcher-maven-plugin:1.0.4:help

**Description**:

Display help information on feature-launcher-maven-plugin.
  
Call `mvn feature-launcher:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>` to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-4-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

## Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <detail> | boolean | - | Iftrue, display all settable properties for each goal.Default:falseUser Property:detail |
| <goal> | String | - | The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.User Property:goal |
| <indentSize> | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default:2User Property:indentSize |
| <lineLength> | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default:80User Property:lineLength |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-4-start-mojo"></a>

# feature-launcher:start – Apache Sling Feature Launcher Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-4-start-mojo--feature-launcher.3Astart"></a>

# feature-launcher:start

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:feature-launcher-maven-plugin:1.0.4:start

**Description**:

Start one or multiple [Sling Feature(s)](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-feature-model).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](https://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `pre-integration-test`.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-4-start-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>

## Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <attachedArtifactsDirectory> | File | - | Directory to temporarily store attached artifacts of the current build in to pass them over to the launcher.Default:${project.build.directory}/featureLauncherAttachedArtifactsUser Property:attachedArtifactsDirectory |
| <featureLauncherVersion> | String | - | The version of theSling Feature Launcherto use.Default:1.3.4 |
| <launches> | List<Launch> | - | List ofLaunchobjects to start. Each is having the following format:<id>...</id><!-- the id of the launch, must be unique within the list, is mandatory--><feature>...</feature><!-- the Maven coordinates of the feature model, mandatory unless featureFile is used  --><featureFile>...</featureFile><!-- the path to the feature model, mandatory unless feature is used --><launcherArguments><!-- additional arguments to pass to the launcher --><frameworkProperties><org.osgi.service.http.port>8090</org.osgi.service.http.port></framweworkProperties>..</launcherArguments><repositoryUrls><repositoryUrl>file://.../artifacts</repositoryUrl><repositoryUrl>https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/</repositoryUrl></repositoryUrls><environmentVariables><!--additional environment variables to pass to the launcher --><JAVA_HOME>...</JAVA_HOME></environmentVariables>If no repository URLs are configured the following defaults are used, in order:The local Maven repositoryThe Maven Central repositoryThe Apache Snapshots repository |
| <outputDirectory> | File | - | The directory in which the features are launched (below its child directorylaunchers/<launch-id>).Default:${project.build.directory}User Property:outputDir |
| <trackProcess> | boolean | - | Whether to track the Sling instance process and forcibly stop it when the build ends, when it was not stopped properly.Default:true |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-archives-sling-feature-launcher-maven-plugin-1-0-4-start-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>

## Parameter Details

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:deploy-file

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--sling:deploy-file"></a>sling:deploy-file

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.0:deploy-file

**Description**:

Deploy a JAR representing an OSGi Bundle to a Sling OSGi Bundle
Repository. This method posts the bundle referenced via
sling.file to an OSGi Bundle Repository accepting the
bundle. The plugin uses a *multipart/format-data* POST
request to just post the file to the URL configured in the
obr property.

**Attributes**:

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <obr> | String | - | The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is posted, e.g.http://obr.sample.comUser property is:obr. |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <slingUrl> | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleFileName> | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:sling.file. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--a.3CbundleFileName.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--bundleFileName"></a><bundleFileName>**

The name of the generated JAR file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.file

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--a.3CfailOnError.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--failOnError"></a><failOnError>**

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--a.3Cobr.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--obr"></a><obr>**

The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is
posted, e.g. http://obr.sample.com

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: obr

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--a.3Cpassword.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--password"></a><password>**

The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.password
- **Default**: admin

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a><slingConsoleUrl>**

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required
for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of
slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.console.url

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-file-mojo--slingUrl"></a><slingUrl>**

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole**
deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to
include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install).
Omitting the dav/default segment can lead to conflicts
with other servlets.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.url
- **Default**: http://localhost:8080/system/console

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:deploy

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-mojo--sling:deploy"></a>sling:deploy

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.0:deploy

**Description**:

Deploy a JAR representing an OSGi Bundle to a Sling OSGi Bundle
Repository. This method posts the bundle built by maven to the OSGi
Bundle Repository. The plugin uses a *multipart/format-data*
POST request to just post the file to the URL configured in the
obr property.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): deploy.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <jarName> | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:project.build.finalName.Alias is:jarName. |
| <obr> | String | - | The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is posted, e.g.http://obr.sample.comUser property is:obr. |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <skip> | boolean | - | Whether to skip this step even though it has been configured in the project to be executed. This property may be set by thesling.deploy.skipcomparable to themaven.test.skipproperty to prevent running the unit tests.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.deploy.skip. |
| <slingUrl> | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-deploy-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:fsmount

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsmount-mojo--sling:fsmount"></a>sling:fsmount

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.0:fsmount

**Description**:

Creates OSGi configurations for the [Apache
Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Since version: 2.2.0.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsmount-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| <failOnError> | boolean | 2.2.0 | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <password> | String | 2.2.0 | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <skip> | boolean | 2.2.0 | If set totrueSling File System Resource mount/unmount commands are ignored.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.fsmount.skip. |
| <slingUrl> | String | 2.2.0 | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| <user> | String | 2.2.0 | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| <deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites> | List | 2.3.0 | Bundles that have to be installed as prerequisites to execute this goal. With multiple entries in the list different bundles with different preconditions can be defined.Default value is::<deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>   <bundlePrerequisite>     <bundles>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>         <version>2.1.14</version>       </bundle>     </bundles>     <preconditions>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.resourceresolver</artifactId>         <version>1.5.18</version>       </bundle>     </preconditions>   </bundlePrerequisite>   <bundlePrerequisite>     <bundles>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>         <version>1.4.8</version>       </bundle>     </bundles>   </bundlePrerequisite> </deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites> |
| <deploymentMethod> | BundleDeploymentMethod | 2.3.0 | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut.Default value is:WebConsole.User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| <fileVaultFilterXmlFile> | File | 2.2.0 | Path to META-INF/vault/filter.xml when using FileVault XML filesystem layout.User property is:sling.filevault.filterxml.file. |
| <fileVaultJcrRootFile> | File | 2.2.0 | FileVault filesystem layout content root folder.User property is:sling.filevault.jcr_root.file. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | String | 2.2.0 | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | 2.2.0 | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsmount-mojo--a.3CdeployFsResourceBundle.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsmount-mojo--deployFsResourceBundle"></a><deployFsResourceBundle>**

Deploy org.apache.sling.fsresource to Sling instance
bundle when it is not deployed already.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: true

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsmount-mojo--a.3CdeployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsmount-mojo--deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites"></a><deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>**

Bundles that have to be installed as prerequisites to execute this
goal. With multiple entries in the list different bundles with
different preconditions can be defined.  
**Default value is:**:

```xml
<deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>
  <bundlePrerequisite>
    <bundles>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>
        <version>2.1.14</version>
      </bundle>
    </bundles>
    <preconditions>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.resourceresolver</artifactId>
        <version>1.5.18</version>
      </bundle>
    </preconditions>
  </bundlePrerequisite>
  <bundlePrerequisite>
    <bundles>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>
        <version>1.4.8</version>
      </bundle>
    </bundles>
  </bundlePrerequisite>
</deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>
```

- **Type**: java.util.List
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsmount-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsmount-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a><deploymentMethod>**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below
   regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall
   goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method
- **Default**: WebConsole

---

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:fsunmount

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--sling:fsunmount"></a>sling:fsunmount

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.0:fsunmount

**Description**:

Removes OSGi configurations for the [Apache
Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Since version: 2.2.0.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleFileName> | String | 2.2.0 | The name of the generated JAR file.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar.User property is:sling.file. |
| <failOnError> | boolean | 2.2.0 | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <password> | String | 2.2.0 | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <skip> | boolean | 2.2.0 | If set totrueSling File System Resource mount/unmount commands are ignored.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.fsmount.skip. |
| <slingUrl> | String | 2.2.0 | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| <user> | String | 2.2.0 | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <fileVaultFilterXmlFile> | File | 2.2.0 | Path to META-INF/vault/filter.xml when using FileVault XML filesystem layout.User property is:sling.filevault.filterxml.file. |
| <fileVaultJcrRootFile> | File | 2.2.0 | FileVault filesystem layout content root folder.User property is:sling.filevault.jcr_root.file. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | String | 2.2.0 | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | 2.2.0 | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a><slingConsoleUrl>**

- **Since**: 2.2.0

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--slingUrl"></a><slingUrl>**

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole**
deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to
include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install).
Omitting the dav/default segment can lead to conflicts
with other servlets.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.url
- **Default**: http://localhost:8080/system/console

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--a.3CslingUrlSuffix.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a><slingUrlSuffix>**

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the
sling.url for use as the real target url. This allows
to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the
same common sling.url in a parent POM (eg.
sling.url=http://localhost:8080 and
sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is
typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet
deployment methods.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.urlSuffix

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--a.3Cuser.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-fsunmount-mojo--user"></a><user>**

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.user
- **Default**: admin

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:generate-adapter-metadata

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--sling:generate-adapter-metadata"></a>sling:generate-adapter-metadata

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.0:generate-adapter-metadata

**Description**:

Build [adapter
metadata (JSON)](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/the-sling-engine/adapters.html) for the Web Console Plugin at
/system/console/status-adapters and
/system/console/adapters from classes annotated with
[adapter
annotations](http://svn.apache.org/viewvc/sling/trunk/tooling/maven/adapter-annotations/).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: compile.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): process-classes.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <fileName> | String | - | Name of the generated descriptor file.Default value is:SLING-INF/adapters.json.User property is:adapter.descriptor.name. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

Name of the generated descriptor file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: adapter.descriptor.name
- **Default**: SLING-INF/adapters.json

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – Sling Maven Plugin

# Sling Maven Plugin

The Sling Maven Plugin provides a number of goals which may be of help while developing bundles for Sling. To run the plugin you need at least Maven 3.x and JDK 1.7 or higher.

See [Goals](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-plugin-info) for a list of supported goals.

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:install-file

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--sling:install-file"></a>sling:install-file

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.0:install-file

**Description**:

Install an OSGi bundle to a running Sling instance.

**Attributes**:

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleStart> | boolean | - | Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.bundle.start. |
| <bundleStartLevel> | String | - | The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default value is:20.User property is:sling.bundle.startlevel. |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <mimeType> | String | - | The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.Default value is:application/java-archive.User property is:sling.mimeType. |
| <mountByFS> | boolean | - | Whether to add the mapping for theApache Sling File System Resource Provider.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.mountByFS. |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <refreshPackages> | boolean | - | Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.refreshPackages. |
| <slingUrl> | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <artifact> | String | - | A string of the form groupId:artifactId:version[:packaging[:classifier]].User property is:sling.artifact. |
| <artifactId> | String | - | The artifactId of the artifact to installUser property is:sling.artifactId. |
| <bundleFileName> | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:sling.file. |
| <classifier> | String | - | The classifier of the artifact to installUser property is:sling.classifier. |
| <deploymentMethod> | BundleDeploymentMethod | - | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to/dav/defaultin the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut.User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| <groupId> | String | - | The groupId of the artifact to installUser property is:sling.groupId. |
| <packaging> | String | - | The packaging of the artifact to installDefault value is:jar.User property is:sling.packaging. |
| <repositoryId> | String | - | The id of the repository from which we'll download the artifactDefault value is:temp.User property is:sling.repoId. |
| <repositoryUrl> | String | - | The url of the repository from which we'll download the artifactUser property is:sling.repoUrl. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |
| <usePut> | boolean | - | Deprecated.UsedeploymentMethodinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.usePut. |
| <version> | String | - | The version of the artifact to installUser property is:sling.version. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--a.3Cartifact.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--artifact"></a><artifact>**

A string of the form
groupId:artifactId:version[:packaging[:classifier]].

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.artifact

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--a.3CartifactId.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--artifactId"></a><artifactId>**

The artifactId of the artifact to install

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.artifactId

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--a.3CbundleFileName.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--bundleFileName"></a><bundleFileName>**

The name of the generated JAR file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.file

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--a.3CbundleStart.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--bundleStart"></a><bundleStart>**

Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when
POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.start
- **Default**: true

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--a.3CbundleStartLevel.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a><bundleStartLevel>**

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is
already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is
ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling
instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually).
Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.startlevel
- **Default**: 20

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--a.3Cclassifier.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--classifier"></a><classifier>**

The classifier of the artifact to install

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.classifier

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-file-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a><deploymentMethod>**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to
   /dav/default in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete
   for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:install

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-mojo--sling:install"></a>sling:install

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.0:install

**Description**:

Install an OSGi bundle to a running Sling instance. The plugin
places an HTTP POST request to [Felix
Web Console](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests). It's also possible to HTTP PUT instead of POST
leveraging the [WebDAV
bundle from Sling](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/development/repository-based-development.html). Since version 2.1.8 you can also leverage
the the [Sling
POST servlet](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/bundles/manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post.html) for that The chosen method depends on the
parameter deploymentMethod.   

**Intermediate Node Creation**

For all deploymentMethods except WebDAV the bundle
is not directly deployed within the OSGi container, but rather
being uploaded to the JCR and from there on being picked up by the
[JCR
Installer Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-jcr-installer-provider) asynchronously, which takes care of
deploying it in the OSGi container. For both other deployment
methods, intermediate nodes (i.e. inexisting parent nodes) are
automatically created. The primary type of those intermediate nodes
depend on the deployment method.

- WebDAV, uses the configured collection node type, by default
  sling:Folder (see also [WebDAV
  Configuration](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development))
- SlingPostServlet, uses internally
  ResourceResolverFactory.create(...) without setting
  any jcr:primaryType. Therefore the
  JcrResourceProviderFactory will call
  Node.addNode(String relPath) which determines a
  fitting node type automatically, depending on the parents node type
  definition (see [Javadoc](http://www.day.com/specs/jsr170/javadocs/jcr-2.0/javax/jcr/Node.html#addNode%28java.lang.String%29)).
  So in most of the cases this should be a sling:Folder,
  as this is the first allowed child node definition in
  sling:Folder. This only may differ, if your existing
  parent node is not of type sling:Folder itself.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): install.

| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |

Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-mojo--a.3CbundleStartLevel.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a><bundleStartLevel>**

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is
already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is
ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling
instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually).
Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: java.lang.String

- **Default**: 20

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-install-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a><deploymentMethod>**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to
   /dav/default in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete
   for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method

---

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin –

## Apache Sling Maven Plugin

---

- Last Published: 2019-01-14|

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:uninstall

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--sling:uninstall"></a>sling:uninstall

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.0:uninstall

**Description**:

Uninstall an OSGi bundle from a running Sling instance. The plugin
places by default an HTTP POST request to [Felix
Web Console](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) to uninstall the bundle. It's also possible to use
HTTP DELETE leveraging the [WebDAV
bundle from Sling](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/development/repository-based-development.html). or the [Sling
POST servlet](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/bundles/manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post.html) to uninstall the bundle. The chosen method depends
on the parameter deploymentMethod.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleStart> | boolean | - | Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.bundle.start. |
| <bundleStartLevel> | String | - | The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default value is:20.User property is:sling.bundle.startlevel. |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <mimeType> | String | - | The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.Default value is:application/java-archive.User property is:sling.mimeType. |
| <mountByFS> | boolean | - | Whether to add the mapping for theApache Sling File System Resource Provider.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.mountByFS. |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <refreshPackages> | boolean | - | Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.refreshPackages. |
| <slingUrl> | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleFileName> | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar.User property is:sling.file. |
| <deploymentMethod> | BundleDeploymentMethod | - | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to/dav/defaultin the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut.User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |
| <usePut> | boolean | - | Deprecated.UsedeploymentMethodinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.usePut. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleFileName.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--bundleFileName"></a><bundleFileName>**

The name of the generated JAR file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.file
- **Default**: ${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleStart.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--bundleStart"></a><bundleStart>**

Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when
POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.start
- **Default**: true

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleStartLevel.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a><bundleStartLevel>**

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is
already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is
ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling
instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually).
Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.startlevel
- **Default**: 20

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a><deploymentMethod>**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to
   /dav/default in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete
   for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CfailOnError.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--failOnError"></a><failOnError>**

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CmimeType.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--mimeType"></a><mimeType>**

The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST
deployment.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.mimeType
- **Default**: application/java-archive

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CmountByFS.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--mountByFS"></a><mountByFS>**

Whether to add the mapping for the [Apache
Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource).

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.mountByFS
- **Default**: false

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3Cpassword.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--password"></a><password>**

The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.password
- **Default**: admin

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CrefreshPackages.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--refreshPackages"></a><refreshPackages>**

Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded
bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.refreshPackages
- **Default**: true

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a><slingConsoleUrl>**

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required
for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of
slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.console.url

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--slingUrl"></a><slingUrl>**

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole**
deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to
include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install).
Omitting the dav/default segment can lead to conflicts
with other servlets.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.url
- **Default**: http://localhost:8080/system/console

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CslingUrlSuffix.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a><slingUrlSuffix>**

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the
sling.url for use as the real target url. This allows
to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the
same common sling.url in a parent POM (eg.
sling.url=http://localhost:8080 and
sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is
typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet
deployment methods.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.urlSuffix

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3CusePut.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--usePut"></a><usePut>**

**Deprecated.** Use deploymentMethod instead.

If a PUT via WebDAV should be used instead of the standard POST to
the Felix Web Console. In the uninstall goal, a HTTP
DELETE will be used.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.usePut
- **Default**: false

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--a.3Cuser.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-uninstall-mojo--user"></a><user>**

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.user
- **Default**: admin

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo--sling:validate"></a>sling:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.0:validate

**Description**:

The validate goal checks the JSON code of a bundle.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): process-resources.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <skip> | boolean | - | Whether to skip the validation.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.skip. |
| <skipJson> | boolean | - | Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no difference betweenskipandskipJsonbecause only JSON files will be validated by now.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.skipJson. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <jsonQuoteTick> | boolean | - | Whether to accept quote ticks in JSON files or not.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.jsonQuoteTick. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo--a.3CjsonQuoteTick.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo--jsonQuoteTick"></a><jsonQuoteTick>**

Whether to accept quote ticks in JSON files or not.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.validation.jsonQuoteTick
- **Default**: false

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo--a.3Cskip.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo--skip"></a><skip>**

Whether to skip the validation.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.validation.skip
- **Default**: false

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo--a.3CskipJson.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-0-validate-mojo--skipJson"></a><skipJson>**

Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no
difference between skip and skipJson
because only JSON files will be validated by now.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.validation.skipJson
- **Default**: false

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:deploy-file

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--sling:deploy-file"></a>sling:deploy-file

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.2:deploy-file

**Description**:

Deploy a JAR representing an OSGi Bundle to a Sling OSGi Bundle
Repository. This method posts the bundle referenced via
sling.file to an OSGi Bundle Repository accepting the
bundle. The plugin uses a *multipart/format-data* POST
request to just post the file to the URL configured in the
obr property.

**Attributes**:

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <obr> | String | - | The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is posted, e.g.http://obr.sample.comUser property is:obr. |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <slingUrl> | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleFileName> | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:sling.file. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--a.3Cobr.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--obr"></a><obr>**

The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is
posted, e.g. http://obr.sample.com

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--a.3Cpassword.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--password"></a><password>**

The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.password
- **Default**: admin

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a><slingConsoleUrl>**

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required
for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of
slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.console.url

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--slingUrl"></a><slingUrl>**

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole**
deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to
include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install).
Omitting the dav/default segment can lead to conflicts
with other servlets.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.url
- **Default**: http://localhost:8080/system/console

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--a.3CslingUrlSuffix.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a><slingUrlSuffix>**

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the
sling.url for use as the real target url. This allows
to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the
same common sling.url in a parent POM (eg.
sling.url=http://localhost:8080 and
sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is
typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet
deployment methods.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.urlSuffix

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--a.3Cuser.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-file-mojo--user"></a><user>**

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.user
- **Default**: admin

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:deploy

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-mojo--sling:deploy"></a>sling:deploy

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.2:deploy

**Description**:

Deploy a JAR representing an OSGi Bundle to a Sling OSGi Bundle
Repository. This method posts the bundle built by maven to the OSGi
Bundle Repository. The plugin uses a *multipart/format-data*
POST request to just post the file to the URL configured in the
obr property.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): deploy.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <jarName> | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:project.build.finalName.Alias is:jarName. |
| <obr> | String | - | The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is posted, e.g.http://obr.sample.comUser property is:obr. |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <skip> | boolean | - | Whether to skip this step even though it has been configured in the project to be executed. This property may be set by thesling.deploy.skipcomparable to themaven.test.skipproperty to prevent running the unit tests.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.deploy.skip. |
| <slingUrl> | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-deploy-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |
