# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:fsmount

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--sling:fsmount"></a>sling:fsmount

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.2:fsmount

**Description**:

Creates OSGi configurations for the [Apache
Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Since version: 2.2.0.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleFileName> | String | 2.2.0 | The name of the generated JAR file.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar.User property is:sling.file. |
| <failOnError> | boolean | 2.2.0 | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <password> | String | 2.2.0 | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <skip> | boolean | 2.2.0 | If set totrueSling File System Resource mount/unmount commands are ignored.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.fsmount.skip. |
| <slingUrl> | String | 2.2.0 | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| <user> | String | 2.2.0 | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <deployFsResourceBundle> | boolean | 2.3.0 | Deployorg.apache.sling.fsresourceto Sling instance bundle when it is not deployed already.Default value is:true. |
| <deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites> | List | 2.3.0 | Bundles that have to be installed as prerequisites to execute this goal. With multiple entries in the list different bundles with different preconditions can be defined.Default value is::<deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>   <bundlePrerequisite>     <bundles>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.commons.johnzon</artifactId>         <version>1.0.0</version>       </bundle>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.commons</groupId>         <artifactId>commons-collections4</artifactId>         <version>4.1</version>         <symbolicName>org.apache.commons.collections4</symbolicName>       </bundle>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>         <version>2.1.16</version>       </bundle>     </bundles>     <preconditions>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.resourceresolver</artifactId>         <version>1.5.18</version>       </bundle>     </preconditions>   </bundlePrerequisite>   <bundlePrerequisite>     <bundles>       <bundle>         <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>         <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>         <version>1.4.8</version>       </bundle>     </bundles>   </bundlePrerequisite> </deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites> |
| <deploymentMethod> | BundleDeploymentMethod | 2.3.0 | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut.Default value is:WebConsole.User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| <fileVaultFilterXmlFile> | File | 2.2.0 | Path to META-INF/vault/filter.xml when using FileVault XML filesystem layout.User property is:sling.filevault.filterxml.file. |
| <fileVaultJcrRootFile> | File | 2.2.0 | FileVault filesystem layout content root folder.User property is:sling.filevault.jcr_root.file. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | String | 2.2.0 | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | 2.2.0 | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--a.3CdeployFsResourceBundle.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--deployFsResourceBundle"></a><deployFsResourceBundle>**

Deploy org.apache.sling.fsresource to Sling instance
bundle when it is not deployed already.

- **Type**: boolean

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--a.3CdeployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites"></a><deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>**

Bundles that have to be installed as prerequisites to execute this
goal. With multiple entries in the list different bundles with
different preconditions can be defined.  
**Default value is:**:

```xml
<deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>
  <bundlePrerequisite>
    <bundles>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.commons.johnzon</artifactId>
        <version>1.0.0</version>
      </bundle>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.commons</groupId>
        <artifactId>commons-collections4</artifactId>
        <version>4.1</version>
        <symbolicName>org.apache.commons.collections4</symbolicName>
      </bundle>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>
        <version>2.1.16</version>
      </bundle>
    </bundles>
    <preconditions>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.resourceresolver</artifactId>
        <version>1.5.18</version>
      </bundle>
    </preconditions>
  </bundlePrerequisite>
  <bundlePrerequisite>
    <bundles>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>
        <version>1.4.8</version>
      </bundle>
    </bundles>
  </bundlePrerequisite>
</deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>
```

- **Type**: java.util.List
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a><deploymentMethod>**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (usually below
   regular Sling root URL). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall
   goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Since**: 2.3.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method
- **Default**: WebConsole

---

- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

---

If set to true Sling File System Resource
mount/unmount commands are ignored.

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a><slingConsoleUrl>**

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required
for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of
slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.console.url

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--slingUrl"></a><slingUrl>**

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole**
deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to
include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install).
Omitting the dav/default segment can lead to conflicts
with other servlets.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.url
- **Default**: http://localhost:8080/system/console

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--a.3CslingUrlSuffix.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-fsmount-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a><slingUrlSuffix>**

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the
sling.url for use as the real target url. This allows
to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the
same common sling.url in a parent POM (eg.
sling.url=http://localhost:8080 and
sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is
typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet
deployment methods.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.urlSuffix

---

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 2.2.0
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.user
- **Default**: admin

---

Build [adapter
metadata (JSON)](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/the-sling-engine/adapters.html) for the Web Console Plugin at

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – Sling Maven Plugin

# Sling Maven Plugin

The Sling Maven Plugin provides a number of goals which may be of help while developing bundles for Sling. To run the plugin you need at least Maven 3.x and JDK 1.7 or higher.

See [Goals](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-plugin-info) for a list of supported goals.

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-file-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:install-file

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-file-mojo--sling:install-file"></a>sling:install-file

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.2:install-file

**Description**:

Install an OSGi bundle to a running Sling instance.

**Attributes**:

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleStart> | boolean | - | Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.bundle.start. |
| <bundleStartLevel> | String | - | The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default value is:20.User property is:sling.bundle.startlevel. |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <mimeType> | String | - | The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.Default value is:application/java-archive.User property is:sling.mimeType. |
| <mountByFS> | boolean | - | Whether to add the mapping for theApache Sling File System Resource Provider.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.mountByFS. |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <refreshPackages> | boolean | - | Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.refreshPackages. |
| <slingUrl> | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to
   /dav/default in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete
   for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:install

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-mojo--sling:install"></a>sling:install

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.2:install

**Description**:

Install an OSGi bundle to a running Sling instance. The plugin
places an HTTP POST request to [Felix
Web Console](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests). It's also possible to HTTP PUT instead of POST
leveraging the [WebDAV
bundle from Sling](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/development/repository-based-development.html). Since version 2.1.8 you can also leverage
the the [Sling
POST servlet](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/bundles/manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post.html) for that The chosen method depends on the
parameter deploymentMethod.   

**Intermediate Node Creation**

For all deploymentMethods except WebDAV the bundle
is not directly deployed within the OSGi container, but rather
being uploaded to the JCR and from there on being picked up by the
[JCR
Installer Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-jcr-installer-provider) asynchronously, which takes care of
deploying it in the OSGi container. For both other deployment
methods, intermediate nodes (i.e. inexisting parent nodes) are
automatically created. The primary type of those intermediate nodes
depend on the deployment method.

- WebDAV, uses the configured collection node type, by default
  sling:Folder (see also [WebDAV
  Configuration](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development))
- SlingPostServlet, uses internally
  ResourceResolverFactory.create(...) without setting
  any jcr:primaryType. Therefore the
  JcrResourceProviderFactory will call
  Node.addNode(String relPath) which determines a
  fitting node type automatically, depending on the parents node type
  definition (see [Javadoc](http://www.day.com/specs/jsr170/javadocs/jcr-2.0/javax/jcr/Node.html#addNode%28java.lang.String%29)).
  So in most of the cases this should be a sling:Folder,
  as this is the first allowed child node definition in
  sling:Folder. This only may differ, if your existing
  parent node is not of type sling:Folder itself.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): install.

   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to
   /dav/default in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete
   for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-mojo--a.3CfailOnError.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-mojo--failOnError"></a><failOnError>**

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a><slingConsoleUrl>**

for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-install-mojo--slingUrl"></a><slingUrl>**

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole**
deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to
include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install).
Omitting the dav/default segment can lead to conflicts
with other servlets.

sling.url for use as the real target url. This allows
to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the
same common sling.url in a parent POM (eg.

sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is
typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet
deployment methods.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.urlSuffix

If a PUT via WebDAV should be used instead of the standard POST to
the Felix Web Console. In the uninstall goal, a HTTP
DELETE will be used.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.usePut
- **Default**: false

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:uninstall

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--sling:uninstall"></a>sling:uninstall

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.2:uninstall

**Description**:

Uninstall an OSGi bundle from a running Sling instance. The plugin
places by default an HTTP POST request to [Felix
Web Console](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) to uninstall the bundle. It's also possible to use
HTTP DELETE leveraging the [WebDAV
bundle from Sling](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/development/repository-based-development.html). or the [Sling
POST servlet](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/bundles/manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post.html) to uninstall the bundle. The chosen method depends
on the parameter deploymentMethod.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleStart> | boolean | - | Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.bundle.start. |
| <bundleStartLevel> | String | - | The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default value is:20.User property is:sling.bundle.startlevel. |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <mimeType> | String | - | The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.Default value is:application/java-archive.User property is:sling.mimeType. |
| <mountByFS> | boolean | - | Whether to add the mapping for theApache Sling File System Resource Provider.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.mountByFS. |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <refreshPackages> | boolean | - | Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.refreshPackages. |
| <slingUrl> | String | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleFileName> | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar.User property is:sling.file. |
| <deploymentMethod> | BundleDeploymentMethod | - | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to/dav/defaultin the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut.User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | String | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |
| <usePut> | boolean | - | Deprecated.UsedeploymentMethodinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.usePut. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleFileName.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--bundleFileName"></a><bundleFileName>**

The name of the generated JAR file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.file

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleStart.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--bundleStart"></a><bundleStart>**

Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when
POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.start
- **Default**: true

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleStartLevel.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a><bundleStartLevel>**

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is
already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is
ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling
instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually).
Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.bundle.startlevel
- **Default**: 20

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a><deploymentMethod>**

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that slingUrl points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that slingUrl
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to
   /dav/default in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete
   for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   slingUrl points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
usePut.

- **Type**: org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod
- **Required**: No
- **User Property**: sling.deploy.method

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CfailOnError.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--failOnError"></a><failOnError>**

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.failOnError
- **Default**: true

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CmimeType.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--mimeType"></a><mimeType>**

The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST
deployment.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: Yes
- **User Property**: sling.mimeType
- **Default**: application/java-archive

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-2-4-2-uninstall-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a><slingConsoleUrl>**

The default is only useful for **WebConsole**
deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to
include the Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install).

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:2.4.2:validate

**Description**:

The validate goal checks the JSON code of a bundle.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): process-resources.

| <jsonQuoteTick> | boolean | - | Whether to accept quote ticks in JSON files or not.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.jsonQuoteTick. |

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:deploy-file

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-file-mojo--sling:deploy-file"></a>sling:deploy-file[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-file-mojo--sling-deploy-file)

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.2:deploy-file

**This plugin goal has been deprecated**:

Use the OBR goals from the [maven-bundle-plugin](https://felix.apache.org/documentation/_attachments/components/bundle-plugin/index.html)
instead.

**Description**:

Deploy a JAR representing an OSGi Bundle to a Sling OSGi Bundle
Repository. This method posts the bundle referenced via
`sling.file` to an OSGi Bundle Repository accepting the
bundle. The plugin uses a *multipart/format-data* POST
request to just post the file to the URL configured in the
`obr` property.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-file-mojo--required-parameters)

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <obr> | String | - | The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is posted, e.g.http://obr.sample.comUser property is:obr. |
| <slingUrl> | URI | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include theSling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-file-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-file-mojo--optional-parameters)

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleFileName> | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User property is:sling.file. |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <httpConnectTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP connection timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until a new connection is fully established. This may also include transport security negotiation exchanges such asSSLorTLSprotocol negotiation).Default value is:10.User property is:sling.httpConnectTimeoutSec. |
| <httpResponseTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP response timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until arrival of a response from the opposite endpoint.Default value is:60.User property is:sling.httpResponseTimeoutSec. |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | URI | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-file-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-file-mojo--parameter-details)

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a><slingConsoleUrl>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--slingconsoleurl)

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required
for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of
slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.console.url`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--slingUrl"></a><slingUrl>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--slingurl)

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole**
deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to
include the [Sling
Simple WebDAV servlet root](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development--separate-uri-space-webdav), for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install).
Omitting the `dav/default` segment can lead to conflicts
with other servlets.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **User Property**: `sling.url`
- **Default**: `http://localhost:8080/system/console`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--a.3CslingUrlSuffix.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a><slingUrlSuffix>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--slingurlsuffix)

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the
`sling.url` for use as the real target url. This allows
to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the
same common `sling.url` in a parent POM (eg.
`sling.url=http://localhost:8080` and
`sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path`). This is
typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet
deployment methods.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.urlSuffix`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--a.3Cuser.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--user"></a><user>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-deploy-mojo--user)

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.user`
- **Default**: `admin`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsmount-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:fsmount

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsmount-mojo--sling:fsmount"></a>sling:fsmount[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsmount-mojo--sling-fsmount)

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.2:fsmount

**Description**:

Create OSGi configurations for the [Apache
Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource). In case a bundle file is
supplied via `AbstractFsMountMojo.bundleFileName` the
configuration for its [initial
content](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-content-loading-jcr-contentloader--initial-content-loading) is created. Otherwise it tries to detect a FileVault
content package layout starting at
`AbstractFsMountMojo.fileVaultJcrRootFile` or the
project's resource directories and potentially creates a
configuration for each path in the package's
`filter.xml`.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.
- Since version: `2.2.0`.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsmount-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsmount-mojo--required-parameters)

Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |

**Default value is:**:

```xml
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.commons.johnzon</artifactId>

      </bundle>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.commons</groupId>
        <artifactId>commons-collections4</artifactId>
        <version>4.1</version>
        <symbolicName>org.apache.commons.collections4</symbolicName>
      </bundle>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>
        <version>2.1.16</version>
      </bundle>
    </bundles>
    <preconditions>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.resourceresolver</artifactId>
        <version>1.5.18</version>
      </bundle>
    </preconditions>
  </bundlePrerequisite>
  <bundlePrerequisite>
    <bundles>
      <bundle>
        <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId>
        <artifactId>org.apache.sling.fsresource</artifactId>
        <version>1.4.8</version>
      </bundle>
    </bundles>
  </bundlePrerequisite>
</deployFsResourceBundlePrerequisites>
```

- **Since**: `2.3.0`
- **Required**: `No`

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsmount-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsmount-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a><deploymentMethod>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsmount-mojo--deploymentmethod)

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that `slingUrl` points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that `slingUrl`
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to
   `/dav/default` in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP
   Delete for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   `slingUrl` points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

For more details refer to [Bundle
Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-bundle-installation).

- **Type**: `org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod`
- **Since**: `2.3.0`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.deploy.method`
- **Default**: `WebConsole`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsunmount-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:fsunmount

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsunmount-mojo--sling:fsunmount"></a>sling:fsunmount[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsunmount-mojo--sling-fsunmount)

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.2:fsunmount

**Description**:

Remove OSGi configurations for the [Apache
Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource). In case a bundle file is
supplied via `AbstractFsMountMojo.bundleFileName` the
configuration for its [initial
content](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-content-loading-jcr-contentloader--initial-content-loading) is created. Otherwise it tries to detect a FileVault
content package layout starting at
`AbstractFsMountMojo.fileVaultJcrRootFile` or the
project's resource directories and potentially creates a
configuration for each path in the package's
`filter.xml`.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.
- Since version: `2.2.0`.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsunmount-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsunmount-mojo--required-parameters)

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <slingUrl> | URI | 2.2.0 | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include theSling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsunmount-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-fsunmount-mojo--optional-parameters)

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| <failOnError> | boolean | 2.2.0 | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <fileVaultFilterXmlFile> | File | 2.2.0 | Path to META-INF/vault/filter.xml when using FileVault XML filesystem layout.User property is:sling.filevault.filterxml.file. |
| <fileVaultJcrRootFile> | File | 2.2.0 | FileVault filesystem layout content root folder.User property is:sling.filevault.jcr_root.file. |
| <httpConnectTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP connection timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until a new connection is fully established. This may also include transport security negotiation exchanges such asSSLorTLSprotocol negotiation).Default value is:10.User property is:sling.httpConnectTimeoutSec. |
| <httpResponseTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP response timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until arrival of a response from the opposite endpoint.Default value is:60.User property is:sling.httpResponseTimeoutSec. |
| <password> | String | 2.2.0 | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <skip> | boolean | 2.2.0 | If set totrueSling File System Resource mount/unmount commands are ignored.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.fsmount.skip. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | URI | 2.2.0 | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | 2.2.0 | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:generate-adapter-metadata

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--sling:generate-adapter-metadata"></a>sling:generate-adapter-metadata[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--sling-generate-adapter-metadata)

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.2:generate-adapter-metadata

**Description**:

Build [adapter
metadata (JSON)](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/the-sling-engine/adapters.html#implementing-adaptable) for the Web Console Plugin at
`/system/console/status-adapters` and
`/system/console/adapters` from classes annotated with
[adapter
annotations](https://github.com/apache/sling-adapter-annotations).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: `compile`.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `process-classes`.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--optional-parameters)

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <buildOutputDirectory> | File | - | The directory which to check for classes with adapter metadata annotations.Default value is:${project.build.outputDirectory}.User property is:adapter.build.output.directory. |
| <fileName> | String | - | Name of the generated descriptor file (relative tooutputDirectory).Default value is:SLING-INF/adapters.json.User property is:adapter.descriptor.name. |
| <outputDirectory> | File | - | The output directory in which to emit the descriptor file with namefileName.Default value is:${project.build.outputDirectory}.User property is:adapter.output.directory. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--parameter-details)

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--a.3CbuildOutputDirectory.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--buildOutputDirectory"></a><buildOutputDirectory>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--buildoutputdirectory)

The directory which to check for classes with adapter metadata
annotations.

- **Type**: `java.io.File`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `adapter.build.output.directory`
- **Default**: `${project.build.outputDirectory}`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--a.3CfileName.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--fileName"></a><fileName>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--filename)

Name of the generated descriptor file (relative to
`outputDirectory`).

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `adapter.descriptor.name`
- **Default**: `SLING-INF/adapters.json`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--a.3CoutputDirectory.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--outputDirectory"></a><outputDirectory>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--outputdirectory)

`fileName`.

- **Type**: `java.io.File`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `adapter.output.directory`
- **Default**: `${project.build.outputDirectory}`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-help-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:help

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-help-mojo--sling:help"></a>sling:help[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-help-mojo--sling-help)

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.2:help

**Description**:

Display help information on sling-maven-plugin.  
Call `mvn sling:help -Ddetail=true
-Dgoal=<goal-name>` to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-help-mojo--optional-parameters)

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:install-file

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo--sling:install-file"></a>sling:install-file[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo--sling-install-file)

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.2:install-file

**Description**:

Install an OSGi bundle from a given file path or Maven coordinates
(resolved from the repository) to a running Sling instance. One of
the following parameter sets are used to determine the bundle to
install (evaluated in the given order):

- `groupId`, `artifactId`,
  `version`, and optionally `classifier` and
  `packaging`
- `artifact`
- `bundleFileName`

To install a bundle which has been built from the current Maven
project rather use goal [install](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo).
For details refer to [Bundle
Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-bundle-installation).

**Attributes**:

- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo--required-parameters)

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <slingUrl> | URI | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include theSling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |

| <bundleFileName> | File | - | The path of the bundle file to install. Is only effective if artifact is not determined via some other way (Maven coordinates).Default value is:${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar.User property is:sling.file. |
| <bundleStart> | boolean | - | Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.bundle.start. |
| <bundleStartLevel> | String | - | The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default value is:20.User property is:sling.bundle.startlevel. |
| <classifier> | String | - | The classifier of the artifact to installUser property is:sling.classifier. |
| <deploymentMethod> | BundleDeploymentMethod | - | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).For more details refer toBundle Installation. This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut. If nothing is set the default is eitherWebConsoleorWebDAV(whenusePutistrue).User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |

This may also include transport security negotiation exchanges such asSSLorTLSprotocol negotiation).Default value is:10.User property is:sling.httpConnectTimeoutSec. |
| <httpResponseTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP response timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until arrival of a response from the opposite endpoint.Default value is:60.User property is:sling.httpResponseTimeoutSec. |
| <mimeType> | String | - | The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.Default value is:application/java-archive.User property is:sling.mimeType. |
| <mountByFS> | boolean | - | Whether to add (for install)/remove (for uninstall) the mapping for theApache Sling File System Resource Providerfor thebundle's initial content. This parameter must not betruewith bundles resolved from the Maven repository.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.mountByFS. |
| <packaging> | String | - | The packaging of the artifact to installDefault value is:jar.User property is:sling.packaging. |

This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a><deploymentMethod>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo--deploymentmethod)

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that `slingUrl` points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that `slingUrl`
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to
   `/dav/default` in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP
   Delete for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   `slingUrl` points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

For more details refer to [Bundle
Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-bundle-installation). This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
`usePut`. If nothing is set the default is either
`WebConsole` or `WebDAV` (when
`usePut` is `true`).

- **Type**: `org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.deploy.method`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo--slingUrl"></a><slingUrl>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo--slingurl)

Simple WebDAV servlet root](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development--separate-uri-space-webdav), for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install).

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:install

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--sling:install"></a>sling:install[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--sling-install)

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.2:install

**Description**:

Install the project's artifact to a running Sling instance (in case
it is an OSGi bundle). It uses the first valid OSGi bundle file for
deployment from the primary artifact and all secondary ones. For
details refer to [Bundle
Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-bundle-installation). To install an arbitrary bundle not attached to
the current Maven project use goal [install-file](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-file-mojo).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `install`.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--required-parameters)

Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |

The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default value is:20.User property is:sling.bundle.startlevel. |
| <deploymentMethod> | BundleDeploymentMethod | - | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).For more details refer toBundle Installation. This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut. If nothing is set the default is eitherWebConsoleorWebDAV(whenusePutistrue).User property is:sling.deploy.method. |

| <httpResponseTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP response timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until arrival of a response from the opposite endpoint.Default value is:60.User property is:sling.httpResponseTimeoutSec. |
| <mimeType> | String | - | The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.Default value is:application/java-archive.User property is:sling.mimeType. |

This parameter must not betruewith bundles resolved from the Maven repository.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.mountByFS. |

This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--parameter-details)

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--a.3CbundleStart.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--bundleStart"></a><bundleStart>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--bundlestart)

Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when
POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.bundle.start`
- **Default**: `true`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--a.3CbundleStartLevel.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a><bundleStartLevel>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--bundlestartlevel)

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is
already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is
ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling
instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually).
Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.bundle.startlevel`
- **Default**: `20`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a><deploymentMethod>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--deploymentmethod)

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that `slingUrl` points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that `slingUrl`
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to
   `/dav/default` in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP
   Delete for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   `slingUrl` points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

For more details refer to [Bundle
Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-bundle-installation). This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
`usePut`. If nothing is set the default is either
`WebConsole` or `WebDAV` (when
`usePut` is `true`).

- **Type**: `org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.deploy.method`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--a.3CfailOnError.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--failOnError"></a><failOnError>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-install-mojo--failonerror)

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Default**: `true`
