<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:uninstall

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--sling:uninstall"></a>sling:uninstall[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--sling-uninstall)

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.2:uninstall

**Description**:

Uninstall an OSGi bundle from a running Sling instance. For details
refer to [Bundle
Uninstallation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-bundle-installation).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--required-parameters)

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <slingUrl> | URI | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include theSling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default value is:http://localhost:8080/system/console.User property is:sling.url. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--optional-parameters)

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleFileName> | File | - | Deprecated.UsebundleNameinsteadDefault value is:${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar.User property is:sling.file. |
| <bundleName> | String | - | The bundles's file/resource name without path (for alldeploymentMethods except forWebConsole) or its symbolic name. If this parameter is set, it takes precedence overbundleFileName.User property is:sling.bundle.name. |
| <bundleStart> | boolean | - | Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.bundle.start. |
| <bundleStartLevel> | String | - | The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default value is:20.User property is:sling.bundle.startlevel. |
| <deploymentMethod> | BundleDeploymentMethod | - | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to/dav/defaultin the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).For more details refer toBundle Installation. This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut. If nothing is set the default is eitherWebConsoleorWebDAV(whenusePutistrue).User property is:sling.deploy.method. |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default value is:true.User property is:sling.failOnError. |
| <httpConnectTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP connection timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until a new connection is fully established. This may also include transport security negotiation exchanges such asSSLorTLSprotocol negotiation).Default value is:10.User property is:sling.httpConnectTimeoutSec. |
| <httpResponseTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP response timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until arrival of a response from the opposite endpoint.Default value is:60.User property is:sling.httpResponseTimeoutSec. |
| <mimeType> | String | - | The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.Default value is:application/java-archive.User property is:sling.mimeType. |
| <mountByFS> | boolean | - | Whether to add (for install)/remove (for uninstall) the mapping for theApache Sling File System Resource Providerfor thebundle's initial content. This parameter must not betruewith bundles resolved from the Maven repository.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.mountByFS. |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.password. |
| <refreshPackages> | boolean | - | Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault value is:true.User property is:sling.refreshPackages. |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | URI | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User property is:sling.console.url. |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User property is:sling.urlSuffix. |
| <usePut> | boolean | - | Deprecated.UsedeploymentMethodinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.usePut. |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default value is:admin.User property is:sling.user. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--parameter-details)

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleFileName.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--bundleFileName"></a><bundleFileName>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--bundlefilename)

**Deprecated.** Use `bundleName` instead

The path of bundle file to uninstall. The file is only used to
determine the file name or bundle symbolic name. This parameter is
only effective if `bundleName` is not set.

- **Type**: `java.io.File`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.file`
- **Default**: `${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleName.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--bundleName"></a><bundleName>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--bundlename)

The bundles's file/resource name without path (for all
`deploymentMethod`s except for `WebConsole`)
or its symbolic name. If this parameter is set, it takes precedence
over `bundleFileName`.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.bundle.name`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleStart.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--bundleStart"></a><bundleStart>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--bundlestart)

Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when
POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.bundle.start`
- **Default**: `true`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleStartLevel.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a><bundleStartLevel>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--bundlestartlevel)

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is
already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is
ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling
instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually).
Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.bundle.startlevel`
- **Default**: `20`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a><deploymentMethod>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--deploymentmethod)

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are
allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [Felix
   Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the
   default. Make sure that `slingUrl` points to the Felix
   Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development)
   for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that `slingUrl`
   points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to
   `/dav/default` in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP
   Delete for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling
   Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that
   `slingUrl` points a path which is handled by the Sling
   POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

For more details refer to [Bundle
Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-bundle-installation). This has precedence over the deprecated parameter
`usePut`. If nothing is set the default is either
`WebConsole` or `WebDAV` (when
`usePut` is `true`).

- **Type**: `org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.deploy.method`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CfailOnError.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--failOnError"></a><failOnError>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--failonerror)

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT
returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.failOnError`
- **Default**: `true`

---

- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.console.url`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--slingUrl"></a><slingUrl>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--slingurl)

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole**
deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to
include the [Sling
Simple WebDAV servlet root](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development--separate-uri-space-webdav), for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install).
Omitting the `dav/default` segment can lead to conflicts
with other servlets.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **User Property**: `sling.url`
- **Default**: `http://localhost:8080/system/console`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CslingUrlSuffix.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a><slingUrlSuffix>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--slingurlsuffix)

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the
`sling.url` for use as the real target url. This allows
to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the
same common `sling.url` in a parent POM (eg.
`sling.url=http://localhost:8080` and
`sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path`). This is
typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet
deployment methods.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.urlSuffix`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3CusePut.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--usePut"></a><usePut>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--useput)

**Deprecated.** Use `deploymentMethod` instead.

If a PUT via WebDAV should be used instead of the standard POST to
the Felix Web Console. In the `uninstall` goal, a HTTP
DELETE will be used.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.usePut`
- **Default**: `false`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--a.3Cuser.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--user"></a><user>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-uninstall-mojo--user)

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.user`
- **Default**: `admin`

# Apache Sling Maven Plugin – sling:validate

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--sling:validate"></a>sling:validate[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--sling-validate)

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.2:validate

**Description**:

Validate all JSON files of a project. It only ensures they are
well-formed but not that they are valid against a certain schema.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `process-resources`.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--optional-parameters)

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <jsonQuoteTick> | boolean | - | Whether to accept quote ticks in JSON files or not.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.jsonQuoteTick. |
| <skip> | boolean | - | Whether to skip the validation.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.skip. |
| <skipJson> | boolean | - | Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no difference betweenskipandskipJsonbecause only JSON files will be validated by now.Default value is:false.User property is:sling.validation.skipJson. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--parameter-details)

Whether to accept quote ticks in JSON files or not.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.validation.jsonQuoteTick`
- **Default**: `false`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--a.3Cskip.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--skip"></a><skip>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--skip)

Whether to skip the validation.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.validation.skip`
- **Default**: `false`

---

#### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--a.3CskipJson.3E"></a>**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--skipJson"></a><skipJson>**[](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-2-validate-mojo--skipjson)

Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no
difference between `skip` and `skipJson`
because only JSON files will be validated by now.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.validation.skipJson`

# sling:deploy-file – Apache Sling Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-file-mojo--sling.3Adeploy-file"></a>

# sling:deploy-file

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.4:deploy-file

**Deprecated**:

Use the OBR goals from the [maven-bundle-plugin](https://felix.apache.org/documentation/_attachments/components/bundle-plugin/index.html) instead.

**Description**:

Deploy a JAR representing an OSGi Bundle to a Sling OSGi Bundle Repository. This method posts the bundle referenced via `sling.file` to an OSGi Bundle Repository accepting the bundle. The plugin uses a *multipart/format-data* POST request to just post the file to the URL configured in the `obr` property.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>

## Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <obr> | String | - | The URL to the OSGi Bundle repository to which the bundle is posted, e.g.http://obr.sample.comUser Property:obr |
| <slingUrl> | URI | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include theSling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default:http://localhost:8080/system/consoleUser Property:sling.url |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-file-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

## Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundleFileName> | String | - | The name of the generated JAR file.User Property:sling.file |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default:trueUser Property:sling.failOnError |
| <httpConnectTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP connection timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until a new connection is fully established. This may also include transport security negotiation exchanges such asSSLorTLSprotocol negotiation).Default:10User Property:sling.httpConnectTimeoutSec |
| <httpResponseTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP response timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until arrival of a response from the opposite endpoint.Default:60User Property:sling.httpResponseTimeoutSec |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default:adminUser Property:sling.password |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | URI | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User Property:sling.console.url |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User Property:sling.urlSuffix |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default:adminUser Property:sling.user |

- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.console.url`

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-file-mojo--slingUrl"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-file-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>

### <slingUrl>

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole** deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to include the [Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development--separate-uri-space-webdav), for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install). Omitting the `dav/default` segment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **User Property**: `sling.url`
- **Default**: `http://localhost:8080/system/console`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-file-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a>

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the `sling.url` for use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same common `sling.url` in a parent POM (eg. `sling.url=http://localhost:8080` and `sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path`). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.urlSuffix`

---

Whether to skip this step even though it has been configured in the project to be executed. This property may be set by the `sling.deploy.skip` comparable to the `maven.test.skip` property to prevent running the unit tests.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **User Property**: `sling.deploy.skip`
- **Default**: `false`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>

### <slingConsoleUrl>

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.console.url`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-mojo--slingUrl"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>

### <slingUrl>

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole** deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to include the [Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development--separate-uri-space-webdav), for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install). Omitting the `dav/default` segment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **User Property**: `sling.url`
- **Default**: `http://localhost:8080/system/console`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-mojo--a.3CslingUrlSuffix.3E"></a>

### <slingUrlSuffix>

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the `sling.url` for use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same common `sling.url` in a parent POM (eg. `sling.url=http://localhost:8080` and `sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path`). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.urlSuffix`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-mojo--user"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-deploy-mojo--a.3Cuser.3E"></a>

### <user>

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.user`
- **Default**: `admin`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-fsmount-mojo"></a>

# sling:fsmount – Apache Sling Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-fsmount-mojo--sling.3Afsmount"></a>

# sling:fsmount

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.4:fsmount

**Description**:

Create OSGi configurations for the [Apache Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource). In case a bundle file is supplied via `bundleFileName` the configuration for its [initial content](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-content-loading-jcr-contentloader--initial-content-loading) is created. Otherwise it tries to detect a FileVault content package layout starting at `fileVaultJcrRootFile` or the project's resource directories and potentially creates a configuration for each path in the package's `filter.xml`.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.
- Since version: `2.2.0`.

        <version>1.2.6</version>
      </bundle>

      </bundle>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-fsmount-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-fsmount-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>

### <deploymentMethod>

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [ Felix Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure that `slingUrl` points to the Felix Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [ WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development) for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that `slingUrl` points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to `/dav/default` in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that `slingUrl` points a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

For more details refer to [Bundle Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-bundle-installation).

- **Type**: `org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod`
- **Since**: `2.3.0`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.deploy.method`
- **Default**: `WebConsole`

---

### <slingUrl>

The default is only useful for **WebConsole** deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to include the [Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development--separate-uri-space-webdav), for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install). Omitting the `dav/default` segment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **User Property**: `sling.url`
- **Default**: `http://localhost:8080/system/console`

This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.urlSuffix`

# sling:generate-adapter-metadata – Apache Sling Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--sling.3Agenerate-adapter-metadata"></a>

# sling:generate-adapter-metadata

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.4:generate-adapter-metadata

**Description**:

Build [adapter metadata (JSON)](http://sling.apache.org/documentation/the-sling-engine/adapters.html#implementing-adaptable) for the Web Console Plugin at `/system/console/status-adapters` and `/system/console/adapters` from classes annotated with [adapter annotations](https://github.com/apache/sling-adapter-annotations).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: `compile`.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](https://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `process-classes`.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-generate-adapter-metadata-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

## Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <buildOutputDirectory> | File | - | The directory which to check for classes with adapter metadata annotations.Default:${project.build.outputDirectory}User Property:adapter.build.output.directory |
| <fileName> | String | - | Name of the generated descriptor file (relative tooutputDirectory).Default:SLING-INF/adapters.jsonUser Property:adapter.descriptor.name |
| <outputDirectory> | File | - | The output directory in which to emit the descriptor file with namefileName.Default:${project.build.outputDirectory}User Property:adapter.output.directory |

# sling:install-file – Apache Sling Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--sling.3Ainstall-file"></a>

# sling:install-file

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.4:install-file

**Description**:

Install an OSGi bundle from a given file path or Maven coordinates (resolved from the repository) to a running Sling instance. One of the following parameter sets are used to determine the bundle to install (evaluated in the given order):

- `groupId`, `artifactId`, `version`, and optionally `classifier` and `packaging`
- `artifact`
- `bundleFileName`

To install a bundle which has been built from the current Maven project rather use goal install. For details refer to [Bundle Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-bundle-installation).

**Attributes**:

- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>

## Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <slingUrl> | URI | - | The URL of the running Sling instance.The default is only useful forWebConsoledeployment.ForWebDAVdeployment it is recommended to include theSling Simple WebDAV servlet root, for instancehttp://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install. Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default:http://localhost:8080/system/consoleUser Property:sling.url |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

## Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <artifact> | String | - | A string of the formgroupId:artifactId:version[:packaging[:classifier]]. Takes precedence overbundleFileName.User Property:sling.artifact |
| <artifactId> | String | - | The artifactId of the artifact to install. Takes precedence overartifactandbundleFileName.User Property:sling.artifactId |
| <bundleFileName> | File | - | The path of the bundle file to install. Is only effective if artifact is not determined via some other way (Maven coordinates).Default:${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jarUser Property:sling.file |
| <bundleStart> | boolean | - | Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault:trueUser Property:sling.bundle.start |
| <bundleStartLevel> | String | - | The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.Default:20User Property:sling.bundle.startlevel |
| <classifier> | String | - | The classifier of the artifact to installUser Property:sling.classifier |
| <deploymentMethod> | BundleDeploymentMethod | - | Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowedWebConsole, uses theFelix Web Console REST APIfor deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the Felix Web Console in that case.WebDAV, usesWebDAVfor deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to/dav/defaultin the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.SlingPostServlet, uses theSling Post Servletfor deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure thatslingUrlpoints a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).For more details refer toBundle Installation. This has precedence over the deprecated parameterusePut. If nothing is set the default is eitherWebConsoleorWebDAV(whenusePutistrue).User Property:sling.deploy.method |
| <failOnError> | boolean | - | Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.Default:trueUser Property:sling.failOnError |
| <groupId> | String | - | The groupId of the artifact to install. Takes precedence overartifactandbundleFileName.User Property:sling.groupId |
| <httpConnectTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP connection timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until a new connection is fully established. This may also include transport security negotiation exchanges such asSSLorTLSprotocol negotiation).Default:10User Property:sling.httpConnectTimeoutSec |
| <httpResponseTimeoutSec> | int | 3.0.0 | HTTP response timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until arrival of a response from the opposite endpoint.Default:60User Property:sling.httpResponseTimeoutSec |
| <mimeType> | String | - | The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.Default:application/java-archiveUser Property:sling.mimeType |
| <mountByFS> | boolean | - | Whether to add (for install)/remove (for uninstall) the mapping for theApache Sling File System Resource Providerfor thebundle's initial content. This parameter must not betruewith bundles resolved from the Maven repository.Default:falseUser Property:sling.mountByFS |
| <packaging> | String | - | The packaging of the artifact to installDefault:jarUser Property:sling.packaging |
| <password> | String | - | The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default:adminUser Property:sling.password |
| <refreshPackages> | boolean | - | Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web ConsoleDefault:trueUser Property:sling.refreshPackages |
| <slingConsoleUrl> | URI | - | The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.User Property:sling.console.url |
| <slingUrlSuffix> | String | - | An optional url suffix which will be appended to thesling.urlfor use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same commonsling.urlin a parent POM (eg.sling.url=http://localhost:8080andsling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.User Property:sling.urlSuffix |
| <usePut> | boolean | - | Deprecated.UsedeploymentMethodinstead.If a PUT via WebDAV should be used instead of the standard POST to the Felix Web Console. In theuninstallgoal, a HTTP DELETE will be used.Default:falseUser Property:sling.usePut |
| <user> | String | - | The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.Default:adminUser Property:sling.user |
| <version> | String | - | The version of the artifact to install. Takes precedence overartifactandbundleFileName.User Property:sling.version |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CbundleStartLevel.3E"></a>

### <bundleStartLevel>

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.bundle.startlevel`
- **Default**: `20`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--classifier"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3Cclassifier.3E"></a>

### <classifier>

The classifier of the artifact to install

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.classifier`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>

### <deploymentMethod>

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [ Felix Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure that `slingUrl` points to the Felix Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [ WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development) for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that `slingUrl` points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to `/dav/default` in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that `slingUrl` points a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

For more details refer to [Bundle Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-bundle-installation). This has precedence over the deprecated parameter `usePut`. If nothing is set the default is either `WebConsole` or `WebDAV` (when `usePut` is `true`).

- **Type**: `org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.deploy.method`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--failOnError"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CfailOnError.3E"></a>

### <failOnError>

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.failOnError`
- **Default**: `true`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--groupId"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CgroupId.3E"></a>

### <groupId>

The groupId of the artifact to install. Takes precedence over `artifact` and `bundleFileName`.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.groupId`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--httpConnectTimeoutSec"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3ChttpConnectTimeoutSec.3E"></a>

### <httpConnectTimeoutSec>

HTTP connection timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until a new connection is fully established. This may also include transport security negotiation exchanges such as `SSL` or `TLS` protocol negotiation).

- **Type**: `int`
- **Since**: `3.0.0`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.httpConnectTimeoutSec`
- **Default**: `10`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--httpResponseTimeoutSec"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3ChttpResponseTimeoutSec.3E"></a>

### <httpResponseTimeoutSec>

HTTP response timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until arrival of a response from the opposite endpoint.

- **Type**: `int`
- **Since**: `3.0.0`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.httpResponseTimeoutSec`
- **Default**: `60`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--mimeType"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CmimeType.3E"></a>

### <mimeType>

The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.mimeType`
- **Default**: `application/java-archive`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--mountByFS"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CmountByFS.3E"></a>

### <mountByFS>

Whether to add (for install)/remove (for uninstall) the mapping for the [Apache Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource) for the [bundle's initial content](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-content-loading-jcr-contentloader--initial-content-loading). This parameter must not be `true` with bundles resolved from the Maven repository.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.mountByFS`
- **Default**: `false`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--packaging"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3Cpackaging.3E"></a>

### <packaging>

The packaging of the artifact to install

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.packaging`
- **Default**: `jar`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--password"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3Cpassword.3E"></a>

### <password>

The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.password`
- **Default**: `admin`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--refreshPackages"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CrefreshPackages.3E"></a>

### <refreshPackages>

Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.refreshPackages`
- **Default**: `true`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>

### <slingConsoleUrl>

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.console.url`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--slingUrl"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>

### <slingUrl>

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole** deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to include the [Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development--separate-uri-space-webdav), for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install). Omitting the `dav/default` segment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **User Property**: `sling.url`
- **Default**: `http://localhost:8080/system/console`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CslingUrlSuffix.3E"></a>

### <slingUrlSuffix>

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the `sling.url` for use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same common `sling.url` in a parent POM (eg. `sling.url=http://localhost:8080` and `sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path`). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.urlSuffix`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--usePut"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3CusePut.3E"></a>

### <usePut>

**Deprecated.**  
Use `deploymentMethod` instead.

  

If a PUT via WebDAV should be used instead of the standard POST to the Felix Web Console. In the `uninstall` goal, a HTTP DELETE will be used.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.usePut`
- **Default**: `false`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--user"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3Cuser.3E"></a>

### <user>

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.user`
- **Default**: `admin`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--version"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-file-mojo--a.3Cversion.3E"></a>

### <version>

The version of the artifact to install. Takes precedence over `artifact` and `bundleFileName`.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.version`

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo"></a>

# sling:install – Apache Sling Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--sling.3Ainstall"></a>

# sling:install

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.4:install

**Description**:

Install the project's artifact to a running Sling instance (in case it is an OSGi bundle). It uses the first valid OSGi bundle file for deployment from the primary artifact and all secondary ones. For details refer to [Bundle Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-bundle-installation). To install an arbitrary bundle not attached to the current Maven project use goal install-file.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](https://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `install`.

Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default:http://localhost:8080/system/consoleUser Property:sling.url |

Whether to skip this step even though it has been configured in the project to be executed.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.install.skip`
- **Default**: `false`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>

### <slingConsoleUrl>

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.console.url`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--slingUrl"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>

### <slingUrl>

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole** deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to include the [Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development--separate-uri-space-webdav), for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install). Omitting the `dav/default` segment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **User Property**: `sling.url`
- **Default**: `http://localhost:8080/system/console`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--a.3CslingUrlSuffix.3E"></a>

### <slingUrlSuffix>

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the `sling.url` for use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same common `sling.url` in a parent POM (eg. `sling.url=http://localhost:8080` and `sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path`). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.urlSuffix`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--usePut"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--a.3CusePut.3E"></a>

### <usePut>

**Deprecated.**  
Use `deploymentMethod` instead.

  

If a PUT via WebDAV should be used instead of the standard POST to the Felix Web Console. In the `uninstall` goal, a HTTP DELETE will be used.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.usePut`
- **Default**: `false`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--user"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-install-mojo--a.3Cuser.3E"></a>

### <user>

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.user`
- **Default**: `admin`

---

# sling:uninstall – Apache Sling Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--sling.3Auninstall"></a>

# sling:uninstall

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.4:uninstall

**Description**:

Uninstall an OSGi bundle from a running Sling instance. For details refer to [Bundle Uninstallation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-bundle-installation).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is not marked as thread-safe and thus does not support parallel builds.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>

## Required Parameters

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Omitting thedav/defaultsegment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.Default:http://localhost:8080/system/consoleUser Property:sling.url |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>

## Parameter Details

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--bundleFileName"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleFileName.3E"></a>

### <bundleFileName>

**Deprecated.**  
Use `bundleName` instead

  

The path of bundle file to uninstall. The file is only used to determine the file name or bundle symbolic name. This parameter is only effective if `bundleName` is not set.

- **Type**: `java.io.File`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.file`
- **Default**: `${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}.jar`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--bundleName"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleName.3E"></a>

### <bundleName>

The bundles's file/resource name without path (for all `deploymentMethod`s except for `WebConsole`) or its symbolic name. If this parameter is set, it takes precedence over `bundleFileName`.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.bundle.name`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--bundleStart"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleStart.3E"></a>

### <bundleStart>

Whether to start the uploaded bundle or not. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.bundle.start`
- **Default**: `true`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--bundleStartLevel"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CbundleStartLevel.3E"></a>

### <bundleStartLevel>

The start level to set on the installed bundle. If the bundle is already installed and therefore is only updated this parameter is ignored. The parameter is also ignored if the running Sling instance has no StartLevel service (which is unusual actually). Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.bundle.startlevel`
- **Default**: `20`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--deploymentMethod"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CdeploymentMethod.3E"></a>

### <deploymentMethod>

Bundle deployment method. One of the following three values are allowed

1. **WebConsole**, uses the [ Felix Web Console REST API](http://felix.apache.org/documentation/subprojects/apache-felix-web-console/web-console-restful-api.html#post-requests) for deployment (HTTP POST). This is the default. Make sure that `slingUrl` points to the Felix Web Console in that case.
2. **WebDAV**, uses [ WebDAV](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development) for deployment (HTTP PUT). Make sure that `slingUrl` points to the entry path of the Sling WebDAV bundle (defaults to `/dav/default` in the Sling starter). Issues a HTTP Delete for the uninstall goal.
3. **SlingPostServlet**, uses the [Sling Post Servlet](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-manipulating-content-the-slingpostservlet-servlets-post) for deployment (HTTP POST). Make sure that `slingUrl` points a path which is handled by the Sling POST Servlet (usually below regular Sling root URL).

For more details refer to [Bundle Installation](#sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-bundle-installation). This has precedence over the deprecated parameter `usePut`. If nothing is set the default is either `WebConsole` or `WebDAV` (when `usePut` is `true`).

- **Type**: `org.apache.sling.maven.bundlesupport.deploy.BundleDeploymentMethod`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.deploy.method`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--failOnError"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CfailOnError.3E"></a>

### <failOnError>

Determines whether or not to fail the build if the HTTP POST or PUT returns an non-OK response code.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.failOnError`
- **Default**: `true`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--httpConnectTimeoutSec"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3ChttpConnectTimeoutSec.3E"></a>

### <httpConnectTimeoutSec>

HTTP connection timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until a new connection is fully established. This may also include transport security negotiation exchanges such as `SSL` or `TLS` protocol negotiation).

- **Type**: `int`
- **Since**: `3.0.0`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.httpConnectTimeoutSec`
- **Default**: `10`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--httpResponseTimeoutSec"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3ChttpResponseTimeoutSec.3E"></a>

### <httpResponseTimeoutSec>

HTTP response timeout (in seconds). Determines the timeout until arrival of a response from the opposite endpoint.

- **Type**: `int`
- **Since**: `3.0.0`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.httpResponseTimeoutSec`
- **Default**: `60`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--mimeType"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CmimeType.3E"></a>

### <mimeType>

The content type / mime type used for WebDAV or Sling POST deployment.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.mimeType`
- **Default**: `application/java-archive`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--mountByFS"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CmountByFS.3E"></a>

### <mountByFS>

Whether to add (for install)/remove (for uninstall) the mapping for the [Apache Sling File System Resource Provider](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-accessing-filesystem-resources-extensions-fsresource) for the [bundle's initial content](#sling-apache-org-documentation-bundles-content-loading-jcr-contentloader--initial-content-loading). This parameter must not be `true` with bundles resolved from the Maven repository.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.mountByFS`
- **Default**: `false`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--password"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3Cpassword.3E"></a>

### <password>

The password to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.password`
- **Default**: `admin`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--refreshPackages"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CrefreshPackages.3E"></a>

### <refreshPackages>

Whether to refresh the packages after installing the uploaded bundle. Only applies when POSTing to Felix Web Console

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.refreshPackages`
- **Default**: `true`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--slingConsoleUrl"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CslingConsoleUrl.3E"></a>

### <slingConsoleUrl>

The WebConsole URL of the running Sling instance. This is required for file system provider operations. If not configured the value of slingUrl is used.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.console.url`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--slingUrl"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CslingUrl.3E"></a>

### <slingUrl>

The URL of the running Sling instance.

The default is only useful for **WebConsole** deployment.

For **WebDAV** deployment it is recommended to include the [Sling Simple WebDAV servlet root](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-repository-based-development--separate-uri-space-webdav), for instance [http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install](http://localhost:8080/dav/default/libs/sling/install). Omitting the `dav/default` segment can lead to conflicts with other servlets.

- **Type**: `java.net.URI`
- **Required**: `Yes`
- **User Property**: `sling.url`
- **Default**: `http://localhost:8080/system/console`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--slingUrlSuffix"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CslingUrlSuffix.3E"></a>

### <slingUrlSuffix>

An optional url suffix which will be appended to the `sling.url` for use as the real target url. This allows to configure different target URLs in each POM, while using the same common `sling.url` in a parent POM (eg. `sling.url=http://localhost:8080` and `sling.urlSuffix=/project/specific/path`). This is typically used in conjunction with WebDAV or SlingPostServlet deployment methods.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.urlSuffix`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--usePut"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3CusePut.3E"></a>

### <usePut>

**Deprecated.**  
Use `deploymentMethod` instead.

  

If a PUT via WebDAV should be used instead of the standard POST to the Felix Web Console. In the `uninstall` goal, a HTTP DELETE will be used.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.usePut`
- **Default**: `false`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--user"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-uninstall-mojo--a.3Cuser.3E"></a>

### <user>

The user name to authenticate at the running Sling instance.

- **Type**: `java.lang.String`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.user`
- **Default**: `admin`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-validate-mojo"></a>

# sling:validate – Apache Sling Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-validate-mojo--sling.3Avalidate"></a>

# sling:validate

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:sling-maven-plugin:3.0.4:validate

**Description**:

Validate all JSON files of a project. It only ensures they are well-formed but not that they are valid against a certain schema.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](https://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `process-resources`.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-validate-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

## Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <jsonQuoteTick> | boolean | - | Whether to accept quote ticks in JSON files or not.Default:falseUser Property:sling.validation.jsonQuoteTick |
| <skip> | boolean | - | Whether to skip the validation.Default:falseUser Property:sling.validation.skip |
| <skipJson> | boolean | - | Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no difference betweenskipandskipJsonbecause only JSON files will be validated by now.Default:falseUser Property:sling.validation.skipJson |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-validate-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>

## Parameter Details

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-validate-mojo--jsonQuoteTick"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-validate-mojo--a.3CjsonQuoteTick.3E"></a>

### <jsonQuoteTick>

Whether to accept quote ticks in JSON files or not.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.validation.jsonQuoteTick`
- **Default**: `false`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-validate-mojo--skip"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-validate-mojo--a.3Cskip.3E"></a>

### <skip>

Whether to skip the validation.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.validation.skip`
- **Default**: `false`

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-validate-mojo--skipJson"></a>

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-sling-maven-plugin-archives-sling-maven-plugin-3-0-4-validate-mojo--a.3CskipJson.3E"></a>

### <skipJson>

Whether to skip the json validation. At the time, there's no difference between `skip` and `skipJson` because only JSON files will be validated by now.

- **Type**: `boolean`
- **Required**: `No`
- **User Property**: `sling.validation.skipJson`
- **Default**: `false`

---

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.1.20:aggregate-features

**Description**:

Aggregate multiple features into a single one.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: test.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): generate-resources.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <aggregates> | List | - | The definition of the features used to create the new feature. |
| <features> | File | - | Directory containing feature filesDefault value is:src/main/features. |
| <testFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing test feature files.Default value is:src/test/features. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-1-20-aggregate-features-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <featuresExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the feature files. Feature files excluded by this configuration are not processed at all. |

| <generatedFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing generated feature files |

| <handlerConfiguration> | Map | - | (no description) |
| <jarStartOrder> | int | - | The start level for the attached jar/bundle. |
| <skipAddFeatureDependencies> | boolean | - | If set totruethe artifacts from the feature are not as dependencies to the project.Default value is:false. |
| <skipAddJarToFeature> | boolean | - | If set totruethe main jar artifact is not added to the feature.Default value is:false. |
| <skipAddJarToTestFeature> | boolean | - | If set totruethe main jar artifact is not added to the test feature.Default value is:false. |
| <skipAddTestFeatureDependencies> | boolean | - | If set totruethe artifacts from the test feature are not as dependencies to the project.Default value is:true. |
| <testFeaturesExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the test features. |
| <testFeaturesIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the test features.Default value is:**/*.json. |
| <validateFeatures> | boolean | - | If set totruethe features are validated against the JSON schema.Default value is:true. |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-1-20-apis-jar-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin – slingfeature:apis-jar

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-1-20-apis-jar-mojo--slingfeature:apis-jar"></a>slingfeature:apis-jar

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.1.20:apis-jar

**Description**:

Generates the APIs JARs for each selected Feature file.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: test.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): package.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-1-20-apis-jar-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <features> | File | - | Directory containing feature filesDefault value is:src/main/features. |
| <testFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing test feature files.Default value is:src/test/features. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-archives-slingfeature-maven-plugin-1-1-20-apis-jar-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <apiClassifierMappings> | Map | - | Mapping for the feature classifier to a user defined name |
| <apiJavadocResources> | List | - | Additional resources for the api javadoc jar |
| <apiRegionNameMappings> | Map | - | Mapping for an api region name to a user defined name |
| <apiResources> | List | - | Additional resources for the api jar |
| <apiSourceResources> | List | - | Additional resources for the api source jar |
| <attachApiJars> | boolean | - | If enabled, the created api jars will be atttached to the projectDefault value is:true. |
| <excludeRegions> | Set | - | Names of the regions to exclude, by default no regions is excluded. |
| <featuresExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the feature files. Feature files excluded by this configuration are not processed at all. |
| <featuresIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the feature files in the configured directory. Only feature files specified by this include are processed.Default value is:**/*.json. |
| <generateApiJar> | boolean | - | Generate api jarDefault value is:true. |
| <generateJavadocJar> | boolean | - | Generate the javadoc jarDefault value is:true. |
| <generateSourceJar> | boolean | - | Generate the sources jarDefault value is:true. |
| <generatedFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing generated feature files |
| <generatedFeaturesExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the generated feature files. Feature files excluded by this configuration are not processed at all. |
| <generatedFeaturesIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the generated feature files in the configured directory. Only feature files specified by this include are processed.Default value is:**/*.json. |
| <ignoreJavadocErrors> | boolean | - | Ignore errors in javadoc generationDefault value is:false. |
| <includeRegions> | Set | - | Names of the regions to include, by default all regions are included.Default value is:*. |
| <includeResources> | String[] | - | Patterns identifying which resources to include from bundles |
| <incrementalApis> | boolean | - | If set to true and api jars are created for more than one region, then the higher region only gets the difference to the lower region. If set to false each api jar gets the full region information (duplicating information)Default value is:true. |
| <jarStartOrder> | int | - | The start level for the attached jar/bundle. |
| <javadocLinks> | String[] | - | List of javadoc links used in the javadoc generation. |
| <javadocSourceLevel> | String | - | (no description) |
| <selection> | FeatureSelectionConfig | - | Select the features for api generation. |
| <skipAddFeatureDependencies> | boolean | - | If set totruethe artifacts from the feature are not as dependencies to the project.Default value is:false. |
| <skipAddJarToFeature> | boolean | - | If set totruethe main jar artifact is not added to the feature.Default value is:false. |
| <skipAddJarToTestFeature> | boolean | - | If set totruethe main jar artifact is not added to the test feature.Default value is:false. |
| <skipAddTestFeatureDependencies> | boolean | - | If set totruethe artifacts from the test feature are not as dependencies to the project.Default value is:true. |
| <testFeaturesExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the test features. |
| <testFeaturesIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the test features.Default value is:**/*.json. |
| <validateFeatures> | boolean | - | If set totruethe features are validated against the JSON schema.Default value is:true. |
