| <testFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing test feature files.Default:src/test/features |

# slingfeature:attach-features – Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-attach-features-mojo--slingfeature.3Aattach-features"></a>

# slingfeature:attach-features

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.9.4:attach-features

**Description**:

Attach the feature as a project artifact.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: `test`.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](https://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `package`.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-attach-features-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>

| <testFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing test feature files.Default:src/test/features |

# slingfeature:embed-features – Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-embed-features-mojo--slingfeature.3Aembed-features"></a>

# slingfeature:embed-features

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.9.4:embed-features

**Description**:

Embed the features in the resources

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: `test`.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](https://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `prepare-package`.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-embed-features-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>

## Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <features> | File | - | Directory containing feature filesDefault:src/main/features |
| <testFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing test feature files.Default:src/test/features |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-embed-features-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

## Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <defaultMetadata> | Map<...> | - | This parameter is only declared to make Maven happy, it is evaluated in the Preprossor |
| <embed> | FeatureSelectionConfig | - | Configuration to define the features to be embedded, by default all features are embedded. |
| <enableLegacyVariableReplacement> | boolean | 1.3.6 | Enable old variable replacement in feature model based on the full maven project including system variables. If this is enabled, enableProjectVariableReplacement and replacePropertyVariables have no effect.Default:false |
| <enableProjectVariableReplacement> | boolean | 1.3.6 | Enable the replacement of variables when reading a feature model. The supported variables are "project.groupId", "project.artifactId", "project.version" and "project.osgiVersion".Default:true |
| <featuresExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the feature files. Feature files excluded by this configuration are not processed at all. |
| <featuresIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the feature files in the configured directory. Only feature files specified by this include are processed.Default:**/*.json |
| <generatedFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing generated feature files |
| <generatedFeaturesExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the generated feature files. Feature files excluded by this configuration are not processed at all. |
| <generatedFeaturesIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the generated feature files in the configured directory. Only feature files specified by this include are processed.Default:**/*.json |
| <jarStartOrder> | int | - | The start level for the attached jar/bundle. |
| <replacePropertyVariables> | String | 1.3.6 | A comma separated list of variables which are replaced when a feature model is read. The value of these variables is fetched from the project properties. |
| <resourcesPath> | String | - | Path where the features are embedded in the target/classes directory.Default:META-INF/features |
| <skipAddFeatureDependencies> | boolean | - | If set totruethe artifacts from the feature are not added as dependencies with scope=providedto the project.Default:false |
| <skipAddJarToFeature> | boolean | - | If set totruethe main jar artifact is not added to the feature.Default:false |
| <skipAddJarToTestFeature> | boolean | - | If set totruethe main jar artifact is not added to the test feature.Default:false |
| <skipAddTestFeatureDependencies> | boolean | - | If set totruethe artifacts from the test feature are not added as dependencies with scope=testto the project.Default:true |
| <testFeaturesExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the test features. |
| <testFeaturesIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the test features.Default:**/*.json |
| <validateFeatures> | boolean | - | If set totruethe features are validated against the JSON schema.Default:true |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-features-diff-mojo--slingfeature.3Afeatures-diff"></a>

# slingfeature:features-diff

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.9.4:features-diff

**Description**:

Compares different versions of the same Feature Model.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: `test`.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](https://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `package`.

# slingfeature:help

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.9.4:help

**Description**:

Display help information on slingfeature-maven-plugin.
  
Call `mvn slingfeature:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name>` to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

| <indentSize> | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default:2User Property:indentSize |
| <lineLength> | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default:80User Property:lineLength |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-include-artifact-mojo"></a>

# slingfeature:include-artifact – Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-include-artifact-mojo--slingfeature.3Ainclude-artifact"></a>

# slingfeature:include-artifact

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.9.4:include-artifact

**Description**:

This goal creates a Feature Model file that includes the Module Artifact as bundle (or extension) so that the Artifact can be added through a FM into a FM project. The FM file can be found in the 'build directory'/slingfeature-tmp folder. After a FM file is created successfully this file will be installed in the local Maven Repository as 'slingosgifeature' file under the Module's Maven Id location (group, artifact, version). This file can then later be used inside the 'aggregate-features' goal with: ` <includeArtifact> <groupId>org.apache.sling</groupId> <artifactId>org.apache.sling.test.feature</artifactId> <version>1.0.0</version> <classifier>my-test-classifier</classifier> <type>slingosgifeature</type> </includeArtifact> ` It also can add dependencies to the FM file if its scope is provided (normally that would be 'compile'). In addition a bundle start order can be set for these included dependency bundles. Finally any FM files inside the Source FM folder are embedded into the FM file. This allows to add extension files like 'repoinit' etc to be added to provide them with the module.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: `compile`.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](https://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `prepare-package`.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-include-artifact-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>

## Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <features> | File | - | Directory containing feature filesDefault:src/main/features |
| <testFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing test feature files.Default:src/test/features |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-include-artifact-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

## Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <bundlesStartOrder> | int | - | Start Order of all included Dependencies.Default:-1User Property:bundleStartOrder |
| <defaultMetadata> | Map<...> | - | This parameter is only declared to make Maven happy, it is evaluated in the Preprossor |
| <enableLegacyVariableReplacement> | boolean | 1.3.6 | Enable old variable replacement in feature model based on the full maven project including system variables. If this is enabled, enableProjectVariableReplacement and replacePropertyVariables have no effect.Default:false |
| <enableProjectVariableReplacement> | boolean | 1.3.6 | Enable the replacement of variables when reading a feature model. The supported variables are "project.groupId", "project.artifactId", "project.version" and "project.osgiVersion".Default:true |
| <featuresExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the feature files. Feature files excluded by this configuration are not processed at all. |
| <featuresIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the feature files in the configured directory. Only feature files specified by this include are processed.Default:**/*.json |
| <generatedFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing generated feature files |
| <generatedFeaturesExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the generated feature files. Feature files excluded by this configuration are not processed at all. |
| <generatedFeaturesIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the generated feature files in the configured directory. Only feature files specified by this include are processed.Default:**/*.json |
| <includeArtifactClassifier> | String | - | Classifier of the feature the current artifact is included in. For simple projects a artifact classifier is not needed but in multi feature projects the classifier is used to find the appropriate feature.User Property:includeArtifactClassifier |
| <includeArtifactExtension> | String | - | Name of the extension to include the artifact in. If not specified the artifact is included as a bundle. |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-info-mojo"></a>

# slingfeature:info – Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-info-mojo--slingfeature.3Ainfo"></a>

# slingfeature:info

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.9.4:info

**Description**:

Extract information from a feature This mojo does not require a project, it can be run by just pointing it at a feature file. When run from within a project, the normal feature selection mechanism can be used. This mojo supports

- Extracting the exported packages per feature and writing them to a file
- Detecting duplicates across features and writing a report

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Since version: `1.1.20`.

| <testFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing test feature files.Default:src/test/features |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-launch-features-mojo--slingfeature.3Alaunch-features"></a>

# slingfeature:launch-features

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.9.4:launch-features

**Description**:

Launches the given Feature File

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

# slingfeature:repository – Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-repository-mojo--slingfeature.3Arepository"></a>

# slingfeature:repository

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.9.4:repository

**Description**:

Create a Maven repository structure from the referenced artifacts in the features.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: `test`.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](https://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): `package`.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-repository-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>

## Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <features> | File | - | Directory containing feature filesDefault:src/main/features |
| <testFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing test feature files.Default:src/test/features |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-repository-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

## Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

# slingfeature:update-feature-versions – Apache Sling OSGi Feature Maven Plugin

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-update-feature-versions-mojo--slingfeature.3Aupdate-feature-versions"></a>

# slingfeature:update-feature-versions

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingfeature-maven-plugin:1.9.4:update-feature-versions

**Description**:

Update the bundles/artifact versions

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-update-feature-versions-mojo--Required_Parameters"></a>

## Required Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <features> | File | - | Directory containing feature filesDefault:src/main/features |
| <testFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing test feature files.Default:src/test/features |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingfeature-maven-plugin-update-feature-versions-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>

## Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <classifiers> | String | - | A comma separated list of classifiers to select the feature files. Use ':' to select the main artifact (no classifier).User Property:classifiers |
| <defaultMetadata> | Map<...> | - | This parameter is only declared to make Maven happy, it is evaluated in the Preprossor |
| <dryRun> | boolean | - | If set to true, no changes are performedDefault:falseUser Property:dryRun |
| <enableLegacyVariableReplacement> | boolean | 1.3.6 | Enable old variable replacement in feature model based on the full maven project including system variables. If this is enabled, enableProjectVariableReplacement and replacePropertyVariables have no effect.Default:false |
| <enableProjectVariableReplacement> | boolean | 1.3.6 | Enable the replacement of variables when reading a feature model. The supported variables are "project.groupId", "project.artifactId", "project.version" and "project.osgiVersion".Default:true |
| <featuresExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the feature files. Feature files excluded by this configuration are not processed at all. |
| <featuresIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the feature files in the configured directory. Only feature files specified by this include are processed.Default:**/*.json |
| <generatedFeatures> | File | - | Directory containing generated feature files |
| <generatedFeaturesExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the generated feature files. Feature files excluded by this configuration are not processed at all. |
| <generatedFeaturesIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the generated feature files in the configured directory. Only feature files specified by this include are processed.Default:**/*.json |
| <jarStartOrder> | int | - | The start level for the attached jar/bundle. |
| <replacePropertyVariables> | String | 1.3.6 | A comma separated list of variables which are replaced when a feature model is read. The value of these variables is fetched from the project properties. |
| <skipAddFeatureDependencies> | boolean | - | If set totruethe artifacts from the feature are not added as dependencies with scope=providedto the project.Default:false |
| <skipAddJarToFeature> | boolean | - | If set totruethe main jar artifact is not added to the feature.Default:false |
| <skipAddJarToTestFeature> | boolean | - | If set totruethe main jar artifact is not added to the test feature.Default:false |
| <skipAddTestFeatureDependencies> | boolean | - | If set totruethe artifacts from the test feature are not added as dependencies with scope=testto the project.Default:true |
| <testFeaturesExcludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of excludes for the test features. |
| <testFeaturesIncludes> | String | - | Comma separated list of includes for the test features.Default:**/*.json |
| <updatesExcludesList> | String | - | A comma separated list of artifact patterns to exclude. Follows the pattern "groupId:artifactId:type:classifier:version". Designed to allow specifying the set of excludes from the command line.User Property:excludes |
| <updatesIncludesList> | String | - | A comma separated list of artifact patterns to include. Follows the pattern "groupId:artifactId:type:classifier:version". Designed to allow specifying the set of includes from the command line.User Property:includes |
| <validateFeatures> | boolean | - | If set totruethe features are validated against the JSON schema.Default:true |
| <versionScope> | String | - | The scope to use to find the highest version, use ANY, MAJOR, MINOR, INCREMENTAL, or SUBINCREMENTALUser Property:versionScope |

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – slingstart:attach-modelarchive

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--slingstart:attach-modelarchive"></a>slingstart:attach-modelarchive

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.7.14:attach-modelarchive

**Description**:

Attach the model archive as a project artifact.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: test.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): package.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| allowUnresolvedPomDependencies | boolean | - | If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in the Maven POM.Default value is:false. |
| disableExtendingMavenClasspath | boolean | - | If set totruethe Maven classpath (either scope "provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being referenced in the model.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| model | String | 1.3 | Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any model found inmodelDirectory.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| modelArchiveName | String | - | The filename to be used for the generated model archive file.Default value is:${project.build.finalName}. |
| modelDirectory | File | - | The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter is evaluated in theDependencyLifecycleParticipant. As default first${basedir}/src/main/provisioningand then${basedir}/src/test/provisioningis used (in case the former does not exist).This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:${basedir}/src/main/provisioning. |
| modelPattern | String | - | The model file name pattern to consider.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:((.*)\.txt\|(.*)\.model). |
| usePomDependencies | boolean | - | If set totrue, Artifact dependencies from provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved against the versions given in the Maven POM. The following sections in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:The project's artifact itselfThe project's dependenciesThe project's dependencyManagementDefault value is:false. |
| usePomVariables | boolean | - | If set totrue, properties from the Maven POM can be used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using this model do not have to resolve them themselves.Default value is:false. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--allowUnresolvedPomDependencies"></a>allowUnresolvedPomDependencies:**

If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is
set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in
the Maven POM.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--disableExtendingMavenClasspath"></a>disableExtendingMavenClasspath:**

If set to true the Maven classpath (either scope
"provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being
referenced in the model.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--model"></a>model:**

Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any
model found in modelDirectory.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 1.3
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelArchiveName"></a>modelArchiveName:**

The filename to be used for the generated model archive file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${project.build.finalName}

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelDirectory"></a>modelDirectory:**

The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter
is evaluated in the DependencyLifecycleParticipant. As
default first ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning and
then ${basedir}/src/test/provisioning is used (in case
the former does not exist).

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelPattern"></a>modelPattern:**

The model file name pattern to consider.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ((.\*)\.txt|(.\*)\.model)

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--usePomDependencies"></a>usePomDependencies:**

If set to true, Artifact dependencies from
provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved
against the versions given in the Maven POM. The following sections
in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:

1. The project's artifact itself
2. The project's dependencies
3. The project's dependencyManagement

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-attach-modelarchive-mojo--usePomVariables"></a>usePomVariables:**

If set to true, properties from the Maven POM can be
used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables
are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using
this model do not have to resolve them themselves.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

| lineLength | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.7.14:package

**Description**:

Create a Sling quickstart package (either JAR or WAR) based on the
referenced model.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: test.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): pre-integration-test.

| attachArtifact | boolean | - | If set tofalsedoes not attach the generated artifact to Maven. This setting takes only effect if the packaging of the current Maven project is notslingstart. Otherwise the generated artifact is always the main artifact (and is therefore always attached).Default value is:true. |
| createWebapp | boolean | - | If set totruecreates a WAR artifact in addition to the standalone JAR from the model.Default value is:false. |
| disableExtendingMavenClasspath | boolean | - | If set totruethe Maven classpath (either scope "provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being referenced in the model.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| model | String | 1.3 | Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any model found inmodelDirectory.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| modelDirectory | File | - | The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter is evaluated in theDependencyLifecycleParticipant. As default first${basedir}/src/main/provisioningand then${basedir}/src/test/provisioningis used (in case the former does not exist).This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:${basedir}/src/main/provisioning. |
| modelPattern | String | - | The model file name pattern to consider.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:((.*)\.txt\|(.*)\.model). |
| usePomDependencies | boolean | - | If set totrue, Artifact dependencies from provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved against the versions given in the Maven POM. The following sections in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:The project's artifact itselfThe project's dependenciesThe project's dependencyManagementDefault value is:false. |
| usePomVariables | boolean | - | If set totrue, properties from the Maven POM can be used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using this model do not have to resolve them themselves.Default value is:false. |

- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – slingstart:start

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-start-mojo--slingstart:start"></a>slingstart:start

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.7.14:start

**Description**:

Start one or multiple launchpad instance(s).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): pre-integration-test.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-start-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cleanWorkingDirectory | boolean | - | Clean the working directory before start.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.clean.workdir. |
| debug | String | - | Overwrites debug parameter of all server configurations (if set). Attaches a debugger to the forked JVM. If set to"true", the process will allow a debugger to connect on port 8000. If set to some other string, that string will be appended to the server'svmOpts, allowing you to configure arbitrary debugging options.User property is:launchpad.debug. |
| keepLaunchpadRunning | boolean | - | Deprecated.UseAbstractStartStopMojo.blockUntilKeyIsPressedinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.keep.running. |
| launchpadDependency | Dependency | - | The launchpad jar as a dependency. This is only used if "launchpadJar" is not specified. |
| launchpadJar | File | - | The launchpad jar. This option has precedence over "launchpadDependency".User property is:launchpad.jar. |
| launchpadReadyTimeOutSec | int | - | Ready timeout in seconds. If the launchpad has not been started in this time, it's assumed that the startup failed.Default value is:600.User property is:launchpad.ready.timeout. |
| parallelExecution | boolean | - | Set the execution of launchpad instances to be run in parallel (threads)Default value is:true.User property is:launchpad.parallelExecution. |
| servers | List | - | Parameter containing the list of server configurations |
| shouldBlockUntilKeyIsPressed | boolean | - | Iftruethis mojo blocks until you press the Enter key. |
| skipLaunchpad | boolean | - | Set this to "true" to skip starting the launchpadDefault value is:false.User property is:maven.test.skip. |
| systemPropertiesFile | File | - | The system properties file will contain all started instances with their ports etc.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/launchpad-runner.properties. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-14-start-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – slingstart:attach-modelarchive

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--slingstart:attach-modelarchive"></a>slingstart:attach-modelarchive

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.7.16:attach-modelarchive

**Description**:

Attach the model archive as a project artifact.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: test.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): package.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| allowUnresolvedPomDependencies | boolean | - | If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in the Maven POM.Default value is:false. |
| disableExtendingMavenClasspath | boolean | - | If set totruethe Maven classpath (either scope "provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being referenced in the model.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| model | String | 1.3 | Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any model found inmodelDirectory.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| modelArchiveName | String | - | The filename to be used for the generated model archive file.Default value is:${project.build.finalName}. |
| modelDirectory | File | - | The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter is evaluated in theDependencyLifecycleParticipant. As default first${basedir}/src/main/provisioningand then${basedir}/src/test/provisioningis used (in case the former does not exist).This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:${basedir}/src/main/provisioning. |
| modelPattern | String | - | The model file name pattern to consider.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:((.*)\.txt\|(.*)\.model). |
| usePomDependencies | boolean | - | If set totrue, Artifact dependencies from provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved against the versions given in the Maven POM. The following sections in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:The project's artifact itselfThe project's dependenciesThe project's dependencyManagementDefault value is:false. |
| usePomVariables | boolean | - | If set totrue, properties from the Maven POM can be used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using this model do not have to resolve them themselves.Default value is:false. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--allowUnresolvedPomDependencies"></a>allowUnresolvedPomDependencies:**

If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is
set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in
the Maven POM.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--disableExtendingMavenClasspath"></a>disableExtendingMavenClasspath:**

If set to true the Maven classpath (either scope
"provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being
referenced in the model.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--model"></a>model:**

Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any
model found in modelDirectory.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 1.3
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelArchiveName"></a>modelArchiveName:**

The filename to be used for the generated model archive file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${project.build.finalName}

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelDirectory"></a>modelDirectory:**

The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter
is evaluated in the DependencyLifecycleParticipant. As
default first ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning and
then ${basedir}/src/test/provisioning is used (in case
the former does not exist).

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelPattern"></a>modelPattern:**

The model file name pattern to consider.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ((.\*)\.txt|(.\*)\.model)

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--usePomDependencies"></a>usePomDependencies:**

If set to true, Artifact dependencies from
provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved
against the versions given in the Maven POM. The following sections
in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:

1. The project's artifact itself
2. The project's dependencies
3. The project's dependencyManagement

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-attach-modelarchive-mojo--usePomVariables"></a>usePomVariables:**

If set to true, properties from the Maven POM can be
used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables
are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using
this model do not have to resolve them themselves.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

-Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

**Attributes**:

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-help-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| goal | String | - | The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.User property is:goal. |
| indentSize | int | - | The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.Default value is:2.User property is:indentSize. |
| lineLength | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – SlingStart Maven Plugin

# SlingStart Maven Plugin

Maven Plugin supporting Sling Launchpad.

See [The Apache Sling Provisioning Model and Apache SlingStart](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-slingstart) for a documentation about the provisioning model and the general SlingStart concepts.

See [Goals](#sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-plugin-info) for a list of supported goals.

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – slingstart:package

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--slingstart:package"></a>slingstart:package

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.7.16:package

**Description**:

Create a Sling quickstart package (either JAR or WAR) based on the
referenced model.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: test.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): pre-integration-test.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| allowUnresolvedPomDependencies | boolean | - | If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in the Maven POM.Default value is:false. |
| attachArtifact | boolean | - | If set tofalsedoes not attach the generated artifact to Maven. This setting takes only effect if the packaging of the current Maven project is notslingstart. Otherwise the generated artifact is always the main artifact (and is therefore always attached).Default value is:true. |
| createWebapp | boolean | - | If set totruecreates a WAR artifact in addition to the standalone JAR from the model.Default value is:false. |
| disableExtendingMavenClasspath | boolean | - | If set totruethe Maven classpath (either scope "provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being referenced in the model.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| model | String | 1.3 | Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any model found inmodelDirectory.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| modelDirectory | File | - | The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter is evaluated in theDependencyLifecycleParticipant. As default first${basedir}/src/main/provisioningand then${basedir}/src/test/provisioningis used (in case the former does not exist).This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:${basedir}/src/main/provisioning. |
| modelPattern | String | - | The model file name pattern to consider.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:((.*)\.txt\|(.*)\.model). |
| usePomDependencies | boolean | - | If set totrue, Artifact dependencies from provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved against the versions given in the Maven POM. The following sections in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:The project's artifact itselfThe project's dependenciesThe project's dependencyManagementDefault value is:false. |
| usePomVariables | boolean | - | If set totrue, properties from the Maven POM can be used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using this model do not have to resolve them themselves.Default value is:false. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--allowUnresolvedPomDependencies"></a>allowUnresolvedPomDependencies:**

If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is
set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in
the Maven POM.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--attachArtifact"></a>attachArtifact:**

If set to false does not attach the generated artifact
to Maven. This setting takes only effect if the packaging of the
current Maven project is not slingstart. Otherwise the
generated artifact is always the main artifact (and is therefore
always attached).

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: true

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--createWebapp"></a>createWebapp:**

If set to true creates a WAR artifact in addition to
the standalone JAR from the model.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--disableExtendingMavenClasspath"></a>disableExtendingMavenClasspath:**

If set to true the Maven classpath (either scope
"provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being
referenced in the model.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--model"></a>model:**

Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any
model found in modelDirectory.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 1.3
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--modelDirectory"></a>modelDirectory:**

The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter
is evaluated in the DependencyLifecycleParticipant. As
default first ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning and
then ${basedir}/src/test/provisioning is used (in case
the former does not exist).

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--modelPattern"></a>modelPattern:**

The model file name pattern to consider.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ((.\*)\.txt|(.\*)\.model)

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--usePomDependencies"></a>usePomDependencies:**

If set to true, Artifact dependencies from
provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved
against the versions given in the Maven POM. The following sections
in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:

1. The project's artifact itself
2. The project's dependencies
3. The project's dependencyManagement

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-package-mojo--usePomVariables"></a>usePomVariables:**

If set to true, properties from the Maven POM can be
used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables
are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using
this model do not have to resolve them themselves.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – slingstart:start

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-start-mojo--slingstart:start"></a>slingstart:start

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.7.16:start

**Description**:

Start one or multiple launchpad instance(s).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): pre-integration-test.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-16-start-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cleanWorkingDirectory | boolean | - | Clean the working directory before start.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.clean.workdir. |
| debug | String | - | Overwrites debug parameter of all server configurations (if set). Attaches a debugger to the forked JVM. If set to"true", the process will allow a debugger to connect on port 8000. If set to some other string, that string will be appended to the server'svmOpts, allowing you to configure arbitrary debugging options.User property is:launchpad.debug. |
| keepLaunchpadRunning | boolean | - | Deprecated.UseAbstractStartStopMojo.blockUntilKeyIsPressedinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.keep.running. |
| launchpadDependency | Dependency | - | The launchpad jar as a dependency. This is only used if "launchpadJar" is not specified. |
| launchpadJar | File | - | The launchpad jar. This option has precedence over "launchpadDependency".User property is:launchpad.jar. |
| launchpadReadyTimeOutSec | int | - | Ready timeout in seconds. If the launchpad has not been started in this time, it's assumed that the startup failed.Default value is:600.User property is:launchpad.ready.timeout. |
| parallelExecution | boolean | - | Set the execution of launchpad instances to be run in parallel (threads)Default value is:true.User property is:launchpad.parallelExecution. |
| servers | List | - | Parameter containing the list of server configurations |
| shouldBlockUntilKeyIsPressed | boolean | - | Iftruethis mojo blocks until you press the Enter key. |
| skipLaunchpad | boolean | - | Set this to "true" to skip starting the launchpadDefault value is:false.User property is:maven.test.skip. |
| systemPropertiesFile | File | - | The system properties file will contain all started instances with their ports etc.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/launchpad-runner.properties. |

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – slingstart:attach-modelarchive

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--slingstart:attach-modelarchive"></a>slingstart:attach-modelarchive

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.7.2:attach-modelarchive

**Description**:

Attaches the model archive as a project artifact.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: test.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): package.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| allowUnresolvedPomDependencies | boolean | - | If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in the Maven POM.Default value is:false. |
| disableExtendingMavenClasspath | boolean | - | If set totruethe Maven classpath (either scope "provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being referenced in the model.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| model | String | 1.3 | Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any model found inmodelDirectory.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| modelArchiveName | String | - | The filename to be used for the generated model archive file.Default value is:${project.build.finalName}. |
| modelDirectory | File | - | The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter is evaluated in theDependencyLifecycleParticipant. As default first${basedir}/src/main/provisioningand then${basedir}/src/test/provisioningis used (in case the former does not exist).This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:${basedir}/src/main/provisioning. |
| modelPattern | String | - | The model file name pattern to consider.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:((.*)\.txt\|(.*)\.model). |
| usePomDependencies | boolean | - | If set to true, Artifact dependencies from provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved against the dependency versions from the Maven POM.Default value is:false. |
| usePomVariables | boolean | - | If set to true, properties from the Maven POM can be used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using this model do not have to resolve them themselves.Default value is:false. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--allowUnresolvedPomDependencies"></a>allowUnresolvedPomDependencies:**

If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is
set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in
the Maven POM.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--disableExtendingMavenClasspath"></a>disableExtendingMavenClasspath:**

If set to true the Maven classpath (either scope
"provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being
referenced in the model.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--model"></a>model:**

Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any
model found in modelDirectory.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 1.3
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelArchiveName"></a>modelArchiveName:**

The filename to be used for the generated model archive file.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${project.build.finalName}

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelDirectory"></a>modelDirectory:**

The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter
is evaluated in the DependencyLifecycleParticipant. As
default first ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning and
then ${basedir}/src/test/provisioning is used (in case
the former does not exist).

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--modelPattern"></a>modelPattern:**

The model file name pattern to consider.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ((.\*)\.txt|(.\*)\.model)

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--usePomDependencies"></a>usePomDependencies:**

If set to true, Artifact dependencies from provisioning file
without explicit version are tried to be resolved against the
dependency versions from the Maven POM.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-attach-modelarchive-mojo--usePomVariables"></a>usePomVariables:**

If set to true, properties from the Maven POM can be used as
variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables are
added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using this
model do not have to resolve them themselves.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**Description**:

the correct locations.

- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: test.

- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): pre-integration-test.

tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Since**: 1.3
- **Required**: No

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-repository-mojo--modelDirectory"></a>modelDirectory:**

The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter
is evaluated in the DependencyLifecycleParticipant. As
default first ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning and
then ${basedir}/src/test/provisioning is used (in case
the former does not exist).

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-repository-mojo--modelPattern"></a>modelPattern:**

The model file name pattern to consider.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.lang.String
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ((.\*)\.txt|(.\*)\.model)

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-repository-mojo--usePomDependencies"></a>usePomDependencies:**

If set to true, Artifact dependencies from provisioning file
without explicit version are tried to be resolved against the
dependency versions from the Maven POM.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-repository-mojo--usePomVariables"></a>usePomVariables:**

If set to true, properties from the Maven POM can be used as
variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables are
added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using this
model do not have to resolve them themselves.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

**Description**:

Mojo for starting launchpad.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): pre-integration-test.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-2-start-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cleanWorkingDirectory | boolean | - | Clean the working directory before start.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.clean.workdir. |
| debug | String | - | Overwrites debug parameter of all server configurations (if set). Attaches a debugger to the forked JVM. If set to"true", the process will allow a debugger to connect on port 8000. If set to some other string, that string will be appended to the server'svmOpts, allowing you to configure arbitrary debugging options.User property is:launchpad.debug. |
| keepLaunchpadRunning | boolean | - | Deprecated.UseAbstractStartStopMojo.blockUntilKeyIsPressedinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.keep.running. |
| launchpadDependency | Dependency | - | The launchpad jar as a dependency. This is only used if "launchpadJar" is not specified. |
| launchpadJar | File | - | The launchpad jar. This option has precedence over "launchpadDependency".User property is:launchpad.jar. |
| launchpadReadyTimeOutSec | int | - | Ready timeout in seconds. If the launchpad has not been started in this time, it's assumed that the startup failed.Default value is:600.User property is:launchpad.ready.timeout. |
| parallelExecution | boolean | - | Set the execution of launchpad instances to be run in parallel (threads)Default value is:true.User property is:launchpad.parallelExecution. |
| servers | List | - | Parameter containing the list of server configurations |
| shouldBlockUntilKeyIsPressed | boolean | - | Iftruethis mojo blocks until you press the Enter key. |
| skipLaunchpad | boolean | - | Set this to "true" to skip starting the launchpadDefault value is:false.User property is:maven.test.skip. |
| systemPropertiesFile | File | - | The system properties file will contain all started instances with their ports etc.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/launchpad-runner.properties. |

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.7.6:attach-modelarchive

**Description**:

Attach the model archive as a project artifact.

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- Requires dependency resolution of artifacts in scope: test.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): package.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-attach-modelarchive-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| allowUnresolvedPomDependencies | boolean | - | If set to true, an exception is throws when "usePomDependencies" is set to true and some dependency version could not be resolved in the Maven POM.Default value is:false. |
| disableExtendingMavenClasspath | boolean | - | If set totruethe Maven classpath (either scope "provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being referenced in the model.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| model | String | 1.3 | Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any model found inmodelDirectory.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin. |
| modelArchiveName | String | - | The filename to be used for the generated model archive file.Default value is:${project.build.finalName}. |
| modelDirectory | File | - | The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter is evaluated in theDependencyLifecycleParticipant. As default first${basedir}/src/main/provisioningand then${basedir}/src/test/provisioningis used (in case the former does not exist).This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:${basedir}/src/main/provisioning. |
| modelPattern | String | - | The model file name pattern to consider.This parameter is evaluated in theModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution therefore it must not be configured within anexecution tagbut rather in the global configuration section for this plugin.Default value is:((.*)\.txt\|(.*)\.model). |
| usePomDependencies | boolean | - | If set to true, Artifact dependencies from provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved against the dependency versions from the Maven POM.Default value is:false. |
| usePomVariables | boolean | - | If set to true, properties from the Maven POM can be used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using this model do not have to resolve them themselves.Default value is:false. |

referenced model.

Start one or multiple launchpad instance(s).

**Attributes**:

- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): pre-integration-test.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-7-6-start-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cleanWorkingDirectory | boolean | - | Clean the working directory before start.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.clean.workdir. |
| debug | String | - | Overwrites debug parameter of all server configurations (if set). Attaches a debugger to the forked JVM. If set to"true", the process will allow a debugger to connect on port 8000. If set to some other string, that string will be appended to the server'svmOpts, allowing you to configure arbitrary debugging options.User property is:launchpad.debug. |
| keepLaunchpadRunning | boolean | - | Deprecated.UseAbstractStartStopMojo.blockUntilKeyIsPressedinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.keep.running. |
| launchpadDependency | Dependency | - | The launchpad jar as a dependency. This is only used if "launchpadJar" is not specified. |
| launchpadJar | File | - | The launchpad jar. This option has precedence over "launchpadDependency".User property is:launchpad.jar. |
| launchpadReadyTimeOutSec | int | - | Ready timeout in seconds. If the launchpad has not been started in this time, it's assumed that the startup failed.Default value is:600.User property is:launchpad.ready.timeout. |
| parallelExecution | boolean | - | Set the execution of launchpad instances to be run in parallel (threads)Default value is:true.User property is:launchpad.parallelExecution. |
| servers | List | - | Parameter containing the list of server configurations |
| shouldBlockUntilKeyIsPressed | boolean | - | Iftruethis mojo blocks until you press the Enter key. |
| skipLaunchpad | boolean | - | Set this to "true" to skip starting the launchpadDefault value is:false.User property is:maven.test.skip. |
| systemPropertiesFile | File | - | The system properties file will contain all started instances with their ports etc.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/launchpad-runner.properties. |

default first ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning and
then ${basedir}/src/test/provisioning is used (in case
the former does not exist).

ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Default**: ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning

therefore it must not be configured within an [execution

plugin.

in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:

| lineLength | int | - | The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.Default value is:80.User property is:lineLength. |

See [The Apache Sling Provisioning Model and Apache SlingStart](#sling-apache-org-documentation-development-slingstart) for a documentation about the provisioning model and the general SlingStart concepts.

See [Goals](#sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-plugin-info) for a list of supported goals.

to Maven. This setting takes only effect if the packaging of the

always attached).

the standalone JAR from the model.

If set to true the Maven classpath (either scope
"provided" or "test") will not be extended by the artifacts being
referenced in the model.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this

Inlined model. Is processed first and afterwards merged with any
model found in modelDirectory.

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

---

**<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-package-mojo--modelDirectory"></a>modelDirectory:**

The model directory containing the provision models. This parameter
is evaluated in the DependencyLifecycleParticipant. As
default first ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning and
then ${basedir}/src/test/provisioning is used (in case
the former does not exist).

This parameter is evaluated in the
ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

- **Type**: java.io.File
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: ${basedir}/src/main/provisioning

---

ModelPreprocessor, i.e. outside of the Mojo execution
therefore it must not be configured within an [execution
tag](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-configuring-plugins.html#Using_the_executions_Tag) but rather in the global configuration section for this
plugin.

If set to true, Artifact dependencies from
provisioning file without explicit version are tried to be resolved
against the versions given in the Maven POM. The following sections
in the effective pom are considered during resolving the version:

1. The project's artifact itself
2. The project's dependencies

If set to true, properties from the Maven POM can be
used as variables in the provisioning files. The resolved variables
are added to the generated provisioning file, so other tools using
this model do not have to resolve them themselves.

- **Type**: boolean
- **Required**: No
- **Default**: false

---

<a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-start-mojo"></a>

# Apache Sling SlingStart Maven Plugin – slingstart:start

## <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-start-mojo--slingstart:start"></a>slingstart:start

**Full name**:

org.apache.sling:slingstart-maven-plugin:1.8.2:start

**Description**:

Start one or multiple launchpad instance(s).

**Attributes**:

- Requires a Maven project to be executed.
- The goal is thread-safe and supports parallel builds.
- Binds by default to the [lifecycle phase](http://maven.apache.org/ref/current/maven-core/lifecycles.html): pre-integration-test.

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-start-mojo--Optional_Parameters"></a>Optional Parameters

| Name | Type | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cleanWorkingDirectory | boolean | - | Clean the working directory before start.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.clean.workdir. |
| debug | String | - | Overwrites debug parameter of all server configurations (if set). Attaches a debugger to the forked JVM. If set to"true", the process will allow a debugger to connect on port 8000. If set to some other string, that string will be appended to the server'svmOpts, allowing you to configure arbitrary debugging options.User property is:launchpad.debug. |
| keepLaunchpadRunning | boolean | - | Deprecated.UseAbstractStartStopMojo.blockUntilKeyIsPressedinstead.Default value is:false.User property is:launchpad.keep.running. |
| launchpadDependency | Dependency | - | The launchpad jar as a dependency. This is only used if "launchpadJar" is not specified. |
| launchpadJar | File | - | The launchpad jar. This option has precedence over "launchpadDependency".User property is:launchpad.jar. |
| launchpadReadyTimeOutSec | int | - | Ready timeout in seconds. If the launchpad has not been started in this time, it's assumed that the startup failed.Default value is:600.User property is:launchpad.ready.timeout. |
| parallelExecution | boolean | - | Set the execution of launchpad instances to be run in parallel (threads)Default value is:true.User property is:launchpad.parallelExecution. |
| servers | List | - | Parameter containing the list of server configurations |
| shouldBlockUntilKeyIsPressed | boolean | - | Iftruethis mojo blocks until you press the Enter key. |
| skipLaunchpad | boolean | - | Set this to "true" to skip starting the launchpadDefault value is:false.User property is:maven.test.skip. |
| systemPropertiesFile | File | - | The system properties file will contain all started instances with their ports etc.Default value is:${project.build.directory}/launchpad-runner.properties. |

### <a id="sling-apache-org-components-slingstart-maven-plugin-archives-slingstart-maven-plugin-1-8-2-start-mojo--Parameter_Details"></a>Parameter Details
